absorb magic.name: absorb magic
absorb magic.description: Every Wanderer has dealt with the disappointment of having poured so much effort (and energy) into the creation of a vortex, only to have it fall apart at the last moments. One particularly clever mage noted that a significant amount of energy is released as a vortex unravels, and it seemed only right that one should be able to harness some of that power. From this idea, 'Absorb Magic' was born.Whenever a vortex fails to stabilize, you are able to collect energy from the fallout. The nicest thing is that you don't even have to have been connected to the rift in order to get this boost!

acupuncture.name: acupuncture
acupuncture.description: Acupuncture is an ancient method of healing, based on finding the damaged nerve centers and when those centers are applied with certain pressure, the ailment cures up miraculously. Some people need needles for this operation, the monks however have practiced the method for so long, they have no need for them. Instead they can use their knowledge of vital points to even increase the effect.

aether flow.name: aether flow
aether flow.description: Runemages get their magical powers not from the gods, as more conventional mages or clerics do, but from ancient concentrations of magical power, that are rumoured to originate from the times when the world itself was created. It is the fractions of this power that the runemagi have over the millenia successfully learned to master and encapsulate in artefacts that they call runestones. The skill of using the power withheld in these stones for their spellweaving is yet another arcane art that the runemagi have to get acquainted with.

alcohol tolerance.name: alcohol tolerance
alcohol tolerance.description: Alcohol can be found in many forms, ale, beer, fine wines, and various other liquors. It is said that the refinement of the production of alcohol preceded many other advancements in the known world, such as metalworking, even the study of magic. Some use alcohol as entertainment, others use it as a panacea for their ills. Others even use it as a source of energy -- many will attest to the single drunkard in the pub who requires several others to subdue him. For all the 'good' feelings alcohol can bring, if used in excess, it can also bring around nasty side-effects. Those who over time have honed their tolerance and skill in drinking alcohol, can drink much more then those who have not, with less chance of a hang-over.

alertness.name: alertness
alertness.description: One of the biggest advantages one can get over another in a battle, is the advantage of surprise. Many times, surprise allows one to control the battle. Also, being surprised makes it easy for one's foe to keep him from leaving the battle. If one has keen senses and is aware of his surroundings, he can sometimes avoid ambushes, and walk away unscathed. Simply using the skill will cause you to turn the skill on/off.

alloying.name: alloying
alloying.description: One of the most circulated tales and legends, is the  child's story of a girl, who was given the ability to turn straw into gold. Other legends hint that others may have  found ways to turn iron, or other worthless material into gold or similar valuable substances. Through the ages, there has been some study using magic and even the new studies into what some call science, or non-magical magic,  that deal with the properties of substances. One of the results of these studies, is the ability to take different substances, and through refinement, create a totally different substance.Realworld usage:You can alloy two or more materials to form a new material. You must put all the materials into a workbench of the appropriate type.Skill usage:use alloying at <mat1>,<mat2>,...,<mat_n> in <bench>example:use alloying at gold,silver in forge use alloying at iron,silver,gold,dukonium in forge use alloying at silk,leather in loom

alpha dog mentality.name: alpha dog mentality
alpha dog mentality.description: While barbarians do not necessarily spring to mind when one talks of leadership and charisma, they are often pictured on the front lines of groups of savage, feral warriors. The fear and respect they demand in both their allies and enemies cannot be underestimated. When paired with a beastmaster's affinity for animals, this allows them to inspire their mounts to strike with greater precision and ferocity, increasing the mount's chance to hit with its special attacks. This mastery skill affects both guided strike and feral attack.

amalgamate.name: amalgamate
amalgamate.description: Those who work with metals and ores, know that to produce quality work, they fashion their works out of single pieces of material. Using several smaller fragments often produces items which are inherently weak, and useless. In order to acquire these large chunks of material, they often must take several pieces of a material and fuse them together to create one larger piece. Once this piece is completed, normal work can proceed. Often the proper tools are needed, since many materials are difficult to work with in their normal states. The true ep cost depends on the amount of material amalgamated.Usage: use amalgamate at <material> in <workbench>  Example: use amalgamate at iron in forge

analysis of magic lore.name: analysis of magic lore
analysis of magic lore.description: As powerful as magic is, it does have drawbacks. The most common way magic is used is to be wielded as a weapon. Due to the nature of magic, the effects of magical spells may not be apparent. Some creatures  themselves are born of magic, with powers to ward off magical attacks. Others have other ways to defeat offensive magic cast upon them. In order to efficiently use magic to defeat a foe, means being able to tell if your attacks are having any affect. By  carefully studying the effects of magic one can deduce his effectiveness against his enemy. Of course there is said to be magic which can hide the true effects of magic from even those most proficient at this skill. It is said that wisdom may help discern the effects of spells using this power.

animist strike.name: animist strike
animist strike.description: This skill combines the incite animal soul and weapon strike skills. You must be riding an animal soul mount for the skill to work. It is also required that you wield a bludgeon or long blade in your primary hand. While a bit on the slow side, this skill has the potential to deal good damage, and even better damage against evil opponents if your weapon is blessed. The weapon used affects the damage greatly.Usage: use animist strike [at target]

anointing.name: anointing
anointing.description: The act of anointing is an old religious ritual in which holy oils are applied upon a person to purify him or her spiritually. This ceremonial act is an old tradition of priests, nuns and other clergymen and it has been practiced by different cultures over centuries. Most oils used in the ritual are considered natural and the oils themselves are typically quite common ones but there are stories of clergymen applying miracle oils to bestow magical blessings. One should also be careful when dealing with fire, as most oils can be highly flammable and instead of anointing a sudden spark could be mean a recipe for disaster.

appraise.name: appraise
appraise.description: The world is full of many items. Some are useless, some are magical, others are cursed. Often the true identity of an item may be hidden from just a casual glance. Through experience, one may be able to, with a closer inspection of an item, discover some properties of the item. Much of the use of this type of skill involves determining a genuine item from a fake one. Many times, blacksmiths and those who work in repairing items must be able to attain information about an item before attempting repairs. If they cannot do this themselves, they may have the local sage appraise the item for them.

arrow spray.name: arrow spray
arrow spray.description: A showy but effective trick, master archers can notch and fire several arrows in a single shot. This invariably causes the arrows to spread, making it useless against a single target but very effective against a group. While each arrow loses some of its punch (the bow can only provide so much power at a time), the overall effect can more than make up for it. Syntax: use arrow spray at <target> Because of the way this skill requires a handful of arrows quickly, it uses the first 'bunch' of arrows in your inventory with 5 or more. Manual selection of ammunition is not possible, and individual arrows can't be used at all.

ascension.name: ascension
ascension.description: The Sentinels of Infizinity, who represent the best of the best, devote their lives for finding ways of ascending above the limits of their mortal shells. Ascension is a long and hard journey for even for the most experienced of the sentinels. Ascension teaches ways to overcome physical limits and allows the sentinels to reach extraordinary pinnacles of power. The way to the top is not an easy one but it sure is rewarding.

aspect of kurenakuma.name: aspect of kurenakuma
aspect of kurenakuma.description: Kurenakuma, a demon lord of blood and insanity, attempted to break into this dimension during a particularly rare lunar event. While he failed, some fragments of his demonic powers were severed and left in this world. A loyal follower of the true demon lords can grab some of this remaining energy and use it to their own ends. The power will be brief, no more than a few seconds, but during that time the follower will have dramatically improved abilities, resistances, and (if used in combat) a sharp spike of deadly attacks. This skill can be used no more than once per hour.

assault.name: assault
assault.description: The structure of a sword makes it ideal for use from horseback. Its aerodynamic blade, combined with its reach and its balance, allows it to strike with even more effectiveness from the saddle. The speed of the mount, combined with the added power of a downwards blow, can cause much more grevious wounds than a soldier on foot could ever hope to do with the same weapon. Assault is the skill used to strike foes with a long bladed weapon while riding. Mastery of mounted combat increases the chance of a second strike.

assembly.name: assembly
assembly.description: This skill is used when assembling simple buildings or sites such as heat-tent, sauna or avanto. Crafting skills on different materials can improve the quality of the building to a degree. Much like in everything, better the quality of the product is, happier the user gets when using it.

attack.name: attack
attack.description: The most common form of fighting is hand to hand fighting. Whether this involves a fist, claw or a wielded weapon, it still is necessary to successfully make contact with the target for the attack to work. And as common sense dictates, most targets won't stand still for you to beat upon them.  In order to be able to land attacks upon your opponent, you  must be skilled in fighting. This requires physical strength, and deftness. A keen mind able to anticipate the opponent is also a desirable trait. Without this skill in fighting, all you will be doing is making holes in the air, which not only makes you look bad, it can make you end up feeling bad as well.

autopsy.name: autopsy
autopsy.description: The gruesome act of autopsy is one of the ways folklorists study creatures. Many a young folklorist has had to leave the room when the act of autopsy is taught, such a gruesome act it is. It involves opening the corpse of a creature, dissecting all the organs and making notes of what is found. Those skilled in dissection and swift scalpel might be able to save some of the organs. Those skilled in dissection can also try to cut a specific organ while performing the autopsy, for example 'use autopsy at corpse try heart'.

avalanche slam.name: avalanche slam
avalanche slam.description: Many of the more experience unarmed fighters know the benefits of a 'throw' are many. The impact of the victim's body against the ground is typically more forceful than any unarmed strike or kick could hope to equal. This particular throw tries to put as much of your enemy's weight into as small of a space as possible, thus magnifying the effective crushing power. In addition, heavy foes, such as armoured warriors, are crushed under more weight than their body is used to handling, increasing the damage further.

axes.name: axes
axes.description: Axes are the favorite weapons of barbarians and rangers. While a common use for an axe is to chop firewood, if you want to use an axe for a weapon, you'll find that your targets are not as easy as a tree to hit, since they tend to try to avoid you, making it difficult to hit them with full force. Axes, to the unskilled user, are very unwieldy to use, due to the differences in balance between an axe, and say a sword, or a club. Axes are very top heavy. In order to be able to hit your foe solidly, you must know how to swing an axe smoothly, or all you will end up with, are glancing blows, not the flesh ripping direct hits you yearn for.

baptize.name: baptize
baptize.description: One of the missions of any follower of good or evil, is to bring others into the fold. By carefully presenting the  good sides of their current belief, they may try to win the souls of others. Not everyone can be easily turned to the  light, or to the darkness. Those who are willing to turn  make much easier converts then those who may try to resist it.

barbaric ways.name: barbaric ways
barbaric ways.description: As anyone with any smarts know, barbarians excel at most combat skills, especially ruthless barbaric ones. However, for a barbarian to be able to do full carnage with their skills they must tap into their barbaric senses. Barbaric ways helps you to tap into these barbaric senses.

bargain.name: bargain
bargain.description: Many people in the realms are able to make their living off the work of others. They roam from place to place, buying items and then, selling them at higher prices. Those who are really good can use their wits and charm to barter and haggle and obtain cheaper prices than normally given to others. It may take flirting, compliments, or down right ass-kissing, but they can come away with their wares and a few extra gold to spare. Some are good enough that their reputation precedes them, shops close for the day if they hear that person is to be in town.

bash.name: bash
bash.description: One of the abilities any warrior has at his advantage is his size and strength. A simple attack maneuver that takes advantage of this is charging full speed into your opponent,  hoping to knock him to the ground. Not only does this cause damage, but it can disrupt many opponents as they have to recover their balance or their feet. Just remember, the bigger you are, the harder they fall.

battery.name: battery
battery.description: When a blunt weapon strikes, the damage it can produce is determined only by its speed and its weight. For centuries, soldiers and weaponsmiths have struggled with the optimum combination of the two to form the most brutal bashing weapon. A more feasable solution is to use the weapon from the back of a fast horse (or similar creature). In addition to the obvious added speed the rider gains from the steed, by striking downwards at their foes they can impart extra force to their blow, causing even more damage.

battle cadence.name: battle cadence
battle cadence.description: Whilst your blades are short, you can achieve a faster pace in battle than your slow adversary. A heavy sword falls once whereas a light one twice; but for this, skill is required. One must, of course, be fairly skilled with short blades before this technique can be employed.

battlecry.name: battlecry
battlecry.description: Any warrior will tell you that the most important part of any battle, is the beginning. Initiative is usually decided in the first seconds of battle, and with it, many times the results as well. Striking the first blow can be  a huge advantage, especially if attacking an unprepared foe. By striking first, and drawing on strength from within, a tremendous first strike can be made, accompanied by a harsh battlecry. Many times this will catch a foe unawares, allowing him to be taken advantage of.

beheading of departed.name: beheading of departed
beheading of departed.description: The legionaries of Kharim sometimes hang the heads of their enemies on wooden stakes so that those heads are seen from longer distances as well. It is a greatly demoralizing act that causes fear amongst the weak. While hanging a head on stake is a vile and disgraceful act, the beheading itself is seen as very natural act in the eyes of Kharim as even the highest ranking officers of Kharim are traditionally beheaded after their death as an act of respect. The cultists of Kharim believe that by cutting the head off, the trapped soul is set free from the dead vessel. As part of the ritual, souls are invited to respect the memory of the recently departed one and then guide the lost soul to its new domain.

bestial frenzy.name: bestial frenzy
bestial frenzy.description: Many of the cultists of Tzarakk still share the same primal instincts as wild animals. In many ways the cultists do share similar traits and taste for blood, like many beasts of the forest. The senses of the beastmasters are always sharp and usually it's intrinsic for a beastmaster to act with a gut feeling rather than to make a careful decision by putting one's mind into it. To civilized people it's perfectly normal to use their brain, but the brutish instincts of the beastmaster are often interpreted as barbaric and bestial, although it's an essential survival mechanism. Many cultists of Tzarakk often become threatened which may cause them to become infuriated and draw resources they don't usually have. But it will usually make them less careful as well. It's common to encounter a cultist who is overwhelmed by bestial frenzy when they're in melee combat.

blacksmithing.name: blacksmithing
blacksmithing.description: Master blacksmiths possess the ability to work wonders with materials. They can take many items, melt them down, and use those materials to create a different piece of armour. This is hardly an exact science, they fail more then they succeed, but  they can truly perform wonders, taking advantage of whatever they can get ahold of to fashion their creations.Usage: use blacksmithing at armour 1 and armour 2

blade of the battlemedic.name: blade of the battlemedic
blade of the battlemedic.description: This mastery skill allows tarmalen followers to an electrical charge to their knight attacks, such as precise slash. The damage is lightning-based and increased by the skill 'mastery of medicine' as well as the actual number of wounded members of their party.

blade of the herald.name: blade of the herald
blade of the herald.description: This mastery skill allows bards to increase the effect of their knight attacks, such as precise slash. The damage is harm-based and increased by the skill 'songmastery', but is greatly increased when used against legendary monsters that have kill timers.

blade of the honourbound.name: blade of the honourbound
blade of the honourbound.description: This mastery skill allows sabres to add animal ego damage to their knight attacks, such as precise slash. The damage is psi-based and increased by the skill 'sabre feint' as well as which weapons the target wields. Shorter or cruder weapons, like clubs and axes, increase the damage. Thieves using multiple knives are ripped apart.

blade of the warden.name: blade of the warden
blade of the warden.description: This mastery skill allows animists to add animal soul damage to their knight attacks, such as precise slash. The damage is mana-based and increased by the skill 'sever soul' as well as the animal spirit they ride when they attack.

bladed fury.name: bladed fury
bladed fury.description: The ability rangers most pride themselves in, is their prowess with edged weapons, either swords, or axes. A true master can use his weapon to strike his opponent with unequaled fury. With the proper training, a ranger can become one with his weapon, making it an extension of his arm. Through this harmony  with his weapon, the ranger is able to carve through his foes, like he was a machine.Since this skill is considered the pinnacle of Ranger combat might, it relies on lots things - including, but not limited to, used weapon, agility, the capability for mayhem in general.. Heck, old rumours say that serious Rangers can even deduce something  of the opponents resistances against certain damagetypes from the bladed  fury only, after adding a shove and a nice, painful kick to the adversary's head.Also, trying to hit things with treesized axes while not being very good at hitting things with pointy items - not a smart idea.

blend salves.name: blend salves
blend salves.description: Mixing two medicines together to combine their effects is a risky step to take, but trained alchemists and herbalists who know what they're doing can make it work. This skill combines the effects of two salves, so they can both be applied at the same time. Syntax: use blend salves at <salve 1> and <salve 2> Higher skill lets you mix stronger salves with more effects, however, the second salve can only have ONE effect which is blended into the first. It should be noted that mixing strong and weak salves always gives a weak result.

bless.name: bless
bless.description: A devoted follower of either good or evil may be able to  invoke the power of the gods and bring a blessing upon one of similar alignment. The more devoted and skilled the invoker, the more gracious the gods may be. Many different blessings can be awarded as the gods see fit, but only one blessing  at a time can be given to any one person.

blinding shot.name: blinding shot
blinding shot.description: Many arrows break on contact with their target, and most of the rest are broken when the victim pulls it out. With this skill, the archer can take this fact and use it to his advantage. By cracking the arrow just barely at the notch when firing, he causes it to break into splinters from the stress of the shot, usually just before it strikes. This does not lower the damage, however, if an arrow fragment hits an unprotected eye, the target could be momentarily blinded. Syntax: use blinding shot at <target> shoot <arrow>         use blinding shot at <target> Since the arrows used by this technique always break, it's considered  unwise to use arrows you wish to see again.

blindsided assault.name: blindsided assault
blindsided assault.description: Before more complex maneuvers may be learned, it is important to know the basics. In the case of legionaries, it usually means long days of shield combat training or simply known as 'manner of lordliness'. When the manner of lordliness is mastered, more difficult maneuvers may be performed. One of those more challenging maneuvers is blindsided assault. Legionaries of Kharim use shield to hide their sword-hand's position from view and thus blocking vision of the enemy, thus making them guess for the next strike. When the combat is rapid, every single second may provide a crucial advantage. Blindsided assault is a derivative technique of tumbling attack which means that proficiency in tumbling attack will also help when performing blindsided assaults.

blood craze.name: blood craze
blood craze.description: The term 'bloodthirsty' has strong roots. The most primal and savage of warriors were known to enter a feral state at the sight, smell, or taste of blood. A berserker who uses this skill grants themself a powerful but short-term boost to all physical stats, the amount of the bonus being based on how wounded they and their target are.

blood harvest.name: blood harvest
blood harvest.description: This fourth and final skill in the progression represents the epitome of reaver's battle fury. By clearing their mind of all thoughts, the reaver is able to act in the purest, most savage form of brutality and strike with primordial fury. A skillful reaver can strike as many as four times before the unfortunate opponent hits the ground, either writhing in agony or dying in a pool of his own blood. As with reaver strike, the first skill occurs right away while the second, third, and fourth take place in the following rounds.

blood of the sorcerer.name: blood of the sorcerer
blood of the sorcerer.description: The most talented of channellers have magic infused in their very blood, coursing through their veins. While being wounded isn't the most pleasant experience, such a powerful channeller could drain the magical energy of their own blood as it falls from their body. This skill, which is automatically in effect, lets the user regain magical energies through their energy aura, depending on how badly wounded they are.

bloodletting.name: bloodletting
bloodletting.description: Bloodletting has a long history. It has been practiced by druids and other healers often with a purpose of curing illness, but whether this practice can be considered effective is somewhat arguable. Priests of Burglefloogah often practice bloodletting in order to collect blood for their own blood mixing experiments. For Sa'hr blood means life and blood is needed to give birth to many satomalums of the swamp. Bloodletting requires a willing donor but there are priests who sometimes collect their blood from a reluctant, dead donor as well.

bloody horns.name: bloody horns
bloody horns.description: Using their horns in combat is natural for minotaurs, but with training they become even more effective weapons. Masters of this skill are often covered in blood; dripping from their horns.

bludgeons.name: bludgeons
bludgeons.description: One of the most common and oldest weapons used is the trusty club. Simple, yet effective the club and many other bludgeons are still preferred by man warriors.  Clubs, maces, morning stars, hammers, and mauls are only a few of the types of weapons that make up this category. Bludgeons are favored by many due to the fact that even heavy platemail may not reduce the shock of a crushing hit, whereas a edged weapon would glance off harmlessly. Knowing what parts of the target are most vulnerable to crushing attacks is a key in using these weapons.

bolt burst.name: bolt burst
bolt burst.description: The more skilled crossbowmen know the full limits of their weapon, and can take full advantage of their crossbow's draw. By loading more than one bolt at the same time into the channel correctly, they can fire them all simultaneously in a single barrage. Because the bolts are placed so closely together, they all end up striking the same target at the same time. The heavier, more dangerous bolts will often smack into each other in midair, turning into a swirling funnel of razor-sharp shards. Syntax: use bolt burst at <target> shoot <bunch of bolts>         use bolt burst at <target>

braced shot.name: braced shot
braced shot.description: When firing any form of crossbow with your offhand, this skill lets you rest the crossbow on the top of your shield, reducing the penalty for an offhand shot. Higher skill% and larger shields reduce the penalty even further.

brawling.name: brawling
brawling.description: Nothing is more comforting to a warrior going into battle, then having his trusty sword, or axe in his hand. But there comes a time when he may not have the luxury of his familiar tools of the trade. If that happens, he must be able to make do in a pinch with whatever he can get his hands on. Chairs, tables, eating  utensils, anything he can pick up and swing, can make a formidable weapon, if one knows what to do with it. Some say that the true masters of this skill claim they must be intoxicated for it to work to its full potential.

break ambush.name: break ambush
break ambush.description: Nobody likes to be cornered. This skill, trained by those who value their mobility in combat, lets you get out of an ambush faster than your opponent would normally allow.

breath of doom.name: breath of doom
breath of doom.description: A reaver in the quest for the destruction of everything finds the need to fight and devestate multiple opponents at once a useful tool. To this end, they learn and use this skill, which is a modified form of corrosive cut. The reaver swings an acid-soaked weapon with great speed and uses dark energy to turn the acid into a mist of tiny droplets. These are blown towards his victims by the exhalation of a mighty scream. Those on the recieving end of the acid mist who inhale are burned severely, possibly with lethal results. You must be in combat to use this skill.

burial ceremony.name: burial ceremony
burial ceremony.description: Followers of Tarmalen and the other good gods, strive to preserve life. Since to them any life is sacred, the taking of a life is a tragedy. Once a soul is released from the  body, the remaining corpse should be given a fitting end. By exercising a few rites over the corpse, the links of the soul to this world, are given a respectful farewell.

burrowing.name: burrowing
burrowing.description: In the big hostile world one may often wish for a private and cosy little burrow to hide in... for some the desire has been strong enough to perfect a method of burrowing to create such a hole, if none are available.

butchering.name: butchering
butchering.description: Since the days when the first humanoids formed the basest elements of civilization, they have found uses for all the body parts of animals hunted or domesticated. The flesh was eaten, clothes formed from the hides, and the bones used as tools. Masters of the butchering skill reflect on this knowledge gained over the centuries and remove from any corpse parts that may still have some value. Butchering the corpse of a primate is an evil act.

bypass armour.name: bypass armour
bypass armour.description: Very little is more frustrating to an archer than firing a well-aimed shot at his target, only to watch the arrow burst into splinters on a helmet or breastplate -- or, worse, a stray piece of jewelry that happens to be in the way. This skill trains you to selectively aim at parts of the body that are not covered by armour, without lowering the odds of a successful shot. In the case of full coverage, this skill helps you find chinks or gaps between the pieces, which is much harder to do.

call animals.name: call animals
call animals.description: Sometimes, it is easier for the hunter to get his prey to come to him, rather than the other way around. With this skill, a trained outdoorsman can try to bring any neary tamable animals to his location. While location is the most important factor of this skill (you can't get fish in the desert), success rate can be improved by having a whistle or appropriate mount feed in your inventory. Higher skill percent allows you to call more types of animals.

calm animal.name: calm animal
calm animal.description: One of the most difficult tasks the beastmaster can attempt is the task of taming a creature too wild and too savage for the civlized races to domesticate. Such creatures as lions and bears have a tendency to attack any invader on sight, which makes the arduous task of breaking their spirit not merely difficult but life-threatening. As such, the bravest and most dedicated of beastmasters learn the art of calming such creatures, stopping their attacks so the taming process can begin. The same skill is also useful for calming a mount that has, for some reason or other, become angered against its owner. To use this skill with any hope of success, the beastmaster must appear as non-threatening to the animal as possible.

camouflage.name: camouflage
camouflage.description: With this skill, a ranger can use a pelt of a monster as a camouflage. For using this skill you need to have a fresh corpse in your inventory (with decent size). Good knowledge in woodland stealth helps you while moving with camouflage on (especially indoors). Skill usage: 'use camouflage at <corpse>' to start hiding. 'Use camouflage' to stop using the skill.

camping.name: camping
camping.description: Living in the wilderness is a tough way to survive.  Often, there is little time for one to recover from the rigors of finding food and fuel. Being able to rest one's self is a discipline in itself. By learning how to relax outdoors and take a short catnap, one can regain lost vigor and strength. There are many ways to make these rests even better. Those  who are skilled at this can also use this when not in the  wilderness, of course there is nothing like being in the great outdoors.

candlestick making.name: candlestick making
candlestick making.description: With this skill one may create ordinary candles or special candles with unique scent. You need wax to create plain candles and leaves of some plant or herb if you want to create scented candles. Candle types are huge, tiny, small, large and normal. Candlestick making is not to be taken lightly as those who master this old art are almost certain in favour of all kind of magicians. Syntax: use 'candlestick making' <type> [scent <herb type>]

cannibalize.name: cannibalize
cannibalize.description: The time comes when even the best blacksmith will come upon an item that he can do nothing with, or may find he badly needs a certain material in order to finish a vital repair. In times like this, he can take almost any armour and melt it down, or form it into a reworkable mass. This way he may not have to go find raw material himself, he can just get by with what he has on hand. If you want to make sure you don't cannibalize wrong item, place the item in keep.

cardiac stimulation.name: cardiac stimulation
cardiac stimulation.description: It has been said that one can revive an unconscious creature with just a blade. By inserting the blade in between the ribs and directly into the heart then giving it just the right twist one can accomplish a miracle. It has been rumored that in human sacrifices that perhaps this is truly what was going on, not death, but a kind of awakening. It has also been said that high priests and high priestesses can perform this ceremony across unknown distances.

carpentry.name: carpentry
carpentry.description: Different people have different skills. Some are good fighters, some are good hunters, some are good, well you know. A few always end up to be much more talented then others using their hands to build things, buildings and furniture, whatever needs to be made, using wood. The finest carpenters know how to strengthen and treat wood to make it not only durable, but also a sight to behold as well. Even points as fine as selection of the wood can drive an amateur nuts, but to an expert, its just another job. Usage: use carpentry at build supports use <wood>

cast acid.name: cast acid
cast acid.description: One form of offensive magic is practiced by those who use acid as their main form of damage. Employing spells which cause the targets to be inflicted upon by acid is  one of the more feared types of magic. Even those who can withstand the brutal agony of their flesh being melted from their bones, must take care that they don't lose their armour as the acid can also eat away at that as well. To successfully employ this type of magic requires some knowledge of the nature of acids and other corrosive substances.

cast alchemy.name: cast alchemy
cast alchemy.description: This skill helps casting spells in an efficient way, a must for every spell caster. Spellcasting without this skill is very inefficient. This skill is automatically in use together with the 'cast generic' skill.

cast asphyxiation.name: cast asphyxiation
cast asphyxiation.description: The element of air, is one of the most powerful elements known, so it is not suprising that the air itself has been harnessed by those who use magic to inflict its power upon their enemies. By amplifying and controlling the forces of air, those who wield this form of magic can use their target's need for air against them. Knowledge of the invisible forces known to us as the air and wind is helpful in casting these types of spells.

cast channelling.name: cast channelling
cast channelling.description: This skill helps casting spells in an efficient way, a must for every spell caster. Spellcasting without this skill is very inefficient. This skill is automatically in use together with the 'cast generic' skill.

cast chaos.name: cast chaos
cast chaos.description: The followers of chaos have long had their own tricks for making magic happen. While other disciplines generally rely on strictly set patterns and methods for harnessing the natural powers, chaos casters rely on doing everything, at the same time. A chaotic magic user casting spells is a sight to behold - first, one laughs, then one cries, then - permanent silence.

cast cold.name: cast cold
cast cold.description: Most creatures encountered in this plane of existance have a need to sustain a minimum body temperature, that is to stay warm. By harnessing the power of cold, one can literally freeze their opponents which can be quite nasty. Flesh has a nasty habit of becoming quite brittle when frozen solid, and quick freezing it makes it even worse. Knowing how to harness the arctic powers takes a special skill and know-how.

cast control.name: cast control
cast control.description: One family of magic that is as old as magic itself, are spells that are woven that break the very limits of nature and its laws. Magical spells that enhance abilities beyond normal physical limits, and that defy other natural limits, are part of this type of magic. To cast these spells effectively, one must learn what makes up the laws that determine what natural limits are, and how to supercede them.

cast death.name: cast death
cast death.description: Death is a normal part of the circle of life as without death there could never be life. Death is often seen as a frightful concept and much of it has to do with its permanence. Not many have the confidence to tamper with magic that involves death and even those who use death magic cast spells cautiously with utmost respect. Death spells bear likeness to death itself and are so  strong that the magic cannot easily be undone.

cast destruction.name: cast destruction
cast destruction.description: As the name implies, this skill helps in the casting of destruction spells. These spells mostly cause the damaging, in whole or in part, of an item or creature, and gain power from the released energies if the target is destroyed. Other spells call upon those released energies to reward the caster. Either way, casting of such spells is very inefficient, perhaps impossible, without this skill.

cast dispel.name: cast dispel
cast dispel.description: This basic skill is used when casting spells of dispel type to harm evil entities.

cast electricity.name: cast electricity
cast electricity.description: Lightning, for ages, has been looked upon as one of the most powerful occurances in nature. Striking from somewhere unseen in the heavens, and wreaking havoc on whatever lies in its path. Not suprisingly, some of those who practice magic have harnessed that power for use against their enemies. The ability to  throw bolts of lightning at will is a very powerful one indeed. In order to conjure the power of the  storms, one should be familiar with the nature of lightning and its characteristics.

cast fire.name: cast fire
cast fire.description: One of the most destructive forces know today is that of a raging fire. Devouring everything in its path with no discrimination, fire is feared everywhere. Of course it is also used as a tool, to provide heat and light, in controlled situations, of course. Others have used fire in another way. Users of magic have discovered how to summon forth and direct fire, in various forms, with predictable results. Fire is a very powerful element, and no different are those magics which are based upon it. To be able to cast spells using fire, it is very helpful to know much about fire and its abilities, and how to control it with magic.

cast generic.name: cast generic
cast generic.description: This skill is the basis upon which a spell caster draws all of his ability. Imbued in this skill is the general learning and knowledge of magic and its use. Even the most basic of incantations require some knowledge of how to correctly speak the verbal components, and execute the  proper accompanying physical actions to work. Those who aren't well schooled in this learning can sometimes get lucky and successfully employ their power some of the time, but who wants to trust luck?

cast harm.name: cast harm
cast harm.description: Followers of the evil gods, unlike their counterparts who follow the good gods, are not taught to use magic to heal, but instead are taught to use their magic to 'unheal', or harm.  In order to cast this type of magic, one must have no regard for life, except his own of course. Death and destruction are  left in the wake of those who practice this dark magic. This type of magic has such little regard for its target, no reliable protection from its effects are known.

cast heal.name: cast heal
cast heal.description: One of the more benevolant types of magic, is the  magic which is used to heal one's self or others. Not many things, once killed, are of any use to  anyone, so keeping things alive was one of the first forms of magic that was utilized. Originally starting as witch-doctors in various tribes, the art of healing through magic has evolved to a very refined art. No town within the realms is without a local healer. It is a very dangerous world, so the art of healing has been practiced and refined through the ages. In order to use healing magic effectively, some knowledge of the nature of this type of magic is required.

cast help.name: cast help
cast help.description: There are many types of magic that are benevolent to the target. Many of these spells are designed to assist or enhance the target in some way. In order to cast these types of spells effectively, one must be skilled in many different  lores and schools of magic. Most of this type of spells are based in religious backgrounds, of the good aligned gods.

cast holy.name: cast holy
cast holy.description: This basic skill is used when casting spells of holy type to destroy undead beings with divine power.

cast information.name: cast information
cast information.description: Throughout the ages, what we now know as civilization has  come about through only one means, knowledge. Knowledge comes in many forms, and in many different fields. Many of the most powerful figures in the realms today, have not fought for their positions as much as they have gained them through knowledge. Magic, from its  inception, has been an unparalleled tool in gaining knowledge.  Any magical spell that allows either the target or the caster to know something previously unknown, is part of this family of spells. The only real prerequisit to cast this type of spell, is the  thirst for knowledge.

cast magical.name: cast magical
cast magical.description: While magic can take many forms, there is still nothing like the unchanged power of pure magic. Instead of shaping the magic power to another form such as fire, many uses of magic prefer to draw on the purest form of magical energy for use against their opponents. To be able to wield pure magic effectively, one must be knowledgable in  its characteristics.

cast poison.name: cast poison
cast poison.description: There are few ways more dreaded by mortals then to die of poison. Many things in the realms, if  introduced into a person's body, are fatal, attacking vital organs in a grotesque fashion. Some poisons are quick, while others take years to painfully claim their victims. Only users of magic with no remorse for their victims choose this path of magic to inflict upon their foes. Some knowledge of the workings of poison and magical poisons is needed to successfully cast this type of spell.

cast protection.name: cast protection
cast protection.description: Many users of magic who had studied the offensive  natures of magic, found that magic of a defensive nature was just as useful. There isn't much that can stand up to sheer power of offensive magic, except perhaps magic itself. There are many spells which deflect, or help one avoid the affects of spell cast upon them. This type of spell requires a certain knowledge of magic and its protective nature. Being skilled in this knowledge can make a caster of protective magic much more capable.

cast psionic.name: cast psionic
cast psionic.description: One of the most puzzling and yet to be understood practices, is that which involves using one's mind as a tool, or even as a weapon. Few are talented with this ability, and even fewer are  able to discover and harness it. By using their thoughts, they are able to attack their enemies with merely a thought, striking them without physical force, but with devastating mental attacks. It takes much discipline and practice in order to even begin to harness the potential one has, once they discover that they possess this rare ability. It is said that most who discover their talents early on, seek out a master to instruct them in the ways.

cast rift.name: cast rift
cast rift.description: This skill lays the groundwork for all spells which manipulate cross-dimensional energies, and beings. Even the most accomplished Riftwalker does not disregard the knowledge gained from these simple, but foundation-forming abilities. The guild has a saying "Disregard the simple, and simple you shall remain".

cast runes.name: cast runes
cast runes.description: One of the oldest types of practiced magic known, is the magic of the druids, or nature magic. It is as old as nature itself, some even claim that it precedes nature, that nature is a product of it, not the other way around. Druid magic is also known as rune magic, since most of the spells are stored on runes passed down through the ages. Upon casting of a druid spell, one must trace a runic symbol in the air that corresponds to the magic spell being cast. These arts are usually passed down through families, it is said that the druids are a tight knit bunch, and it is rare for an outsider to be let into the teachings of runic magic.

cast special.name: cast special
cast special.description: Generally considered as the most mysterious and unknown types of spells, are those spells such as resurrect, raise dead, and others of that nature. The ability to supercede natural laws of life, death and reality is very complex indeed. Hence careful study must be taken in order to successfully use this type of magic. Spells of this type are so powerful and rare, that they are usually not even researched through normal means, but often given by the gods to their servants.

cast teleportation.name: cast teleportation
cast teleportation.description: Magic has many forms, one of the more useful of these forms is the type of magic that bends space and time. Travel from one place to another usually takes time and  involves many risks. Using magic to transport from one place to another is very handy. Over time, the art of of using magic to overcome the obstacles of space and time has taken many forms. Users of this type of magic are familiar with the other planes, which they use to open rifts in the very fabric of time and space.

cast transformation.name: cast transformation
cast transformation.description: This skill helps casting spells in an efficient way, a must for every spell caster. Spellcasting without this skill is very inefficient. This skill is automatically in use together with the 'cast generic' skill.

ceremony.name: ceremony
ceremony.description: Many times one can call on their god's favor to assist them in casting a spell. Certain ceremonies and rituals may be able to bring the blessings of one's god on one's  actions. Of course the gods are very fickle and their favor is not always granted. Others even say that the gods are no help at all, but that these rituals are only for the sake of mortals to ease their minds. Either way, most teachers of magic urge their apprentices not to forget that gods and that the tiny blessings that might be imparted unto them are worth the trouble to make these rituals habit before trying to cast spells.

chaotic circulation.name: chaotic circulation
chaotic circulation.description: Self-mutilation beyond recognition is only one the ways that Kharim's legionaries use to cause fear among the troops of their enemies. While it could prove to be somewhat effective, it is not the only reason why it is done. The most important reason for this is to activate a backward healing process, a difficult technique that causes circulation to speed up regeneration. The technique is commonly used before entering combat with the enemy. It is said that the legion of the Blood God can be a dreadful sight:self-mutilated brutes who seemingly refuse to perish.

chaotic defilement.name: chaotic defilement
chaotic defilement.description: Although chaos mounts are extremely powerful and come in handy when in battle, they lack some certain characteristics that more or less makes them equal with normal living mounts. To counter that imperfection the chaos priests of Tzarakk came up with this utility skill that will temporarily boost your steed to rise above the masses. Only after killing the beast, and making a mockery of its pathetic life by dispensing the remains in a place the beast spent its life avoiding, will you unveil the true power of this skill. In addition to the actual corpse you will also need some kind of sharp object that can be defined as a dagger. (This skill works only for generic outworld monsters)

chaotic spawn.name: chaotic spawn
chaotic spawn.description: True followers of chaos have been known to assume the form of an unambiguous monster. This may only be legend - however, a terrible legend about monsters with too many limbs... You can also use 'despawn' as target. Using the skill while already spawned will replenish your spawn.Despawning and respawning causes additional strain on your endurance.

charge.name: charge
charge.description: No weapon says more about the art of combat than the lance. Easily the largest and heaviest weapon made for warfare, the lance is far too unwieldy for a foot soldier to use reliably. However, if that same soldier strikes from horseback, the lance becomes extremely dangerous. The combined inertia of lance, soldier, and mount join as one to force a great deal of damage into a small area. A good hit from a charging soldier's lance can cause unbelievable wounds on just about any creature.

chest creation.name: chest creation
chest creation.description: With this skill one may create a chest to save stuff over boot from desired material and perhaps even reinforce the chest with some other material to ensure good quality. The size of chest depends on the amount of used material, refine state of material and rarity of material. The capacity of chest also depends on possible reinforcement. The material used to reinforce the chest must be more sturdy than the one used to the hull. High skill percentage is required to be able to construct the most largest high quality chests. This skill is also used to add dimensional red gems into chests to increase their capacity. The old forgers had a phrase 'You can become a good chest constructor by only making chests'use 'chest creation' submerge dimensional red gems into <chest> use 'chest creation' build <chest> hull from <material> use 'chest creation' reinforce <chest> hull with <material> use 'chest creation' complete <chest>

chest lock creation.name: chest lock creation
chest lock creation.description: With this skill an able craftsman can create a dial lock and attach it to a chest to prevent anyone just opening it. The amount of dials, combinations and type of symbols is dependant on quality, quantity and type of the chosen material. Level of skill and knowledge of metamorphosis affect every step of creation and to be able to create the best locks one must wield the highest skill. You are not simply born to be a good locksmith, it takes time, effort and patience to master the art.use 'chest lock creation' build <lock> from <material> use 'chest lock creation' complete <lock> use 'chest lock creation' attach <lock> to <chest> use 'chest lock creation' remove lock from <chest>

chest trap creation.name: chest trap creation
chest trap creation.description: To ensure the safety of one's valuables it is wise to plant some clever traps to the chest to hinder or completely prevent anyone to pick the lock too easily. With this skill one may create various traps and implement them to a chest. The quality and functionality of the trap depends greatly on quality and quantity of used material as well as the skill and knowledge of metamorphosis. The most sophisticated traps can be implemented only to the best chests.

choreography of mutilation.name: choreography of mutilation
choreography of mutilation.description: Some followers of Azzarakk have developed killing and mutilation into a chaotic form of art. While these followers are rare, the discipline is terrible to behold.

clawed strike.name: clawed strike
clawed strike.description: One of the most fearsome capabilities of the servants of chaos is the possibility to attack in a chaotic frenzy, being literally claws and teeth, against your enemies. Some say that only a servant of chaos, assuming the form of a chaotic abomination, can use this skill to its full extent.

cleave.name: cleave
cleave.description: The most inviting feature that an axe gives to its wielder, is the ability to, in one giant swing, cleave a huge chunk of  flesh from the target. Great woodsman are said to be able to fell even the mightiest tree in a few strokes. Great warriors are said to be able to fell the mightiest foe in only a single stroke.

cold tolerance.name: cold tolerance
cold tolerance.description: Barbarians have been known as the toughest fighters in all of the world. They fear nothing, and are beaten by even less. They win through endurance and attrition, and down right savageness. One of the tools that they are able to use, is the ability to block out physical pain and handicaps. Barbarians can enrage themselves enough that they are able to ignore to an extent, the effects of cold weather-or more often cold based attacks of various forms. No pain is the motto of the barbarian. Pain is definitely something their foes will feel.

combat damage analysis.name: combat damage analysis
combat damage analysis.description: For an untrained eye a raging battle may seem like a chaotic play of luck and raw strength where the fortunate and strong rend the unfortunate and weak. However, for a professional and experienced combatant the battle is an organized entity where luck plays but a minor role. These true melee warriors are able to analyze their opponents to reveal their strengths and weaknesses and use this knowledge to improve their odds in this cruel and age-old dance of violence.

combat riding.name: combat riding
combat riding.description: While riding from place to place takes little skill or effort, the same cannot be said about fighting from the saddle. While the added speed, height, and visibility can turn the tide to your advantage, they can just as quickly be neutralized by an uncontrolled mount or a badly-timed twist in the saddle. Experts among the cavalry can strike harder and remain seated after being hit. This skill also affects how frequently and how hard your mount is struck instead of you. Combat riding is essential for the use of the mounted attack skills trample and charge.

combat sense.name: combat sense
combat sense.description: Just the fact that you are wearing armour of some  type does not mean you are instantly protected from some damage. There are many different types and styles of armour, each needing their own skill in use to be effective. Platemails must be worn in order to absorb as many blows as possible. Softer armours, such as leather armour, must deflect blows, since it cannot absorb the damage that a set of platemail  can. The more skilled one is in using armour, the more  effectively he can protect himself from damage through its use.

compare.name: compare
compare.description: Anyone one who uses weapons or armour must be on constant vigil for that stronger helmet and that sharper sword. Of course, there is much skill involved in comparing such artifacts; through experience and training, one can discern many differences in the quality and other properties.

conceal spellcasting.name: conceal spellcasting
conceal spellcasting.description: This skill helps you when you cast offensive spells. Monsters may find out when you are casting offensive spell, but the better you are in this skill the better are your chances to cast spell without immediate counterattack.

conduit of the hive.name: conduit of the hive
conduit of the hive.description: Conduit of the Hive allows you to strengthen the connection between minions under the thrall of your parasites and the Hive as a whole, allowing your servants to perform their tasks better with the aid and knowledge of similar creatures who are part of the collective hivemind.

consider.name: consider
consider.description: Many an adventurer would attest that the best fight is one that leans heavily in your own favor, and everyone knows the best way to stack a fight in your own favor is to simply pick an opponent that you can handle with ease. Of course another general rule is that looks aren't everything. And while this is a good rule to follow, by looking for the right things and using a good amount of discretion and judgement, one can sometimes get a fair estimate of a potential opponent's ability. Being able to look for the right things, beyond that first glance, is an art.Notice! The consider skill compares the target, among other things, to your personal top solo kill, which will affect the outcome. You can change your top kills via 'top10' command.

contact reflexes.name: contact reflexes
contact reflexes.description: Those who practice the martial arts are taught to gain complete control over every part of their body. This not only helps them execute stunning offensive maneuvers, but also gives them the edge defensively. When any physical attack comes into contact with the body of the martial artist, he is able to  instantly shift his weight and movement, to allow a portion of the attacking energy to be deflected. This is simply a much more effective way to 'roll' with a punch.

controlled motion.name: controlled motion
controlled motion.description: This skill allows you to sometime move without aborting the concentration on a skill. It is automatically in use when you move.

controlled panic.name: controlled panic
controlled panic.description: The most stressful time any adventurer finds, is when  it is time to flee. Running can often give true meaning out of the frying pan and into the fire. Any good tactician plans ahead of time and gives himself a safe escape route. Of course, even the best of plan can be forgotten when one is in the heat of battle and on his last breath. Discipline and training can often help one remember which path is the way to safety when death is on the doorstep.Usage: wimpy dir <direction>

cooking.name: cooking
cooking.description: This skill is used for cooking. You need to use three different foodstuffs as components. You also need a campfire or a stove to do any cooking. Usage: use 'cooking' item1,item2,item3

corrosive cut.name: corrosive cut
corrosive cut.description: Through the use of this skill, a reaver can use some dark energy to fling acid from the blade (or whatever) of his corrosive weapon, splashing a single target. While the reaver can use any weapon to do this, it must be a weapon he or she is familiar with. Furthermore, it must be dripping with acid.

corrupt guidance.name: corrupt guidance
corrupt guidance.description: Every once in a while, even the most eager followers of Kharim can stray from their goals. Legionaries with a tainted faith are unreliable and weak, but determination and discipline help clear the mind of those distractions, and a silent prayer for guidance leads back onto the path which the Blood God has chosen for his minions.

craft orb.name: craft orb
craft orb.description: The flow of magic is by no means a single direction. Just as with heat, it tends to go where it is needed most, but it can be encouraged or hindered. While lifeless objects contain only a small amount of magical energy compared to a living being, they can be coaxed to hold much more, even an entire spell. Channellers use orbs for their perfect shape, and can store any spell they know well. Sadly, the strain on the orb when it releases the magic is too much for it to bear, and it will not survive when the spell is later 'invoke'd. Syntax: use craft orb at spell <spell name> into <orb or ball>

craft runestone.name: craft runestone
craft runestone.description: Runemages are known for their mysterious habit of tinkering with stones, trees and various other things that one might expect to find in the wilderness. They are then rumoured to tap the power of these resources and channel it into stones, that they have painstakingly sculpted for this very purpose.Syntax for this skill is as follows:============================================        -- to create a new stone --  use craft runestone at material <material>   -- to resume work on unfinished stone  --  use craft runestone at runestone   -- to check how much material you need  use craft runestone at amount

create armour.name: create armour
create armour.description: This skill allows the creation of various armours from a base material. The quality of the final product is dependant on the starting material, as well as users skill and other modifying skills. Syntax: use create armour at <item> from <material_type> in <workbench> For the skill to succeed, the material to be used must be contained within a workbench of the appropriate type, listed under the specific modifying skill for that material

create hunting trophy.name: create hunting trophy
create hunting trophy.description: This skill is used for creating hunting trophies from the corpses of dead animals. When displaying corpses in trophy halls, Tzarakk will give additional gifts to those who respect his power by murdering beasts in his name. As Tzarakk has personal pride over his slaves, it goes without saying that to gain respect of the hunter god, the blood of the victims must be shed alone.

create staff.name: create staff
create staff.description: This skill allows the mage to create a wizards staff from an existing staff or wand, or transfer new stats from another staff to their previously created staff. The normal stats of the item are saved in the transformation. Normal stats are the ones shown on identify. usage: use create staff at <item> [from <source>]example: Our friend Sancran is fed up with the stats of his current staff staff, Mjollnir, and has aqcuired himself a delicate rosary for that purpose. He has checked that the rosary counts as a 'wand' and is therefore suitable for this skill. Sancran now has two options, he could:  1) use create staff at delicate rosary   To create a new staff, but then he would have two staves, one with    powers he has so very hard work to gain, and one with the stats he   desires. But he wants those powers to combine in one item, which leads   to the second option:  2) use create staff at mjollnir from delicate rosary   By doing this he retains the current power of his staff, but it will   have new stats, those of the delicate rosary. The rosary will be lost   in the process.Do note another example:  This time demonstrated by tale by our friend Hurin. Hurin has a staff, that sparkles magically whenever he holds it.  When it is not held, it is only a stick.  Hurin does not identify the staff while not holding it, and thus opts to craft a magic wand out of an inert stick. Don't be like Hurin. Always identify an item before using it to create a staff.Mage's staff is a personal item and can be only used by the creator.

create vortex.name: create vortex
create vortex.description: The talent of being able to open an interdimensional vortex, essentially at will, is a very difficult one to master. With proficiency comes a greater chance of success, in no small part due to being able to get the vortex stabilized more quickly.

create weapon.name: create weapon
create weapon.description: This skill allows the creation of various weapons from a base material. The quality of the final product is dependant on the starting material, as well as users skill and other modifying skills. Syntax: use create weapon at <item> from <material_type> in <workbench> For the skill to succeed, the material to be used must be contained within a workbench of the appropriate type, listed under the specific modifying skill for that material

crimson claw.name: crimson claw
crimson claw.description: The crimson claw is a swift, piercing martial arts attack. Using the same philosophy as the dim mak, the user's fingers become powerful weapons, able to inflict great amounts of damage. Particulary well-placed hits can rupture an artery or vein and cause additional bleeding damage. Mastery of the skill 'vital points' increases the damage.

crippling shot.name: crippling shot
crippling shot.description: Hits from crossbow bolts are known for their ability to penetrate deep into muscle, or even into bone. This skill makes use of that by putting a bolt through the leg of victim. The pain of the deep leg wound, combined with the damage to muscle tissue, limits the target's ability to put weight on the damaged leg. Done correctly, the victim will have reduced power and mobility for a short time. Syntax: use crippling shot at <target> shoot <bolt>         use crippling shot at <target> Note that, if the bolt impales your victim, it is automatically destroyed.

crushing blow.name: crushing blow
crushing blow.description: Knights are more about finesse and grace in combat than raw, knock-down power. Those trained with such smashing weapons as the mace or the flail would rather score a light hit on a vulnerable spot than risk overextending themselves, leaving them open to a counterattack. This skill lets a knight use any one-handed bashing weapon to try to cave in the skull of their target. Skill with the weapon used is a must, and lighter weapons are more accurate but cause less damage. Note that some weapons work better against some creatures than others. Arms lore may help.

cull from the herd.name: cull from the herd
cull from the herd.description: Traditionally, archers are at their best when fighting a single target at long range. Getting surrounded by an irate mob and beaten to death, while trying to defend themselves with (in melee terms, at least) a bent stick, isn't in their best interest. However, most ranged weapons are silent, which can greatly help an archer make a stealthy kill. By using this skill, you observe a single member of a group of monsters and wait till it wanders away from the rest of its friends. You will have only a limited time to strike, so act quickly! True masters of this skill can time their attack to hit at the exact moment when this skill goes off...

damage criticality.name: damage criticality
damage criticality.description: One of the more recent ventures into the realm of magical studies, is the one that looks to the  forces which limit the scope of magic that is drawn into this world. One of the results of these studies is a special form of magical concentration that can sometimes allow one to cast his spells at normally unthought of levels. By tapping into the unseen planes from which all magic power is drawn from, offensive spells can be cast with awesome devastation.

dark baptism.name: dark baptism
dark baptism.description: One of the sacred rites performed by evil priests upon each  other and other servants of evil, is the rite of dark baptism. This reinforces their own pull towards evil. The person being baptized, if he is in the dark gods' favor, will receive a small portion of power. Occasionally incredible abilities will be  bestowed. If one is not favored by the dark gods, attempting a dark baptism could be very dangerous.

dark meditation.name: dark meditation
dark meditation.description: This skill allows you to regenerate faster by concentrating on your inner evil. In order to fully reach the meditative state, you must sacrifice either health, power or endurance, and thus you only get the benefits on the other two. Those who are proficient enough in the skill can just concentrate on malice to regain their standing with Draen-Dalar. Your alignment, wisdom and proficiency in dark meditation affects the outcome, as well as your environment to some degree.  You can 'stop' to end the meditation.

daunting presence.name: daunting presence
daunting presence.description: With this skill you spread fear into the ranks of the undead and evil, making them less likely to hit you. The effect itself is automatically on at all times once you turn it on. You can check how much you can train this skill with target 'check'. There is also an option to ask a ghost to add some injury to those who dare to attack you anyway. Use the skill with the ghost's name as target, or current for selected ghost to activate this mode, and use the skill with target release or release at target's name to punish them.While most consider undead as fearless warriors, the Order of Ghost Liberator Paladins knows better. Even the fiercest undead has its weaknesses, and this skill manipulates those flaws. Normally a paragon of goodness is the favourite target of all evil, but this skill creates an aura of power so great that this hate turns to fear and avoidance. Not only does this aura spread fear to the hearts and empty places where normally there is a heart of evildoers, it can actually deliver a mighty punishing blow to those who dare to attack anyway. This rare skill is only available to train in the spiritworld.Usage: use daunting presence (toggles on/off)        use daunting presence at on (forces on)        use daunting presence at check        use daunting presence at <ghost name> (activates punishment)        use daunting presence at current (use selected ghost)        use daunting presence at release (at current target in combat)        use daunting presence at release at <target>

decanting.name: decanting
decanting.description: Decanting is a process by which one potion can be diluted into two potions of  similar effect but of less strength.  Component: full potion, and empty flask  Syntax: use decanting at <full potion>

decapitate.name: decapitate
decapitate.description: A well placed slash with a good sword can usually stop most opponents in their tracks. Occasionally, and some would argue the fact that occasionally is the right word, one may confront a foe that takes a little more effort to dispatch. Those who are fully trained in their swords, can sometimes combine their skill and wits and instead of a single slash, execute a combination move, where the first slash is  immediately followed by a second maneuver, usually aimed at the target's head.

deceitful act of mercy.name: deceitful act of mercy
deceitful act of mercy.description: While a legionary of Kharim never shows mercy to the enemy, it is possible that someone would believe they might. The enemy who is surrounded and running out of choices is desperate to cling on any lifeline that is offered regardless of how improbably it might sound. On the other hand, the enemy who realizes that the life is coming to an end always fights more fiercely than anyone else. For the same reason, legionaries of Kharim sometimes mislead their enemy into believing that their surrendering might ultimately save their lives, before they choose to slay those who wallow in despair.

decimate.name: decimate
decimate.description: An axe is a lopsided, end-heavy weapon, and difficult to use from the back of a moving mount in combat. However, with this same issue comes leverage and momentum, two things that make a successful axe strike all the more deadly. With careful balance and coordination, the flying wedge of an axe blade can be made much more effective with the added speed and height of striking from horseback.

defence sense.name: defence sense
defence sense.description: The martial artist is taught early on in his training to be completely aware of his environment. This includes the  battlefield. By being aware of the events around him during  a battle, he is able to predict actions of his opponents. This allows him to avoid attacks with ease, since he really doesn't have to think about it, it is just his instincts kicking in and taking over.

defiance.name: defiance
defiance.description: A knight knows that fleeing from a fight is the mark of a coward, and that deserting one's comrades in battle is an even worse offense. It is when they are badly injured, nearing death's door, that the strength of their resolve is called into question. Should a knight choose to withstand the assault and continue the fight, they may focus their determination into an overall improvement in combat performance. This skill is automatically in effect.

deflect blows.name: deflect blows
deflect blows.description: Before more complex maneuvers may be learned, it is important to know the basics. In the case of legionaries, it usually means long days of shield combat training or simply known as 'manner of lordliness'. When the manner of lordliness is mastered, more difficult maneuvers may be performed. One of those more challenging maneuvers is deflecting blows. Legionaries of Kharim use shield both to attack and to defend. Shields are often balanced so that they are designed for deflecting away weapons. Skilled deflection would leave the attacker open for a quick counter-attack and that is what legionaries of Kharim try to take advantage of. Deflect blows is a derivative technique of parry which means that proficiency in parry will also help when deflecting blows.

desecrate ground.name: desecrate ground
desecrate ground.description: True followers of evil generally stoop beyond the limits of generally accepted behavior and tread deep into the sacreligious. A common practice among these vile beings, is to not stop with the defeat of their foe, but to relish in it. This usually involves desecrating the lifeless corpse of their foe. While most give the  dead their respects, those who are truly sinister see only an opportunity for enjoyment. They revel in their rituals and can actually be rewarded from it if they have given their hearts to it completely. Those around them may also be pulled into the fray and join in the revelry.

destructive rage.name: destructive rage
destructive rage.description: The highest ranks of the Lords of Chaos have long been able to focus their rage and hatred, leaving in their wake a trail of destruction of both good and evil creatures.  In this pseudo-subconscious state these fearsome warriors become almost super-human, and can shrug off attacks that would have felled giants three times their size.

detect trap.name: detect trap
detect trap.description: Sometimes harmful traps and hidden snares are surreptiously placed in a normal looking box, a door or any other place where they are the least expected. With this skill you can detect these traps in time to avoid  their nasty effects.

dirty fighting.name: dirty fighting
dirty fighting.description: This skill allows you to beat your enemy into submission using street fighting skills and otherwise very dirty tricks.Knowledge of kicking, pummeling and overbearing is useful when applying this skill.

disabling shot.name: disabling shot
disabling shot.description: Most arrows are designed to burrow a certain distance into the flesh of their target. This opens a gaping wound, but if part of the arrow should also break off in the victim, it can lead to great pain as well. This skill attemps to lodge all, or at least part, of an arrow in an attack limb of the victim. Besides the usual damage, it might lower the victim's number of attacks for a short time. Syntax: use disabling shot at <target> shoot <arrow>         use disabling shot at <target> Since the arrows used for this skill are supposed to break off in the wound, they do not survive the use of this skill.

discipline.name: discipline
discipline.description: Discipline is one of the most important traits a  warrior must possess. With discipline he is able to block out pain. Even when one is hit incredibly hard, he is  able to continue whatever maneuver he was executing before being hit. Hits that make most stop in their tracks and recollect their thoughts, are simply shrugged off by those who have this ability.

dismount.name: dismount
dismount.description: For centuries the heavily armoured cavalry has been the ultimate meat grinder of the battlefields. However, if the warrior got dismounted they were pretty much doomed. The armour was so heavy they couldn't even get up on their feet but had to wait on their back like a tortoise for the enemy to approach with a tin opener and drain their life away.

dissection.name: dissection
dissection.description: This skill allows you to dissect a corpse and extract potentially two  bodyparts.  Component: knife and corpse  Syntax: use dissection at corpse try <organ1> <organ2>

distillation.name: distillation
distillation.description: This skill allows alchemist to perform distillation on a distillery for raw essences. Distilling essences requires a lot of patience and work and can be straining for both physical and mental capacities.Usage: use 'distillation' amount <grams> in <bench>        use 'distillation' amount all in <bench>

dodge.name: dodge
dodge.description: The easiest way not to die from damage taken in a fight, is to not get hit in the first place. Avoiding blows is the best way to stay in a fight longer. By anticipating an attack, a warrior can move oneself out of the way, avoiding the hit. Those who are skilled at dodging hits, can easily take on much greater odds then those who can only get into a slugging match with their foe. Of course, the lighter one is encumbered, the better they are able to dodge, and the more encumbered they are, the more hindered they are at dodging attacks.

double mine.name: double mine
double mine.description: He who is proficient in this art may enter into the groove while mining and really go to town.

draconic tail.name: draconic tail
draconic tail.description: The tail attack of attack of a draconian can be only fully effective with proper training and in combat. With training and combat experience the tail becomes harder and the scales thicker, making it even more painful for their opponents.

dragon tail sweep.name: dragon tail sweep
dragon tail sweep.description: While usually believed to fight unarmed, there is one weapon a martial artist often employs -- the ground. Knocking a victim down forcefully can cause a greater impact falling than the force of the blow alone could obtain alone. Using this skill, you kick your enemies' legs out from beneath them, and then gravity does the rest.
