Since the sweep itself requires only minimal contact on a relatively lightweight part of the body, it is quite possible for the attack to follow through and hit more than one victim at once.

dreary hibernation.name: dreary hibernation
dreary hibernation.description: The acolyte falls to his knees while rotting roots entangle and twist around him, obstructing them from view. The cocoon protects the servants of Nergal while they gain introspective on the world, while simultaneously the twisted, supernatural roots feed them the energy from whatever rots under Nergals reach at the time.

dripping fangs.name: dripping fangs
dripping fangs.description: The worshippers of Kharim believe in the beauty of combat, in all its cruel savagery. They can get lost in the bloodlust of battle and the thrill of the kill. Many beasts have similar dark feelings trapped inside of their primal skulls. If a beastmaster is a Kharim follower, this skill lets them convert some of their mount's physical damage to unholy damage, which rends through armour and physical resistances like tissue paper. This mastery skill affects both guided strike and feral attack.

earthquake kick.name: earthquake kick
earthquake kick.description: Most warriors have a hard time deciding between hitting once hard, or hitting twice quickly. This maneuver makes that choice irrelevant. By kicking your foe just above their center of mass with just the right timing, you can force them to shudder back and forth, causing them to effectively lean into your attack, increasing the effect! Furthermore, targets hard on the outside but soft on the inside (such as armoured foes) are battered against the inside of their own defenses.

elder cobra kick.name: elder cobra kick
elder cobra kick.description: Some legends say that serpents never die, they merely grow wiser and more cunning as they age. With no arms or legs to use, they truly need to be careful with their prey -- as is the cobra, which strikes at the back of its victim's neck. So, too, does this skill. By flipping forwards and using careful timing, you can use the hard heel of your foot to whip around, like a striking snake, with as much speed and power as you can. Done correctly, your foe will not only be injured, but hopefully unable to counter this acrobatic move by striking back.

elite guard.name: elite guard
elite guard.description: A knight's study into strategy tells them almost immediately that a leader must defend a group's weaker, softer members. However, just standing between the enemy and those you wish to protect is rarely enough. Many creatures and most people have some kind of ranged attack, usually a spell, to strike at distant targets. Knights study this skill to look for the warning signs of ranged attacks against a specific member in his party, and attempt to intercept them, blocking them with his own body. Not every spell can be intercepted. Area spells and touch spells, for example, cannot be blocked, nor can most curses. However, most single-target attack spells can be blocked. Training in both leadership and rescue is crucial for this skill to work.Syntax: use elite guard at <party member>         use elite guard [ to stop ]

embalming.name: embalming
embalming.description: When the earliest of mummies were ever created, the priests noticed that the dehydration and the removal of organs was not enough to preserve the body for longer periods of time. Thus began the experimenting with different chemicals to find a solution to keep the mummy preserved. Today the priests use a specific brand of ashenberry oil to improve the longevity of the mummies at their disposal.

embrace the gifts.name: embrace the gifts
embrace the gifts.description: By embracing the myriad gifts Nergal bestows upon its followers the acolytes form begins to twist in unnatural ways as the mutations he has evolved become more prominent for a time. The acolyte may also use this to share the gifts, among the enthralled sharing his blood. Enthralled are capable of transferring the gifts through their nails into other living beings as especially festive maladies. Usage: use 'embrace the gifts' start aura <disease>        use 'embrace the gifts' start mutation <mutation>        use 'embrace the gifts' list mutations        use 'embrace the gifts' list auras        use 'embrace the gifts' list races

enchanted wings.name: enchanted wings
enchanted wings.description: Being weak in physical warfare the sprites started applying magic to their benefit. The enchantments cast on their wings make them sharp as steel.

endurance.name: endurance
endurance.description: In the simplest words possible, the last one standing is the winner of the battle. In order to be the last one standing, one must be able to sustain a level of physical activity in order to outlast his foe. Through rigorous exercise and training, one can condition one's self in order to be able to sustain his fighting level longer. Fatigue, not your enemy's blade can be the killer on a battlefield, because when fatigue is near, you can bet that blade is right behind it.

enhance criticals.name: enhance criticals
enhance criticals.description: While every warrior always attempts to hit his opponent in a way to cause the most damage, every now and then, one is able to defy even his own limitations and strike extremely hard, sometimes many times harder then normal. A very difficult art to master, is the ability to increase these number of critical hits, and their magnitude. A critical hit can many times save the day against a seemingly unbeatable foe.

enhanced peer.name: enhanced peer
enhanced peer.description: One skill taught to all rangers by their mentors, is how to scout an area. This allows them to peer into nearby areas and sense what foes wait there. Knowing their surroundings is one of the key traits rangers thrive on. This is one of the abilities rangers possess that make them excellent advanced scouts for armies, especially in heavily wooded areas, where they can make use of their other abilities to remain undetected. Peering outside our environment takes ALMOST no endurance. When trying to glean extra information, some strain is placed on your neck vertebra, however, so some endurance is needed in order to perform.

enrage.name: enrage
enrage.description: Enrage is a barbaric ceremonial dance which includes muscle flexing and other macho things alike and inspires other barbarians to be much more fierce in combat. The bigger the barbarian horde, the more enraged the horde will be. The reputation of the enrager allows the enrage to exceed normal boundaries.

entity control.name: entity control
entity control.description: A skilled riftwalker must know how to control his entity, and this skill will assist him/her in a variety of spells. Amongst other things, this skill will help a riftwalker to sense if a spell effect drops from his entity.

essence eye.name: essence eye
essence eye.description: The essence eye skill provides a graphical feedback of the spell you are currently casting.  It will display  the number of rounds left until the spell is casting is done.  The higher your percent in essence eye the  more often the output is updated.  Example of essence eye output:Money is power: ############In this case, money is power is the spell you are  currently casting, and it will be complete in 12 rounds.  Each '#' is 1 round.

evaluate mount.name: evaluate mount
evaluate mount.description: The selection of a horse or other steed is a difficult process, and there are many factors to consider. Is it healthy? Is it strong? Does he respond well to training? A good mount can be your friend for life, while a bad one could end yours prematurely. As you gain prowess in this skill, you learn more and more of the factors worth considering, and the visible signals of those factors, not just for horses but for any potentially ridable beast.

evil intent.name: evil intent
evil intent.description: Those who follow the dark path of Burglefloogah, know that it is in their best interest to appease the evil gods. They must show their loyalty and allegience to evil. This can be done in  many ways, the simplest being the sacrifice of material possessions. By executing a dark rite, they are able to give an item to their gods. The power inbedded deep within the item is given to the gods, with a small portion give back to the priest as his reward. Many priests choose to sacrifice items that don't belong to them, and thats fine, since the gods don't give a damn where they get their sacrifices from, just as long as they get them!

evil unveiled.name: evil unveiled
evil unveiled.description: With the help of this skill, you can detect evil in nearby rooms. This skill is automatically in effect when peering around. Knowledge of the spell 'detect alignment' is required for this skill to function.It is always good to know when to prepare for a fight (or flight). That is when this skill comes into play. By peering around, you can estimate the flow of evil from each direction. This information can be interpreted to form an assessment of evil around you. The order of ghost liberator paladins was the first organization to learn this technique. It was taught to Samuel de Montfort by an elusive ghost in the spiritworld and he put it in the teaching program of the guild. The ghost is said to still haunt the spiritworld, avoiding the dangers with its ultimate knowledge of this skill.Usage: peer <direction>

exchange money.name: exchange money
exchange money.description: Physical wealth can be not only hard to accumulate, but also can become hard to handle. Riches in small currencies, gold or lower, are very difficult to handle. Large chests of gold are very cumbersome to move. Fortunately there are metals which are more valuable then gold,  and there are people who are more then happy to take their cut to exchange it. It's not completely understood where they take the coins and exchange them, but they get it done, and their results in platinum, mithril and the like, are accepted at face value throughout the realms.The following are the best types of coins you can come up with at any,  depending on your skill%  5% - zinc  10% - tin  20% - copper  25% - bronze  40% - silver  50% - gold  70% - platinum  80% - anipium  90% - batium  95% - mithril

exorcize.name: exorcize
exorcize.description: Exorcizing has become important part of nuns daily work. With this skill nuns may drive out the evil from any living creature, purifying their soul in order to get more closer to Las. Exorcizing is very demanding and requires a fair amount of patience and self-discipline. A relic is also required. Demons of the soul are very unpredictable and the exorcized may start acting violently as soul fiends use their host to protect them. Exorcizing may be very painful and some have even died during the exorcism. Purity of excorzicer's heart and good alignment increase the effect of the process.

expose weakness.name: expose weakness
expose weakness.description: Allows you to expose the skin of your opponent, thus making him more vulnerable to physical damage. This is a delicate skill, and a single use will not harm the opponent much. By using it repeatedly you can make even the strongest opponents ready to beg for mercy. This effect is more noticeable for those who participated in the exposing of the opponent. Note: This skill can't be used with a blunt weapon.

extract ether.name: extract ether
extract ether.description: Using this skill on corpses while having a sharp knife out and ready for work, have a chance for alchemists to extract the very life essence of the creature. This so called quintessence can then be further refined by master alchemists for more practical form of usage. Having the skill also increases chance of essence dropping from monsters upon their demise. Proficient alchemist can try to extract essences belonging to certain category by focusing on a distinct tint of that category. This however has increased chance of failing since focusing and searching leaves very little room for error. Syntax: use 'extract ether' corpse focus on <color>         use 'extract ether' corpse

eye of loraen.name: eye of loraen
eye of loraen.description: This skill allows you to choose how tuned you are with the wilderness. When you become one with nature, you can sense its lush offerings from far away. This heightened state of awareness may cause fatigue. Usage: use 'eye of loraen'                      : turn skill on/off, seeing all plants and ores        use 'eye of loraen' <ore/plant>          : turn skill on, seeing either ores or plants        use 'eye of loraen' <ore/plant> <type>   : turn skill on, seeing only a specific ore or plant        -- skilled users can add more than one target        use 'eye of loraen' remove <type>        : takes <type> off your list        use 'eye of loraen' alert <on/off/visual>: beeps or visual alert when something is spotted        use 'eye of loraen' setting colour:<colour> brightness:<1 to 10>        Changes the colour of anything spotted with this skill.

falcon talon strike.name: falcon talon strike
falcon talon strike.description: The falcon strikes with its hooked talons, swooping from above. It times its dive to hit its prey unaware and defenseless, and to get away without being caught in return. This skill follows that example. With careful timing, the user pushes off the victim and flips overhead. While the force of the push alone can be damaging, the user also attemps to use the force and speed of the spin to drive his own fingers, like claws, into the enemy. Done correctly, the user will also land and tumble safely out of harm's way.

falling boulder strike.name: falling boulder strike
falling boulder strike.description: By harnessing your inner strength and concentration, you can bring your elbow down like a pickaxe, combining both your own raw strength with the force of gravity. Doing so without special training hurts, but doing so with this skill's teachings lets you turn an enemy's own density against them. Armoured targets, which are heavy on the outside but weaker inside, are especially vulnerable to this attack.

feigned remorse.name: feigned remorse
feigned remorse.description: Physical weakness easily turns into decisive factor between dueling combatants, but it is equally important to be emotionally prepared for war. The soldiers who show mercy to the enemy may be revered by their beneficial gods, but not by their commanders. Honourable traits, such as compassion and forgiveness, are traits that belong to a priest rather than a warrior. Inability to withstand emotional pressure is as crucial weakness as is inability to wield a sword. Those who make the mistake of trusting the enemy regardless of how sincere their intentions might seem are always putting their own life on the line. And those who know how to feign remorse often take advantage of it - with deadly consequences.

feral attack.name: feral attack
feral attack.description: Many animal trainers begin their career teaching animals how to perform simple tricks. This skill is an extension of that idea. While not actually riding a mount, but leading it instead, you can send it forward to attack, using one of its own attack abilities. You must wield a whip or a poker to use this skill. Also, the speed and accuracy depend both on you and the mount in question.

find campsite.name: find campsite
find campsite.description: When a ranger needs a safe place to stop and rest for a while, they look for a campsite. While not as comfortable as an inn, it is free lodging with little to no chance of being disturbed. Using this skill, you find a private spot for yourself and any party members you might have to store their gear and their location until they log in again. Higher skill lets you find shelter more easily, as well as find a campsite for a larger party. Making a campsite for one or two people does not require special help. For larger parties, you will need some of the following: -- a campfire  -- three pieces of cooked food  -- a tree  -- water adjacent (but not in the room itself)  -- a tent (especially helpful)

find weakness.name: find weakness
find weakness.description: A true warrior is able not only to make the best of his strengths in battle, but is also able to notice when his enemy makes mistakes, which can be taken advantage of. Many times, when an opponent misses, he may be off-balance for just a split second. A cunning warrior can use this to his advantage, and land a particulary hard blow while his opponent is helpless to stop it. In addition to this, one can also spot vulnerable spots in his opponents armour, which can allow him to hit where it really hurts.

fire building.name: fire building
fire building.description: When one is outdoors, many times the only thing he can call home, is his  campfire. There are few things more relaxing and satisfying than sitting  in front of a roaring fire, telling tales. Of course, one needs to be  able to start the fire in the first place, and keep it burning bright.  Key ingredients include selection of wood, quality of kindling, and the  fuel once the fire is started. There are many tricks of the trade that  help fires burn faster and better as well. Fires, besides facilitating  rest, are also useful to cook items. A cooked animal caught in the  wilderness is much tastier and nourishing then one eaten raw. As the fire starts to die out it is possible to 'refuel' it.

fire walking.name: fire walking
fire walking.description: One of the first tests that any barbarian must prove in his ritual to ascend rank in his clan, is the ability to walk through fire. This proves that he is strong physically and mentally in order to endure the challenges that he must face to uphold the survival of the clan. This not only proves as a testing ground, but also as a tool to be utilized later  in his journeys should he come across the deadly power of fire.

first aid.name: first aid
first aid.description: There are times when someone might just pass the their physical limits. Anyone incapacitated usually is  on the brink of death. By applying various medicinal techniques, conciousness of the target can be regained. This skill can also be used with bandages to bind some  wounds, if the target has minimal armour, in order to give access to the wounds.

fishing.name: fishing
fishing.description: Wherever rivers and lakes exist, an abundant source of food exists also. These bodies of water are invariably teeming with fish and other aquatic life, all who sit nicely below most of us on the food chain. Of course, it is very difficult to go in and try to grab some of them by hand (admit it, we've all tried.) In order to catch these tasty morsels, one must apply certain tactics, honed over the years into an art form. Using nets, spears, and even hooks with bait on them are many of the ways one can catch fish and other water creatures. Luck, of course, can play a role in the process, but even more so does skill. Having  a proper fishing rod will also yield better results than trying to forage your environment for sticks and bark for the purpose.

flanking attack.name: flanking attack
flanking attack.description: In general, a riding warrior is capable of faster movement than one on the ground. Even with heavy armour and weapons, they can move in and out of their pedestrian opponents, striking and evading at will. This skill aids the control a mounted combatant has over their mount, allowing for tighter turns and quicker escapes. In practice, it allows an experienced user to strike at opponents in the rear protected ranks of a group. Higher skill allows more targets to be attacked, but it should be noted that small parties defend themselves better against this sort of attack than larger ones. This skill also enables a rider to strike from further back in the party, assuming they are along one side of the party and not trapped in the center.

flow of magic.name: flow of magic
flow of magic.description: When channelers cast a spell, they need the energy _now_ and don't have the luxury of deciding where it comes from. Energy is pulled from their own bodies to fuel the incantation and later release of magical energy, which, over time, can wear the caster out. By becoming more skilled with such spells they can endure the strain of this energy reduction for a longer period of time before giving out.

forceful blow.name: forceful blow
forceful blow.description: Superior in many ways to crushing blow, a knight can use this skill to take a second or two longer to line up a solid hit on a known weak spot. This has multiple benefits. One is that the overall damage is increased. Another is that a special weapon, one the target is vulnerable to, is not required. Most importantly, a hit delivered at the right time can distract the target with the force of the blow, disrupting its concentration.

forest location.name: forest location
forest location.description: Rangers are skilled at using various navigation aids to get from place to place in the wilderness. This is why rangers never seem to get lost, and always know where they are headed. It is said some rangers can even give directions to other people in the wilderness.Usage: use forest location at <location_desc>        use forest location at player <player_name>

foul play.name: foul play
foul play.description: The knights and templars act in war, guided by moral codes and codes of honour. To Kharim, there is no honour in defeat as only the strongest will survive and retain one's honour. When only victory is important, it is necessary to use all devious tricks and ways that are available. While legionaries of Kharim often rely on their swords, they also take advantage of opportunity when it comes on their way. The example uses of foul play may mean brutal tricks of drowning enemy under water or whacking one's head with a chair. Legionary of Kharim is always prepared for battle. The act of foul play is related to brawling, which means that adeptness in brawling may come useful when engaging in foul measures.

frenzy.name: frenzy
frenzy.description: A true warrior is prepared to take a leave from his sanity, so that he can go into a devastating battle frenzy. While in such a frenzy you summon all of your unused strength and dexterity allowing you to hit harder than ever before in combat and perceptively find your foe with the blow of you weapon. Extreme aggression rules while in a frenzy, and you will attack anyone within your sight. You may try to break your frenzy (SYNTAX: 'break frenzy'), but it requires extreme discipline from the frenzied warrior.

fresh pants.name: fresh pants
fresh pants.description: Many, particularly those who live off the land waste nothing, not even the bodies of their kills. Many creatures hides are  very useful in making different clothing and other items.  Most who take the time to skin and fresh pants their corpses, carry with them the proper tools. While fieldcraft may not give as fine looking results as a blacksmith, many masters of this art come very close. Usage: use fresh pants at corpse

gem cutting.name: gem cutting
gem cutting.description: Jewels and precious gems have always been one of the most sought after types of wealth. Not only are they valuable because of their looks, finding high quality gems is very rare, because working them into their finished shape is a very difficult art to learn. Knowing how to work and cut gems takes a lifetime to learn. More times then not, ore is flawed during workmanship, drastically reducing the value of the finished item. A master gem cutter can take even flawed ore and stone, and turn them into master pieces. Exceptional use of this skill requires both a steady hand and a keen eye for details.

geyser force kick.name: geyser force kick
geyser force kick.description: While some martial arts moves are regarded as needlessly flashy, this is not one of them. Done correctly, the user seems to run up the chest of the victim, kicking off and flipping backwards. However, the impact of both feet on the chest cavity, kicking with enough force to leap backwards, will not only damage the torso, but can knock the wind out of the victim as well. This causes heavy damage while possibly disrupting their ability to focus.

ghost affinity.name: ghost affinity
ghost affinity.description: This skill allows you to handle more ghosts. Basically this means you are privileged to know the customs of the ghosts and the borders not to cross. It also helps you to organize the ghosts in hierarchial way, giving them sense of self-control. The skill is automatically in effect.The research on this skill was started by Samuel de Montfort, and mastered by one of his humble followers. The legend has that part of this mastering process rendered the follower into a nameless ghost, but with her research left, it was easy to limit the amount of affinity allowed to the members of the guild. The name of the follower might still be found in the guild library, but when consulted in a seance, she wanted to stay anonymous. Her wish is to be treated with utmost respect - the ghost world accepted her as one of their own, and breaking this wish might result in uprising.

ghost army assault.name: ghost army assault
ghost army assault.description: This skill temporarily releases all your ghosts to assault all the evil targets in the room. Your partymembers are safe, though. After the assault, the commanding ghost gathers all the ghosts and returns the control to you. This maneuver is very draining for the commanding ghost.This attack is very close to necromancy, and thus it is hated by nuns. Despite the fact that it only harms evil creatures, nuns view this sudden release of ghosts to harm people very evil. This has never let the 'necropaladins', as nuns call the order of ghost liberator paladins, from using this very efficient technique. It is always a glorious sight to see a horde of skeletons ripped from bone to bone apart by ghost forces. The attack was first used by none other than the founding father of the order, Samuel de Montfort, during his last crusades before his untimely departure.Usage: use ghost army assault

ghost channeling.name: ghost channeling
ghost channeling.description: With this skill you can channel the ability of a ghost through your body. Only the wise and likable people can wrest out the most of this ability. Channeling ghosts has its risks, as any starting necromancer soon finds out, but these risks are minimal for ghost liberators, since the ghosts usually are willing to help.This is it, the foundation of ghost liberators. Samuel de Montfort started as a ghost channeler, performing at parties and fairs, until he channeled a powerful paladin through him. The experience was life-changing. The ghost paladin led de Montfort to his dead body, and sure enough, his blade and armour were still intact. Gone was the easy life of a charlatan, and the days of ghost liberators had begun. It is not sure how much of the ghost liberation movement is the invention of de Montfort, and how much of it was ghost possession, but since ghost liberation is more about the ends than the means, who cares?Usage: use ghost channeling        use ghost channeling at <suitable target for the power>

ghost slash.name: ghost slash
ghost slash.description: Ghost slash is the primary offensive skill of ghost liberators. The slash is a combination of hits, some mundane and some magical, but all the damage originates from the blade used, so choosing your weapon to suit your opponent is wise. This technique uses other lesser techniques taught by the guild as its base, so all-round training is required to take full advantage of this skill. Since part of the attack is to channel a ghost to smite your enemy, the skill works better against evil targets, but the mundane part of the combination deals damage even to good people - at the cost of angering the ghost.The skill was created by the original ghost liberator, Samuel de Montfort, with the help of ghost of a warrior chief, a direct descendant of the once noble northern warriors, Markus Morgansson. Together they combined the savage assault of northern warriors with the ghost channeling de Montfort had a little earlier mastered. The skill lacks style, but is crudely effective. Other holy warriors scorned de Montfort for using cheap tricks and unfair kicking, but the skill stayed in the repertoire of ghost liberators.Usage: use 'ghost slash' <monster>

giant step.name: giant step
giant step.description: Despite being a bit on the stupid side, giants once ruled the realms. Their culture was rich and their magic strong. But a lot has changed since then, during the centuries and millenia. Whether it was because of a cataclysm, war or famine, the giants today are a minority.One aspect, recently found by a young giant, of the ancient times is the ability to take a 'giant step'. The process begins by doing the ritualistic stomp, thus calling the element of the giant. For the unskilled one this might take several tries, but when successful, the giant enters the giant realms, located deep underground or high above the mortal realm.In the realms, travel is swift and often effortless, unless the giant wants to push his limits. How deep in the realms you can go depends on your skill.Usage: use giant step

glassblowing.name: glassblowing
glassblowing.description: This skill is automatically used to improve your ability when you use craft and construction skills that work with glass like materials.

gloveknock.name: gloveknock
gloveknock.description: A special technique where your fist accelerates quickly, driven by your muscles and the rotation of your body, and hits your adversary on the face. For optimal performance it is recommended that you wear gloves... and as is obvious, the material the glove is made of might have some relation with your adversary's level of suffering.

grapple.name: grapple
grapple.description: The most common instinct an individual defeated in battle, is to flee, to live again to fight another day. Of course, if you hold the upper edge in a fight, escape is the last thing you would want your foe to do. By carefully using special techniques, one can hinder an opponent's attempts to flee the field of battle. In order to execute this maneuver, one must allocate 100% of his effort. This means he cannot attack, or attempt to use spells or skills.

guided strike.name: guided strike
guided strike.description: Perhaps the ultimate skill of the beastmasters, this allows them to let their mount do some of the attacking for them. Many animals and monsters have far more dangerous natural weapons than even the most trained of warriors, and can use them instinctively just as effectively as the best-trained of fighters. The beastmaster merely points his or her mount at the intended victim, and lets nature run its course. You must wield a whip or a poker to use this skill. Also, the speed and accuracy depend both on you and the mount in question.

gutblade.name: gutblade
gutblade.description: An alchemists' knowledge of the vital organs of most living creatures can be a useful tool or a dangerous weapon. When wielding a small, light blade, such as a knife or scalpel, an alchemist can use this skill to try to injure -- but not destroy -- the vital organs of an enemy. If successful, the blade will cause severe pain and damage, otherwise a much less effective flesh wound results. Dexterity improves the chance of hitting the target, intelligence aids in hitting a vital organ, and dissection skill helps both. Note that not all creatures have vital organs or need them to survive.

harvest soul.name: harvest soul
harvest soul.description: The chaotic steeds are very powerful mounts but they lack one vital characteristic: the ability to heal. For aeons this has been an accepted fact nobody dared to challenge. Until now. The slaves of the beastmaster have long been working on a way to replenish their battle-beaten steeds with a fraction of their foe's vitality. After years of trial and horrible mistakes they've finally found a way to do it and have shared the secret with a few selected allies.

hear noises.name: hear noises
hear noises.description: Druids are always at one with nature and with their surroundings. This fine intertwinement with their environment allows them to be able to simply listen and from the noise or silence they hear, deduct some information, such as the presence of another being. Half magical and half physical, this ability is uncanny. Legends say that the druids can hear a man long before a dog can smell it.

heel.name: heel
heel.description: This two-stage skill is used by animal trainers who want their pets to come to them. It comes in handy if you are seperated from a beast of burden, for as long as they can hear you, they will respond to your whistle and arrive. To start this skill, try:use heel at <tamed animal in the room> This will give you a special ID which you use in the second part of the skill, which is:use heel at <animal ID> Note that the animal still has to travel the distance from you to it, and may arrive tired or hungry. Also note that the sound of your whistle works better outdoors. You have to use this skill again every reboot and every time the animal is stabled.

herding.name: herding
herding.description: Experienced farmers, ranchers, and horse trainers know the value of being able to move more than one animal at the same time. Keeping a pack of animals together gives the animals a kind of group mentality, which keeps them all on the path. In addition, groups of animals are less vulnerable to predators, which makes them feel safer. With this skill, you can lead more than the normal amount of one mount. A master of this skill can even lead animals while riding!

hiding.name: hiding
hiding.description: With this skill you can hide yourself from other peoples' eyes. You can examine them from your hideout, but doing anything else will break your cover, and you will be noticed. This skill is very useful with backstab. You can surprise your enemies. The affecting stats are your dexterity and size.

hiking.name: hiking
hiking.description: One constant attribute of the wilderness that cannot be avoided, is its vast size. Travelling through the wilderness means travelling without the benefit of roads and even ground. Those skilled at moving well in the wilderness can easily outdistance those who are not, with no effort at all. Knowing how to move swiftly takes much discipline and skill. Also,  there are tried and true methods on how to wear your load for minimum wear on the body.

holy blaze.name: holy blaze
holy blaze.description: A holy warrior can focus divine energy through his or her blessed shield, turning it into a kind of spiritual beacon. The pure, powerful light that shines forth will burn all those who see it, friend or foe, who have evil lurking within. If the shield is not just blessed, but enchanted as well, the light it shines can distract or even blind the most evil of foes. Knowledge of the skill holy smite is required for the use of this skill.

holy seance.name: holy seance
holy seance.description: This skill has multiple uses: you can use it with the target 'enter spiritworld' to enter the spirit realm, target it at a monster to check if it is enslaving ghosts or target it at a ghost lily to remember a fallen innocent. A ghost is required to enter the spiritworld, to act as a guide. The more powerful the guide, the deeper you will find yourself in the realm of ghosts, and the benefits of the realm are greater. Checking monsters is easier than entering the realms, and thus less time-consuming. Also, you don't need a ghost to check a monster.The spiritworld is a dangerous place, but it offers great power to those who master its secrets. The inhabitants of the realm are many, and most of them are hostile. Some, on the other hand, are beneficent, and it is said that some (others say most) secrets of the order of ghost liberator paladins were brought back from the spiritworld by Samuel de Montfort and those who follow his footsteps. In the spiritworld you can seek guidance or try to get a task from one of the inhabitants.While some of the order see using this skill to check a monster as an act of greed, all approve the general training of this skill, for its use as the key to the spiritworld. It is also a common topic to debate if greed is such a bad thing - you are liberating ghosts after all, and sometimes knowing how to liberate the most with the least effort can be very useful.Usage: use holy seance at <monster>        use holy seance at enter spiritworld        use holy seance at lily

holy smite.name: holy smite
holy smite.description: Many holy warriors have heard the heartening sizzle of their weapon striking the flesh or bone of an evil adversary. This skill attempts to maximize that effect. When landing a solid blow, divine forces cause holy light to spring from the impact, burning evil targets with its power. Only blessed weapons can make use of this power. This skill is automatically in effect.

holy strike.name: holy strike
holy strike.description: Even though just hitting someone with a weapon is quite effective a templar with the right conviction can summon all his strength, all his dexterity and all his faith to unleash an even more powerful blow than any normal warrior could. In order for a templar to be able to use all this energy and actually be able to focus it and put it to use he needs to know that doing it is a good deed. He also needs to be wielding a weapon that is capable of channeling holy energy.

holy warfare.name: holy warfare
holy warfare.description: Mastering the art of holy warfare is not an easy task, but for a true Templar it is, nevertheless, a necessity in order to be victorious on the battlefield defending the weak and slaying the forces of evil.

hop back.name: hop back
hop back.description: The bane of every archer is hand-to-hand combat. Bows and crossbows make lousy clubs, and firing an arrow or bolt point-blank is damn near impossible. Worse, at such close range, his enemies can pound or cleave him to death before he can get away. This skill helps with both issues at once. While it can't help with most melee attacks, it can help with the use of skills in combat, both offensively and defensively. Using quick reflexes and cautious timing, you can use your skills as if you were one party row further back -- allowing you to fire a crossbow in hand-to-hand combat, for example. It also works defensively, letting you avoid close-range attack skills by jumping back just before the skill goes off. Using this skill turns it on or off. Default is 'off'. Or, you can 'use hop back at enable' vs. 'use hop back at disable'

hunters moon.name: hunters moon
hunters moon.description: The second full moon of the autumn is often called the Hunter's Moon. Its light in the night sky is said to guide the spears and arrows of those seeking to feed their family before winter. A trained outdoorsman can call upon this same guiding light to curse a single target at a time, increasing physical damage taken. This curse lasts indefinitely, but can only be used on one victim at a time.

hunting.name: hunting
hunting.description: While roots and berries are capable of sustaining any individual for a long time, its no real replacement for those who lust after the taste of flesh. The wilderness is inhabited by many creatures, whose flesh is very edible. Catching these creatures is a challenge indeed however. The best way to catch these types of creatures is to trap them. Most of the time they are fleet of foot and cannot be simply caught and killed with  a sword. Simple rope traps, and other means allow one to catch his prey, easily and cleanly. A skilled hunter can live forever on his own. Of course once the prey is caught preparing it is another task, maybe if you could cook it over an open fire...

hydra fang strike.name: hydra fang strike
hydra fang strike.description: Too often, the martial artist finds himself at a disadvantage when fighting multiple enemies at the same time. Most attacks take so much precision that striking at more than one opponent at once is next to impossible. This maneuver attempts to bypass this. By striking with hands folded to give the knuckles a knife-like edge, you can strike at a somewhat accessible target -- the flesh between the ribs. This in turn allows you to strike quickly without sacrificing much power.

immunology.name: immunology
immunology.description: Immunology shows your expertise in everything related to spreading, containing and modifying diseases. True masters of the craft are able to modify their diseases to hasten the incubation period and strengthen the effects, making the victims suffering all the more horrifying.

impale.name: impale
impale.description: Anyone who uses polearms, from pikes to tridents, know that it is to their advantage to keep their enemy at a distance and to thrust at them as they try to close. If done correctly, one can safely from a distance, and strike their foe from one side and  push the haft of their weapon so the business end comes out the other side. Enemies are much easier to deal with when they are lifted up off the ground on a eight foot spear placed right through their midsection.

incite animal soul.name: incite animal soul
incite animal soul.description: This skill, as its name suggests, incites an animal soul to attack a target. The effect is almost totally dependent on the animal soul - the effects vary from angry stare and a fierce 'MOO' to a wholescale destruction with claws and horns. You must have an animal soul mount conjured and close by to use this skill.Usage: use incite animal soul [at target]

infernal arc.name: infernal arc
infernal arc.description: This potent skill allows the reaver to use some dark energy to hurl fire from the blade of his or her weapon at a target, setting it ablaze. The type of weapon is not as important as the user's skill in that weapon, and the weapon itself must be on fire when the skill is used. Distance is not a factor.

insane prices.name: insane prices
insane prices.description: The most silver-tongued of hagglers are said to haggle like madmen, which is not far from the case. Using tall tales, questionable logic, misleading market figures, or just plain outright lying, a particularly glib merchant can unload an item for a greater value than the shop would normally offer. Using this skill also has a tendency to bypass the restriction some stores have on how many of the same item they're willing to accept. Buying the item back could prove tricky. Syntax: use insane prices at <single item carried> Bargain skill speeds up the haggling process dramatically.

insider trading.name: insider trading
insider trading.description: This skill gives you the ability to get extra information about past sales and prices at the BatMUD materials exchange.

instrument creation.name: instrument creation
instrument creation.description: Long, long time ago bards used to carry musical instruments. Somewhere in midst of the Great Conversion, when the guild disappeared for long years, these instruments were lost and never found again. Finally the art of Instrument Creation has been re-invented! A group of bards, including Balron, Qurp, Krzysiek, Zhaman, Typhos and Comax combined their efforts, and a workshop was built into the guild. It is there where this skill becomes handy.

iron body.name: iron body
iron body.description: Iron Body is an exercise used to strengthen your body against all kinds of blows.  Common techniques include slapping your body at least 200 times a day, and increasing the force of the blows every few days.  After your body builds up the resistance, you switch to punches, and after that to bags of beans, gravel or even metal.  It may take years for the exercise to be complete, if this is a thing that can be ever completed -- you can always become more resilient, more durable.For most part, this skill is a passive skill.  You only gain the passive benefits of this skill when unarmed.  Wisdom only affects the active use of this skill.  Actively using this skill does not affect the passive use in any way.

iron palm.name: iron palm
iron palm.description: The martial artist is taught to make himself a deadly weapon, without the need for tools such as swords and axes. His fists and his feet are taught to act as one, moving like lightning with awesome power. The well trained individual can bring to bear incredible series of punches, kicks, creating combinations of attack maneuvers that can devastate his foe.

joint lock.name: joint lock
joint lock.description: Locks are the ancient form of peace enforcing. Even the most toughest bullies calm down rather quickly when they are targeted by a painful joint lock. Of course, this technique requires much concentration and devoted training, to be effective. And by training the art of locks, one also improves the skill to resist them. The would-be enforcer needs a free hand or similar appendage for any real chance of success.Usage: use 'joint lock' [target]        use 'joint lock' release

kata.name: kata
kata.description: Kata is an ancient way martan-em taught to better one's performance using a technique that could be best explained as 'pre-practizing the muscle memory'. With continuous and devoted repeating of certain series of movements, one will succeed better in the situations to come. Doing kata is always worth its while. Martan-em said that doing kata a hundred times gives you a basic understanding of what the kata wants to teach you. One thousand times makes you see your enemies. One hundred thousand times, and it becomes a part of one's spirit, and one knows how to perform right techniques at the right moment, flowing subconsciously from one's hara and empowered with Ki.

ki.name: ki
ki.description: The martial artist is taught his true strength lies not in his physical state, but in his mental state. All power is derived from there. Through proper training and conditioning, he is able to apply his ki to his advantage. His strength and endurance can be augmented by tapping into his ki, which can make him much more effective fighter. A person skilled in ki can also burst out all of their ki energy gathered, in a massive burst of positive energy. Many consider this skill the pinnacle of monk training, as its uses and effects are many, and not always limited to active usage of this skill.Syntax: use ki at list         use ki at add <list>         use ki at remove <list>         use ki at clear         use ki at burstJust replace <list> with a comma-separated list of ki power names.

kiai-cry.name: kiai-cry
kiai-cry.description: This skill is useful for starting a battle. With it, the martial artist summons all his/her/its strength and sends it forth as fast strike against the targets body. The effect is to startle enemy, rendering them momentarily harmless by the  pain, allowing the attacker to finish the series of hits. The skill requires knowledge of the martial arts before it works.

kick.name: kick
kick.description: While most use their hands, or items wielded in their hands to damage their opponents, one can also make very good use of his feet. A well placed kick can do a variety of damage,  such as knocking one's foe to the ground, breaking his ribs, or even crushing his windpipe. Those who are very skilled can defeat many skilled fighters with their hands tied behind their backs.

kiss of death.name: kiss of death
kiss of death.description: This Lord of Chaos skill allows you to blow a pre-emptive kiss of death to your foe.  It is considered to be rude, yet extremely threatening when done right.  Killing the foe you've marked is said to help in the search for your chaotic self.

knockdown shot.name: knockdown shot
knockdown shot.description: The heavy impact of the dense, hard sling bullets can pack quite a punch. With careful aiming and even more careful timing, the user of this skill can hit someone at just the right place and time -- just above their center of gravity, when they are off-balance. The effect, when it works, is that the victim falls onto his stomach or back, and has to take a moment to get back up. Syntax: use knockdown shot at <target> shoot <bullet/stone>         use knockdown shot at <target>

know thy roots.name: know thy roots
know thy roots.description: Although ents are intelligent sentient beings, they still have a yet unknown relation to plants. Those ents, that have not left their traditional ways behind, may find it most relaxing to indulge in their kindred with trees by rooting in an enjoyable natural environment for a while.

knowledge of alchemy.name: knowledge of alchemy
knowledge of alchemy.description: This skill is meant for true magic users. It gives unearthly powers by increasing the effect of the spells.

knowledge of asphyxiation.name: knowledge of asphyxiation
knowledge of asphyxiation.description: Out of all of those who use magic spells from the air element, a few have studied extra hard. Their rewards is the ability to meld the forces of air just a little bit better then those who have not. The result is the ability to strike effortlessly with their spells, yet with much greater power. Those who have mastered the magic powers relevant to the air element are a powerful lot indeed.

knowledge of dispelling.name: knowledge of dispelling
knowledge of dispelling.description: Knowledge of dispelling is needed when purifying the souls of the most vicious and wicked creatures. This skill is automatically in use and is vital for every true nun.

knowledge of herb conservation.name: knowledge of herb conservation
knowledge of herb conservation.description: Fresh herbs, or sometimes even preserved herbs, are hard to come by in large quantities. Knowledge of herb conservation helps you squeeze the last ounces of power out of herbs, thus saving the herb for another use. The skill is automatically in effect when casting herbal spells. Fresh herbs are easier to save, but a master of this skill should have no trouble saving even non-fresh herbs. Strong preserving magics, on the other hand, render the herb unconservable. Some herbs are considerably harder to conserve than others.

knowledge of identification.name: knowledge of identification
knowledge of identification.description: Certain individuals who are able to spend more time researching legends and determining fact and fiction, and taking in all they see, are able to more fully deduct whatever is brought in front of them. While most may take things at face value, these people are able to look past looks and truely deduct the nature of an item.

knowledge of magic lore.name: knowledge of magic lore
knowledge of magic lore.description: Out of all of those who use pure magic as a form of attack, a few have gone beyond and studied a little  harder and practiced a little more. Through the extra preparation and knowledge of their craft, they are able to far outmatch the abilities of those who are only casual users of this form of magic. They are able to bring much more power to the plane for their use.

knowledge of mental defence.name: knowledge of mental defence
knowledge of mental defence.description: By gathering mental images of monsters a psionicist's knowledge of the mind's defence can increase. Using this knowledge it's possible to increase the effectivness of spells that target the mind.

knowledge of metamorphosis.name: knowledge of metamorphosis
knowledge of metamorphosis.description: Those who study alteration magic, or the magic which is able to change the physical properties of items, can with time and practice,  perfect their spells and refine their chants to be able to more effectively meld their weavings into their targets. Only a few are able to say that they truly know their powers and use them to their full extent.

knowledge of thanatology.name: knowledge of thanatology
knowledge of thanatology.description: Thanatology, or the study of death in layman terms, is very important. In order to better understand death, one must learn the many aspects of it. The death itself is many times a silent guest, but the sadness and grief that it usually leaves behind affect the lives of the many. Death is a daunting concept especially in magic. The slightest errors in the casting process could do irreversible damage, which is why the novices are often very scared of invoking spells that tamper with death. The only way to overcome the fear of death is to study thanatology. Once a person becomes an adept in the affairs of death, one learns not to be afraid of it. Only then can a priest truly use magic and its true potential.

knowledge of toxicology.name: knowledge of toxicology
knowledge of toxicology.description: Of the cruel ranks that combine the deadliness of  poison, with the power of magic, there are some that  push even the limits of this horrible face of magic. Some have dwelved deep into studies of poisons and their history, and how to use magic to increase the potency. Some poison mists conjurered forth have been known to poison its victim through protective armour. It is said that some of the true masters of this art have poison flowing in their veins. . .

labeling.name: labeling
labeling.description: With this skill one may label items with unique description for better handling. Usage: use labeling at <item> as <label>/clear. Items can be relabeled but it takes more effort.

large crossbow shot.name: large crossbow shot
large crossbow shot.description: Larger crossbows have bows made from flexible metal, too strong for even an ogre to pull back with one hand. Some, like the medium crossbow, have a stirrup at the end, so you can hold the crossbow in place with one foot while cocking the crossbow with both hands. Others, like the heavy crossbow, require a special winding mechanism. Firing these weapons quickly in battle is just about impossible, but the bolts hit with amazing force when they are launched. Syntax: use large crossbow shot at <target> shoot <bolt>         use large crossbow shot at <target>

law.name: law
law.description: Local governments and associations commonly hold jurisdiction over certain processes in most towns and villages. In order to be able to  lawfully complete some acts, mostly legal ones, one must be able to know what must be done to obtain permission from the local authorities. Usually this involves a tedious process of requests and appeals. Certain individuals who are familiar with these systems can complete these processes much faster and easier then someone who is inexperienced in them. In fact, some make a mighty fine living doing so, many set up shops in town offering their services.

leadership.name: leadership
leadership.description: The leader is the most important member of the party. One skilled in leadership can get the attention of the party members in a crisis, thus obtaining the leadership of the group. A true leader can also save partymembers from a threatening ambush, reorganize party ranks in the heat of a battle and order members to focus their efforts on a single target

leather craft.name: leather craft
leather craft.description: One of the more popular materials to make outerwear and other useful items, is leather. Due to its light weight, flexibility, durability, and its good looks,  it is prefered by many for belts, cloaks, gloves, and many other uses. In order to get leather, one must take the hide from a dead --it's so much easier to work the hide of a dead creature then a live one-- creature, and refine it into a workable piece of leather. Once the leather is tanned properly, it can be cut and decorated as one likes. The best looking and softest leather is used for casual wear, while the tougher and cheaper leather is used for uses such as light armour. It takes a great deal of skill to work with leather at any level, as one wrong move, can ruin an entire piece. Skillful hands, and preferably a sharp knife, are a must to anyone who wishes to craft leather items. Usage: use leather craft at corpse

lesser taunt.name: lesser taunt
lesser taunt.description: The survival of the group often depends on the warriors ability to draw the attention of the aggressing enemies to himself, thus keeping his weaker friends out of harm. By provoking the enemy, it is possible to make them more keen to assault you. Naturally, being a charismatic person helps alot, and only simple minded monsters will fall for this weak form of taunt.

light steps.name: light steps
light steps.description: The legends tell of monks with so light steps, they are capable of hopping from cloud to cloud.  While these are usually indeed only legends, moving quickly over water without falling in is an attainable goal -- a goal requiring numerous hours of practise and oftentimes swimming lessons.  Pausing to catch one's breath while moving this way usually ends in disaster.

lions teeth throw.name: lions teeth throw
lions teeth throw.description: The mighty lion does not torture his prey, as many cats do. Instead, it throws itself at its victim, biting at the neck with all of its mass and muscle in one savage blow. Now most martial artist don't have teeth that big or jaws that wide, but they can follow the same principle . By hurling yourself feet-first through the air, twisting your body in flight, not only can you deliver a lot of force to your enemy's neck, but present yourself as a small, mobile target at the same time.

loan sharking.name: loan sharking
loan sharking.description: Physical wealth is the driving force behind virtually every single day-to-day activity the normal person participates in. Without wealth, even basic needs, such as shelter, clothing, and food are difficult to obtain. Many people require larger amounts of wealth then they can afford to gather at once, to make large purchases, such as plots of land, or other expensive items. This gives those who are able to accumulate these large amounts of capital, a chance to lend them to others, to be payed back over time, at a premium.

locate water.name: locate water
locate water.description: Another problem one must deal with when stuck out in the wild for an extended period of time, is to be able to find fresh water. One can go without food for weeks, but without water for only several days. Even if there are no lakes or rivers in sight, there are always places you can find water. Certain plants hold water in their stalks, there are also hidden springs around. Knowing where and when to find water is a must have skill for anyone who plans to travel in the wilderness.

location memory.name: location memory
location memory.description: Many magical and non-magical means of travel and navigation require complete memory of a location. Failure to store a destination in memory can prove disastrous. The higher trained one is in the art of location memory, the more locations he can remember safely. Usage:    use location memory at remember <location>  You can get a list of the locations you remember by typing:    use location memory at list  To forget a location:    use location memory at forget <location>   use location memory at forget <location1>, <location2>, ... To rename a location:  use location memory at rename <location1> to <location2>

location of weak points.name: location of weak points
location of weak points.description: Each type of creature has its own weak spots -- places where the hide isn't as thick, scales don't overlap, or where vital organs are closer to the skin. Knowledge of these places is crucial to the archer who can't afford diamond-tipped arrows for every shot. Steel arrows might shatter on the scales of a large reptile, but will lodge in the beast's throat just fine. Using this skill requires practice more than anything else. The best way to do this is to find different types of creatures -- humanoids, mammals, reptiles, etc -- and shoot them. It is easier to find weak points on slower, weaker monsters, but you don't learn as much from them. Stronger, faster monsters have better protected weak points, but you learn more by finding them.

long blades.name: long blades
long blades.description: One of the favorite weapons over the years, is the sword. Varying in size and shape, they come in many forms. While anyone who picks up a sword for the first time may be able to swing it back and forth, it takes much practice in order to wield  a blade with true skill. Much of the art called swordsmanship is made up of discipline. Executing the same movements smoothly, and fluidly over and over again are what give a real blademaster his edge. A true master can take his sword, and swing with  only a bit of effort, and slice his foe in half, while a  beginner may swing with all his might, and not even penetrate his foes outer skin.

longbow shot.name: longbow shot
longbow shot.description: Considered the first 'real' skill of the experienced archer, the longbow requires more practice and more strength in the arm to use. The increase in range, speed, and damage of a launched arrow over a shortbow is noticeably better, and some of the more skilled archers can even punch an arrowhead through iron plate armour at a hundred paces. Syntax: use longbow shot at <target> shoot <arrow>         use longbow shot at <target>

looting and burning.name: looting and burning
looting and burning.description: The primitive savages of the wild frontiers are often regarded as violent, ignorant barbarians, burning everything they cannot take. This is not entirely true, but pillaging is a popular passtime amongst the warrior types, as they use the smoke as cover to take the most valuable items and burn the rest. Further, the bodies of their fallen enemies are used to feed the flames. Looting and burning will not interrupt ongoing skills for barbarian elders. Note: You can 'use looting and burning at toggle looting' to switch between looting objects or not.

lounging.name: lounging
lounging.description: We all know that adventures can be a bit tiresome at times. You kill one orc, you've killed them all. Or you see one dungeon, you fly in one citadel...Amidst all this trouble, barbaric environment and companions, it is necessary to maintain a certain standard of living. Instead of napping in a dank sleeping bag you can, as a Shadow Sabre, show some class by having a topnotch meal and use the instruments available at Guild Store to make the Realms a bit more pleasant place for a short while. You will find yourself strangely recovered and refreshed.

lumberjacking.name: lumberjacking
lumberjacking.description: In order for carpenters to fashion items and buildings out of wood, the wood must first be obtained from forests. Cutting down raw trees and milling them into usuable lumber requires much skill and time. It is not simply enough to chop down the tree and cut it into pieces. Doing this yields low quality lumber, and wastes much of the tree. By using basic lumberjacking know-how, this process can be much easier and much more productive, yielding more, high-quality lumber.Experienced lumberjacks can also use this skill to harvest stems of vegetation from smaller plants, although the yield is not nearly as high in terms of the amount of raw material.

lure.name: lure
lure.description: The witted warrior knows ways to fool an opponent. By exposing yourself as vulnerable, luring your foe to attack carelessly, you might get him in the position for a pin pointed strike to some vital part of his body. However, they say that even the dumbest trolls won't go for this trick twice.

mad defense.name: mad defense
mad defense.description: Whether it is fencing, boxing, or martial arts, combat usually follows a set of inherent rules. Each combat style has a priority of where and when you can strike a particular target, and therefore, where and when you you should block. This skill allows the defender to follow all of them for a short time, greatly increasing their parry chance. The cost, however, is mobility, as the user cannot run away while using this skill. Syntax: use mad defense at <number of rounds, min 5>

mad science.name: mad science
mad science.description: The scientists who make the greatest strides forward in progress are often the ones who tried thinking the most freely...not always a safe move when dangerous chemicals are involved. With this skill, a particularly risky alchemist can try to brew up a random potion -- even one they have not yet discovered. This process requires a great number of ingredients, namely five different metals, five different organs, and five different plants. Syntax: use mad science at <flask> The skill will take care of the rest.

make ammunition.name: make ammunition
make ammunition.description: This skill is used to make ammunition, such as arrows and bolts. More than one can be made at a time, if there is enough material. Syntax: use make ammunition at <type> from <material> Examples:  use make ammunition at arrow from wood   use make ammunition at bolt from iron in forge   use make ammunition at arrow from wood,feathers,steel   use make ammunition at needle from steel,silk   use make ammunition at harpoon from wood,steel Arrow and bolt making can use up to three materials. The first is mandatory and makes the shaft, the arrow's main body. The second is optional and makes the fletching. The third is also optional and makes the head. Some combinations make stronger, faster, or sharper ammunition than others.

make arrow of torture.name: make arrow of torture
make arrow of torture.description: Normally, an arrow or bolt doesn't do a lot more or less damage when pulled out, or left in, the wound it has made. However, if the head of it was treated with a magical substance, such as a potion, leaving it in the wound could be disastrous. Not only would the potion continue to inflict damage, but other effects from the magical fluid entering the victim's bloodstream could also ravage this body. Syntax: use make arrow of torture at <potion> and <arrow/bolt> Using high-quality potions is essential for this skill.

make bandage.name: make bandage
make bandage.description: Expert woodsmen, foresters, lumberjacks, and other veterans of the outdoors can find themselves or their comrades injured by a variety of natural and monstrous forces. Most train in the arts of first aid, but sometimes more help is required, for bandages are always in short supply. As such, the skill of making fresh bandages from nearby vegetation or cotton cloth can be quite helpful.

make heatstick.name: make heatstick
make heatstick.description: An introduction to the alchemical arts, students are taught the ways to enhance a material's various properties. The most fun property, of course, is flammability. Just a little special powder can make some materials burn better than they did before. While not always that helpful, some explorers have found that campfires burn hotter when treated with such things, while metalworkers swear that a hotter forge makes for better smelting work. Syntax: use make heatstick at <material> Material must be one of coal, wax and phosphorus coal = low heat, long-burning wax = moderate heat, burns quickly phosphorus = high heat, burns almost instantly You need to wield a knife or scalpel to cut the heatstick.

make herbal remedy.name: make herbal remedy
make herbal remedy.description: Experienced outdoorsmen know that the wilds are full of dangers, but also full of assistance as well. Some learn the ways of healing with plants. This skill allows the user to crush between 3 and 5 barberries into a healing gel that closes wounds and eases pain when applied. High skill in first aid and plant lore intensify the effect, and high percent in this skill let you add yarrow flowers for greater healing and/or ginseng for anti-venom effects.

make mount feed.name: make mount feed
make mount feed.description: Different creatures require different forms of food to survive. This is known by everyone who works with animals, such as hunters, farmers, or animal trainers. Knowing their dietary requirements and their tastes is important if you want the animal to behave properly. With this skill, one can make usable, durable feed for any type of creature by mixing two different plants together. Even carnivorous creatures can be tempted by nutritious herbs and sweet fruit, if the user is skilled enough. Higher skill creates more healthy feed, but knowledge of plants is essential for usable results Syntax: use make mount feed at <plant 1> and <plant 2> for <race>         use make mount feed at <plant 1> and <plant 2> for <mount> To use the second syntax, the mount must be standing next to you.

make mount gear.name: make mount gear
make mount gear.description: Just as an adventurer might want custom-made armour, weapons, and other items built for him by the most masterful of craftsmen, he may also wish the same for his mount. Saddles, bridles, saddlebags and barding are all essential for optimum steed use, and both mount and rider benefit from high-quality gear. Syntax: use make mount gear at <item> from <material> for <mount> where <item> can be any mount-related piece of gear <material> should be a single piece carried or on the ground You can also use workbenches, like 'leather in loom' <mount> is the beast of burden the gear is for, who must be in the room

make reagent.name: make reagent
make reagent.description: Certain spells require small objects called reagents to function. These reagents are consumed during casting and, therefore, are always in short supply. This skill allows the user to turn raw materials into hand-crafted spell reagents, which can be immediately used for casting. Knowledge of alchemy and knowledge of identification aid the user find the correct shape each spell requires. Other than that, normal item creation rules (e.g. tools) apply. Syntax: use make reagent at <material> for <spell name> [into <pouch>]

mana control.name: mana control
mana control.description: Magic, due to its very nature, is not a totally reliable tool. Even the most powerful wielders of magic can fail in their spells. Unfortunately, once a caster attempts to use a spell, he must supply every bit of energy and concentration to the spell, whether or not it succeeds. While some may argue that the first step is to not fail in the first place, many find it necessary to be able to  reclaim the lost energy that they expend, should a spell fail. By using what some refer to as, a reflex action of the mind, upon failing a spell, they can attempt to regain the energy they put into the spell, before it disappears into the void, lost forever. This  is one of the few arts that challenges even the most gifted, and its results are very sporadic. It is said that those who are exceptionally wise are better at reclaiming the lost energies.

mangle.name: mangle
mangle.description: While impaling an opponent is a difficult task, those who can execute this maneuver with ease can sometimes having once impaled their foe, twist their weapon so it rips and tears the victim, until the weapon is pulled completely out of their victim. Once this is done, another impaling maneuver can be done, before the victim has time to react.

maniacal drive.name: maniacal drive
maniacal drive.description: A true mage is a master of the essence of his craft, be it fire, lightning, cold, or many. This essence allows such true spellcasters to push the limits of what a sane caster would attempt. A little insanity, however, lets the caster push even further, but at some personal risk. Use of this skill in combat can greatly improve the chance of mage essence, but can cause the spell's effect to leak onto the caster as well when it is released.

manner of lordliness.name: manner of lordliness
manner of lordliness.description: The legionaries of Kharim use specific fighting style that includes wielding shields. This combat style introduces ways to keep the combat pace up and specialize in shield fighting. While situational warfare concentrates on the theoretical side of tactics, the manner of lordliness is all about the ability to sustain speed and agility. Proficiency in manner of lordliness results in better chances to adapt to different situations on the battlefield.

martial arts.name: martial arts
martial arts.description: Martial arts is the skill of unarmed combat. Those who study this form of fighting learn to use their hands and feet as weapons. Moving faster than the eye, they can pummel their foe into submission with frightening, yet graceful ease. Using perfect  balance, they can throw their opponent off-guard and use that moment of vulnerability to their advantage. You can define martial arts attack speed using command 'marts'

masonry.name: masonry
masonry.description: In order to build strong, durable structures that can pass the test of time and the elements, stone is often used. It is unequaled in sheer strength, except for materials that are impractical to use as building materials. Castles and keeps, and other buildings that require protection from more then just the elements have used stone as the basic building element for quite some time. Its resistance, but not invulnerabilty, to fire is its strongest asset. Due to its desireable features of strength, and durability, it is also a difficult material to work with. Choosing the right stone and shaping it takes much skill.

master chef.name: master chef
master chef.description: Those with sufficient training in the art of cooking can learn the ways of the master chef. Unlike the free-spirited 'improvisational' cooking done by most adventurers, master chefs can make classic recipes using more specific ingredients. It is rumored that these recipes, once perfected, are amongst the best food available for kings and adventurers alike. This skill is not directly used to make food. It is the cooking mastery skill. Other syntaxes:use cooking at help use cooking at my recipes use cooking at my recipe list

mastery of arctic powers.name: mastery of arctic powers
mastery of arctic powers.description: Not many forces known are of equal to the rage and fury of an arctic blizzard, and even fewer are able to lay claim to fully controlling this fury. Those that can lay claim to this, are those who  practice cold-based spells. After much study and research, only then can one truly tame the forces  of the arctic and bend them to their own will. Those who have mastered this form of magic are able to summon blizzards of the highest magnitude even in the scortching desert, without breaking a sweat.

mastery of assistance.name: mastery of assistance
mastery of assistance.description: Those who practice magic in the area of assistance, mostly benevolent spells such as those found in many religious schools, can, after time, employ these spells with great effectiveness. By studying the specific magical needs of each spell, one can carefully optimize his chants to increase the effectiveness  of his spells to normally unobtainable levels.

mastery of bladed fury.name: mastery of bladed fury
mastery of bladed fury.description: While rangers are known throughout the realms at being masters with their blades, there are a few that stand out  from the others. They have used practice and experience to find ways to make their blades even deadlier. These are the ones who are commonly found teaching others the art of bladed fury. Those who survive a hostile encounter with one of these masters leaves, not only with many scars, but with an extreme sense of awe.

mastery of bows.name: mastery of bows
mastery of bows.description: This skill improves your damage with any bow attack skill you use. It may also affect some special effects of bow skills. It does not help the damage caused by bows in melee combat, however.

mastery of camping.name: mastery of camping
mastery of camping.description: Since rangers spend most of their time in the wilderness, away from civilization, they spend most of their sleeping time underneath the stars. Even this skill has been perfected by rangers. While many are proficient campers, only rangers know the latest tricks to get the most out of their rest. It's said that you can let a ranger rest for an hour and then he can walk another hundred miles, without missing a beat.

mastery of channelling.name: mastery of channelling
mastery of channelling.description: This skill is meant for true channelers. It gives unearthly powers by increasing the effect of their spells.

mastery of control.name: mastery of control
mastery of control.description: Many are the ones that cobble in the art of magic and alter the ebb of this arcane force. However, few are the ones that truely understand how magic runs through the mundane plane, affecting every living creature to some degree. The scholars that spend their time studying this fine art, find themselves excelling in spells related to the control of creatures and their life- and magical forces.

mastery of crossbows.name: mastery of crossbows
mastery of crossbows.description: This skill improves your damage with any crossbow attack skill you use. It may also affect some special effects of crossbow skills. It does not help the damage caused by crossbows in melee combat, however.

mastery of destruction.name: mastery of destruction
mastery of destruction.description: As the name suggests, this skill allows a spellcaster to cast  destructive spells with more impact. Spells that damage or destroy creatures or objects do so more effectively, with reduced chances  of the target surviving. Spells that call upon released destructive energies for a reward grant a larger reward.

mastery of draining.name: mastery of draining
mastery of draining.description: The act of syphoning magical energy from other objects is a delicate art. One cannot take too much too quickly. Further, as the immutable laws of the universe dictate, some energy is always lost in a transition between two sources. This skill empowers the caster with the ability to reduce this loss to the environment, effectively getting more energy for the same price.

mastery of fire building.name: mastery of fire building
mastery of fire building.description: This skill increases your ability in firebuilding skill.

mastery of holy vials.name: mastery of holy vials
mastery of holy vials.description: The most skillful nuns master the arts of vial making and have the knowledge and power to give water the most intensive blessing with ease.This skill is also checked when throwing vials or sprinkling holy water upon righteous people.

mastery of locating.name: mastery of locating
mastery of locating.description: This skill is meant for true magic users. It gives unearthly powers by increasing the effect of the spells.

mastery of medicine.name: mastery of medicine
mastery of medicine.description: Those who practice the art of healing magic have always  searched for ways to make their magic more powerful, since there never seems to be enough power at their disposal to heal their friends in dire times. Through much study and practice, one may be able to discern ways to increase the effectiveness of their spells. Many followers of good gods can gain much knowledge from their temples and their priests.

mastery of mounted combat.name: mastery of mounted combat
mastery of mounted combat.description: Attacking from horseback has many advantages. The attacker has the benefit of striking from a higher position, added mobility, and added speed, all of which translates into a more powerful blow.
