This skill takes these factors to their maximum advantage, enabling you to strike while wheeling your mount about for a more effective overall hit.

mastery of pain.name: mastery of pain
mastery of pain.description: Once one has become familiar with evil magic, or harming magic, he may choose to dwelve deeper into the evil lores and practices. If he is able to completely turn his soul over to the evil gods, he may be granted power beyond his imagination. Evil priests who  have mastered this power are some of the most feared beings in the realms, since they literally wield death in their hands.

mastery of rift entities.name: mastery of rift entities
mastery of rift entities.description: Knowing entity life forms is an integral part of the guild of riftwalkers. This skill, although difficult to learn, will have very beneficial effects on a number of guild spells.

mastery of rifts.name: mastery of rifts
mastery of rifts.description: Eventually, there comes a day when every Wanderer discovers that they have attained some deeper, significantly more profound understanding of how the Realms work, thanks to their regular exposure to Vortices. This essential knowledge is expressed in terms of rifts in time and space, from which all Vortices are born.With this understanding comes an improved ability to open vortices successfully, as well as a greater resistance to the physical strains of the creation process.

mastery of runic sigla.name: mastery of runic sigla
mastery of runic sigla.description: Only the oldest and most powerful druids are able to call themselves master druids. Through their careers, they have been able to study and research their craft more deeply then many believed possible. They are able to make their spells perform at a level that exceeds the limit of casual users of their magic. Mountains and trees are truly under their control. Druids having the power of this magnitude, are commonly sought for by those seeking apprenticeship.

mastery of savage beatings.name: mastery of savage beatings
mastery of savage beatings.description: Rangers are masters of using weapons with deadly effectiveness in more than one hand at a time. Rangers who become beastmasters can put this trained efficiency to use, and are able to use a whip or poker in their non-main hand and still 'urge' their mount into combat. Stronger mounts with thicker skin are more resistant to the lighter beatings given by offhand weapons, and require a higher value of this skill to have any effect. This mastery skill affects both guided strike and feral attack.

mastery of shielding.name: mastery of shielding
mastery of shielding.description: Protection magic is one of the most useful types of magic known. Many protective spells offer resistance or immunity to many hazards, some of them fatal without such protection. Those who have studied and practiced this art diligently are able to provide their spells more effectiveness, reliabilty and duration. Many times there is need for only the best of these magic users, due to the magnitude of danger involved in the current crisis.

mastery of short blades.name: mastery of short blades
mastery of short blades.description: Through years of training, a warrior may dwell deeper into the art of fighting. Via hard exercise he learns how to perfect his skills and becomes a fabled master in the art of warfare. This skill is automatically in effect.

mastery of slings.name: mastery of slings
mastery of slings.description: This skill improves your damage with any sling attack skill you use. It may also affect some special effects of sling skills. It does not help the damage caused by slings in melee combat, however.

mastery of weapon handling.name: mastery of weapon handling
mastery of weapon handling.description: A fighter or fightress who masters his or her weapons is truly a formidable opponent. With his weapons of choice, this skill allows one to perform special maneuvers which may turn the situation to his side's advantage. This skill  allows combatants to apply special damagetypes of weapons in combat maneuvers.

meditation.name: meditation
meditation.description: This skill allows you to rest your body, mind and soul by doing nothing except concentrating on doing nothing. Masters of meditation just sit all day meditating. Beginners don't have the discipline to concentrate for long times. ('stop' stops meditation.)

metal fist.name: metal fist
metal fist.description: Before more complex maneuvers may be learned, it is important to know the basics. In the case of legionaries, it usually means long days of shield combat training or simply known as 'manner of lordliness'. When the manner of lordliness is mastered, more difficult maneuvers may be performed. One of those more challenging maneuvers is metal fist. Simply put, the enemy rarely expects a smashing blow inflicted by the off-hand and rather expects a blow from the sword-hand. Using the element of surprise, legionaries of Kharim are sometimes able to punch the enemy with their shield. While shield is not as dangerous as a sharp blade, it may be effective when succesfully used. Metal fist is a derivative technique of riposte which means that proficiency in riposte will also help when punching with the metal fist.

method of runemagery.name: method of runemagery
method of runemagery.description: Runic magic is weaved in a way much unlike that of conventional spellcasters. Spells are not granted as blessings from faceless deities, but mastered through painstaking research in the wilderness, and through the analysis of ancient scriptures. Thus, the arcane art of runemagery itself can be to some extent be simplified to a scientific field in itself, allowing a learned runemage to interpolate and deduce when an occasional fragment of knowledge eludes him.

might of the saints.name: might of the saints
might of the saints.description: This is an arcane skill of holy lore. With this skill caster can harness the power of the saints to aid her fight against the undeads. This skill is automatically in use and vital for every true nun.

mighty charge.name: mighty charge
mighty charge.description: A knight knows that strength and speed will only win a battle if they are supported by conviction and perserverance. Mustering the courage of himself and any allies, convincing them that the battle will go their way, is a key element in any victory. Use of this skill increases overall combat effectiveness if used at the beginning of a fight. The effect is great when used by a knight acting by himself, but even more impressive when used in a capable party.

military discipline.name: military discipline
military discipline.description: Ability to follow orders in the heat of a battle can make the difference between life and death. Training oneself to manner of discipline can aid in this. Without proper training it is extremely hard to focus on commands when heat of the battle is upon you but if the commands are already in your backbone, acting upon those are like breathing.

mind over body.name: mind over body
mind over body.description: The mastering of this hard theory allows one hard disciplined individual to suppress his hunger and thirst. This process is very demanding, for the energy is still used from the body, and it is not recommended to try this under extreme exhaustion. Knowledge of your energies, Ki, will help one to understand this skill better.Usage: use mind over body        use mind over body at list

minecrafting.name: minecrafting
minecrafting.description: The ability to mine minerals is a notable craft, but to tunnel underground and create a mine to search for more is the true challenge. The art of minecrafting is a tedious one to learn, but it will reward you in the end. To correctly balance your hunger for valuables with keeping your mineshaft intact requires patience and nerves. The true treasures wait one in the depths of the earth. Just don't dig too deep...

mineral cutting.name: mineral cutting
mineral cutting.description: This skill can be used to cut one piece of raw material in a forge or workbench into two. You can either shave off a small piece for detail work, or crudely hack a huge log in half. Some material will be lost during the division. Syntax: use mineral cutting at <ore> in <workbench> cut <grams>         use mineral cutting at <ore> in <workbench> (to cut in half)

mining.name: mining
mining.description: Virtually all materials that are man made, such as most metals and refined gems, are created from ore taken from the earth itself. To be able to start this process, first the material must be located. Once a location has been identified as containing valuable resources, the correct process for taking the material from the land must begin. The land and the type of substances to be taken dictate the best techniques to use. Once the correct processes are chosen they must be executed. Mining is hard and involved work, even sometimes it can be dangerous. Attempting to mine any substances from the earth without formal knowledge usually ends in failure.

mint coins.name: mint coins
mint coins.description: Everyone seems to feel their money is disappearing, but this is a truth about any economy. Coins get lost, corrode to worthlessness, or get worn down to faceless, valueless chips of metal. To keep the shops open and workers paid, more money can be minted and introduced -- in limited quantities. This heavily regulated skill allows the knowledgeable user to make blank coins, which need only be stamped by a government official to become cold hard cash. You need a piece of raw material, the same type as the coins to be minted (obviously) on the ground, and the current coin mould to form them.Syntax: use mint coins at <material chunk>

miscellaneous launching.name: miscellaneous launching
miscellaneous launching.description: Some call this the art of the master slinger, others the last-ditch effort of the desperate. Either way, this skill lets you use a sling-type weapon to throw anything you want, provided you can fit it in the launching weapon. Bullets and stones will still work, but so will rocks, maces, hammers, helmets, corpses, empty boxes, chunks of material, or even handfuls of cash. While the impact of a heavy item can be quite powerful, it's also more tiring, and never sling anything you expect to see again. Syntax: use miscellaneous launching at <target> shoot <whatever you can lift>         use miscellaneous launching at <target> [uses a bullet only]

mix drug.name: mix drug
mix drug.description: This skill lets experienced alchemists create drugs to enhance various  abilities.  You need a plant make a drug pill, and you can crush the plant  into some powder to make the pill.  Syntax: use mix drug at <plant>

mix elixir.name: mix elixir
mix elixir.description: The true masters of alchemy can brew the most powerful of potions called 'elixirs'. These elixirs are the purest augmentations to a mortal's body, mind, or spirit that the laws of magic and nature will allow. The alchemist must start with the freshest possible organ of an exceptionally powerful creature. This is dissolved in potent alcohol, along with three drug pills to enhance the same attribute as the elixir itself. The mixture is so strong that only a specially prepared gold bottle will hold the resulting elixir. Syntax: use mix elixir at <organ>

mix juice.name: mix juice
mix juice.description: Many herbalists and naturalists know that drinking water off the ground isn't always a good idea. Brackish swamp water, briny salt water, or just plain old dirt can make such a drink an unpleasant experience. Trees and plants, however, are perfect filters, and the fruit they bear has no trace of such impurities. Juice squeezed from such water-bearing herbs is both safe and tasty. The process rids the herb of any special properties, but a sweet beverage is often reward enough. Syntax: use mix juice at <fruit> into <cup> Example: use mix juice at apple,pear,pear 2,pear 3,plum into jug          use mix juice at all apple into bottle

mix potion.name: mix potion
mix potion.description: This skill allows you to make potions.  The higher skill will enable you to  make difficult potions which require great care. To make a potion you need a  prepared alchemists flask, plus three ingredients.  These are an organ from a  corpse, a mineral sample and a herb.  Syntax: use mix potion at <flask> use <mineral> <organ> <herb>.

mix salve.name: mix salve
mix salve.description: Not all alchemists leap straight into the delicate and sometimes unpredictable art of potion mixing. Some take the time to work with a slightly simpler system and make salves instead. Salves are various balms, ointments, and creams applied to a person or object to give it some special power. Making a salve requires only a bit of some material and a plant, plus a mortar and pestle (an alchemist's hammer can act as a pestle) to grind the ingredients. Syntax: use mix salve at <material> and <plant>

modify ammunition.name: modify ammunition
modify ammunition.description: Nothing is worse to an archer than showing up to a battle with iron arrows against a stone golem, or bolts of fire against a lava monster. Given time, preparation, and ingredients, ammunition can be permanently modified to apply a certain type of bonus damage (such as cold or poison), or to remove an unwanted effect. Syntax: use modify ammunition at <ammo> add <bonus damage> Examples: use modify ammunition at arrow add fire           use modify ammunition at bundle add <chilling>           use modify ammunition at handful of 20 bullets add clear

moonstruck.name: moonstruck
moonstruck.description: This special skill allows the most experienced of sling-users to fire off a moonstone gem, which bursts in a small eruption of lunar energy on contact. The gem will explode on contact, so armour and shields are useless at stopping it.

morphology.name: morphology
morphology.description: Morphology measures how far along the path you are towards mastering the evolution of your own body and spawn-form, in addition to aiding in inflicting others with changes to their physiology. Crucial talent to know and master for any follower of Nergal, it is in particular valued by those who seek to elevate themselves to greatness beyond that which mere mortals can fathom.

mount lock.name: mount lock
mount lock.description: An expert in the field of taming can break a mount, so that it can be ridden. A true master can also force the mount to accept a limited list of potential riders. In simple terms, a 'locked' mount will only allow riders that have ridden for a certain length of time before. Better skill percent lowers this margin, letting the mount trust people faster. Use the skill at 'help' for more information.

mountaineering.name: mountaineering
mountaineering.description: Almost everywhere in the Great Realms of BatMUD you can see mountain tops looming in the distance, beautiful but unattainable for the majority of the mortals. However, adventurers skilled in mountaineering can reach these peaks - it will take some time, and having a pick and some rope with you is strongly suggested.

mounted archery.name: mounted archery
mounted archery.description: This skill teaches the fundamentals of firing any missile launcher, such as a bow or crossbow, from the saddle of a moving horse (or camel, dragon, etc). Your loss of accuracy for firing while mounted will be lower, or possibly even negated entirely. Some masters of this skill get _better_ shots while mounted than on foot!

multiple fury.name: multiple fury
multiple fury.description: Bladed fury would not be called bladed fury, if it weren't for the techniques that allow one to hit his opponent multiple times. Those trained in this discipline are able to make their hands and blades move faster than the wind itself, landing blow after blow upon their enemy. Relentlessly chopping through foes, master rangers are feared throughout the realm for their incredible effectiveness with their weapons.

mummify cadaver.name: mummify cadaver
mummify cadaver.description: Mummification dates back to the times of antiquity. The earliest priests who worshipped Draen-Dalar performed burial rites and commonly whispered a prayer dedicated to the person who had deceased. Often the royal families and aristocrats would prefer towrap their loved ones in expensive linen sheets carefully woven by the seamstresses. The process itself has experienced few changes to help the preservation of the body. The common procedure is evisceration and dehydration of the cadaver before tightly wrapping it into linen. The old traditions that respected the last will of the deceased have transformed into something that carries a more malignant purpose. Today the priests place the mummies of their defeated foes into tombs specifically built to preserve them and use them as a magical reagent for their death spells.

naval tactics.name: naval tactics
naval tactics.description: In combat, a couple of seconds can determine the whole battle. Naturally, you want to be the one accomplishing your goals, and stopping your foes; combat on the high seas is no different in this respect. However, ship to ship battles require coordination among dozens, if not hundreds, of people, and it is very easy for things to go wrong. Someone with a deep understanding of naval combat can get the most out of his crew, making them work faster and more efficiently, resulting in much faster response times from the ship.

negate offhand penalty.name: negate offhand penalty
negate offhand penalty.description: While most of us possess two hands, some more than that, we are usually more skilled at using one than the other. In many cases, the offhand is only a spectator while the other hand performs most duties. The same applies to wielding weapons, our primary hand is much more adept when using weapons. Through rigorous training, one can become skilled enough to use weapons in their offhand(s). If you are really good, you can probably hide that you have an offhand at all.

offhand shot.name: offhand shot
offhand shot.description: While some weapons, like longbows and staff slings, require both hands and focus, some smaller weapons can be fired, although with less accuracy, even in the archer's non-primary hand. This is challenging, and only masters can pull off trick shots with their left hand.     1% and up: slingshots    21% and up: light crossbows    41% and up: slings    61% and up: medium crossbows    81% and up: heavy crossbows   101% and up: shortbows Skill chance reduces the penalty, regardless of weapon type. Regardless of skill%, you cannot fire an overwielded weapon offhand.

offhanded fury.name: offhanded fury
offhanded fury.description: While a ranger using one blade to direct his fury at his foe is impressive, a ranger using two or more, is ungodly.  Proper training allows one to be able to direct his fury  with his second hand weapon as well as his first. Even though this seems difficult, its not as hard as it seems. Once one has proficiency in bladed fury, hitting with the offhand proves  relatively easy, since the opponent is already knocked off balance from the hit from the primary weapon.

overbear.name: overbear
overbear.description: There are times when fighters need to rely on their wits and cunning to survive a fight. There are also times when nothing beats brute force. Overbearing an opponent simply involves wading straight into your foe and attempting to body slam them. Not only does this damage your foe, it is good at knocking the sense out of him, which can leave him helpless for a short time while he regains his senses.

overland flight.name: overland flight
overland flight.description: A flying mount is an exceptional asset to the long-distance traveller. Able to bypass such obstacles as forests, deserts, and even mountains, the rider can soar over difficult terrain in any direction they choose.  Syntax: use overland flight at <direction> <distance> <direction> is any of the eight compass directions <distance> is either short, medium or long If you happen to have the 'location memory' skill, you can also use this skill to fly to a known location. Anyone can use this skill to fly to a nearby ferry dock with the target 'ferry'.

pain threshold.name: pain threshold
pain threshold.description: The most important ability that barbarians possess, is that which allows them to ignore physical pain, and continue pressing the attack on their foes. This not only gives them the physical edge, but the mental edge. It is quite disheartening to land a solid blow, and have your foe simply shrug it off and continue the assault. Hordes of barbarians are a fearsome sight indeed, because of the relentless style of attack.

parry.name: parry
parry.description: While most of the art of combat leans towards the  offensive side, a portion of this art leans also in the defensive direction. If one has a weapon in hand, even better if he has a shield, he can use these to help deflect blows aimed at himself. The best way to live to fight another day, is not to die. Of course, if one is spending time defending himself, he may not attack with the same effectiveness as he would if he was not holding himself back in order to defend himself.Usage: parry <0-51>

pathfinding.name: pathfinding
pathfinding.description: The most common request outsiders give to rangers, is to hire a guide to lead them when traversing the wilderness. Rangers have, over the years, blazed many trails in the wilderness that are only visible to those trained in the art of pathfinding. Either leading a large company, or traveling alone, this allows them to save much time and effort while traveling, making them excellent guides and runners.This skill is both automatically used when moving about, and also used actively.Syntax: use pathfinding at <location> 	use 'pathfinding' <location>This will make the ranger calculate a path from one location to another and then lead his/her party through the woods to the desired destination.

pattern weave.name: pattern weave
pattern weave.description: An adept martial artist can mesmerize his opponent with the hypnotic patterns wowen with his hands and movements. While not directly harmful, it makes seeing the real attacks more difficult, thus evading or blocking them is harder.

pierce.name: pierce
pierce.description: One of the advantages to using small weapons such as a dagger or a small sword, is that they are very light and easy to handle. Combining this characteristic with the art of stabbing can enable one to not only stab their opponent once, but, in many cases use the same motion and inflict a second strike.

pin down.name: pin down
pin down.description: A truly skilled fighter of the Crimson Brigade is devoted to defending its group. The art of pinning down an enemy with your shield is a tough job and requires multiple masteries to accomplish properly. One who truly masters this art, can sometimes create a situation where the enemy can only bend to the unbreakable will of a true Crimson warrior and be held down. With violence.

plant lore.name: plant lore
plant lore.description: This skill helps you to identify different kinds of plants. It is also used for picking the fruits of the plants, so that you don't break them. This skill is automatically in effect when you walk around in the wilderness. To pick fruits/leaves/berries use the command 'pick'. For example:        pick appleThis skill can also be used to tell you a little bit about a specific plant or herb, even if you do not have one handy. Syntax: use plant lore at <name of plant/herb>         use plant lore at listOne should be careful how much they sample from the wilderness or Gaia might punish those that are too greedy of nature's benefits.

plastic surgery.name: plastic surgery
plastic surgery.description: While it is said that looks are only skin deep, that skin deep image is the first impression anyone makes with any new contacts. Some people use their good looks to their advantage, as beautiful people are given more leniency then ugly ones, its a fact of life. Due to this emphasis on physical beauty, one of the newer studied arts, is the art of making one more beautiful. By using creams and salves, many skin afflictions can be remedied. Other problems may require more drastic measures, but be assured, someone out there knows how to do it!Syntax: use plastic surgery at <player>         use plastic surgery at <player> install implant <implant>         use plastic surgery at <player> view implants         use plastic surgery at <player> remove implant <implant>Removing an implant will destroy it.

polearms.name: polearms
polearms.description: Weapons ranging from long spears, to halberds and pikes, all fall under the category of polearms. While not as commonly seen as a sword or an axe, they are still effective weapons. Due to  their size and abilities they are most commonly found in large organized armies. Ineffective for close in fighting and skirmishing, they are prefered usually for large scale battles involving hundreds or thousands. They are effective when used in great numbers, being able to create an impenetrable wall. Their great length also makes them ideal for either using on horseback, or using from the ground to counter foes on horseback. A great deal of skill is  required to use these weapons effectively. Knowing when to feint and thrust can make all the difference in sticking your foe in the chest, or thrusting into open.

pound.name: pound
pound.description: The most common form of attack made with a bludgeoning weapons is to muster up all of one's strength and land a crushing blow upon the upper body of the target. Even  the most well-made helms and body plates are helpless against the stunning force of a well-placed overhead  smash. This type of attack is good for knocking a foe to the ground where he can be repeatedly pounded.

power of faith.name: power of faith
power of faith.description: The nuns have numerous saints both living and dead. The saints together form a circle of holy power which flows strong in those with the power of faith. With every cast of certain spells there is a possibility to gain power from the holy circle to do more damage against fiendish entities. This skill is automatically in use.

power slash.name: power slash
power slash.description: Knights are careful and deliberate fighters, placing higher value on accuracy than brute strength. This skill is an example of the knight's philosophy, allowing the knight to use any one-handed slashing weapon (axe, sword, anything will do) to land a blow more reliably than the wild swings of the barbarian or ranger, although at the expense of some damage. Skill with the weapon used is essential, and larger, clumsier weapons will miss more often but cause more damage. Note that some weapons work better against some creatures than others. Arms lore may help.

prayer.name: prayer
prayer.description: While a templar's most important duty in life is to protect the world against the forces of evil there also comes a time when he has to show his devotion to his god, Faerwon. Even though the god of holy war prefers to see devotion through action, he does not want to be forgotten. Through prayer a templar makes sure that he is on good terms with his god and on occasion Faerwon may reward a praying templar. A templar can also decide how he wants to focus his inner energies through prayer.

prayer to destruction.name: prayer to destruction
prayer to destruction.description: There comes a time in every reaver's life where he needs to focus his dark energies for a single strike. This skill lets a reaver get in touch with the untapped evil power in his heart, in addition to the destructive energies he has released. Once properly motivated, his next attack will have a greater chance of success. While this skill can aid the success of any venture, it has the greatest effect when used on reaver powers. Syntax: use prayer to destruction at skill         use prayer to destruction at spell Add 'spite' at the end if you want to see your spite data.

praying mantis.name: praying mantis
praying mantis.description: All the thrikhren have natural ability to learn the praying mantis fighting style quickly. This makes them more deadly in melee combat on top of their superb magical abilities.

precise slash.name: precise slash
precise slash.description: This advanced version of power slash allows the knight to choose the moment for the most effective strike. In exchange for taking a second or two longer, the blow causes more damage to a vital point, with or without a special weapon the target is vulnerable to. Also, if timed correctly, the blow can cause more distraction than a mere wound, and can throw off the target's concentration.

primal adept.name: primal adept
primal adept.description: Traditionally, martial arts is for those with hands and feet, and it concentrates on making the most use of those.  Those having horns, hooves or even wings can benefit from similar stoic concentration on bodily and mental betterment.  The way of the primal adept is just that -- concentration on bodily betterment, via martial arts methods, for natural attacks beyond fists, feet and the occasional claw.  The training must begin at the earliest possible age, thus all kinds of later learned or acquired methods of attack won't benefit from this.  "Use what you were born with" is the solid motto of the primal adept school of thought.

protection by sacrifice.name: protection by sacrifice
protection by sacrifice.description: A soldier may take a vow to protect a weaker adventurer if he is up to the task and if he considers the weakling worth protecting, for the common good of the party. The life of the protected may well be saved by the soldier; but nothing is as certain as uncertainty in the chaotic turmoil of a battle.The protected must be weaker than the protector, and unless she is behind the protector in party the saving will not be possible.

protection coordinator.name: protection coordinator
protection coordinator.description: A leader who is not aware of the full status of his grunts might make the wrong choices. This skill gives the user an unique ability to manage the spell and skill effects on her partymembers using the 'protset' command.

pulverize.name: pulverize
pulverize.description: Not many things are more devastating in a fight then landing a pounding blow to your opponent with a large club. If one is strong enough and trained well, he can not only pound his target, but also bring to bear enough force to knock his opponent down, allowing him to strike  a second time. These are the types of attacks that can literaly 'pulp' your foes skull inside his helm.

pummel.name: pummel
pummel.description: During a fist-fight, the most successful tactics usually involve a series of blows and kicks. If one is able to close with their opponent with the initiative, they may be able to unleash a flurry of blows that not only damage the opponent, but may also knock him senseless for a short while. This is the type of maneuver that bouncers excel at in order to quickly subdue rowdy patrons.

punch.name: punch
punch.description: Basic punching skill. A fair fist to the face is sometimes the best teacher.

purifying strike.name: purifying strike
purifying strike.description: An excellent offensive skill to use against chaotic spawns. This skill draws upon holy might and tries to remove the effects of chaotic spawn from the target. The strike takes a lot of concentration, and drains greatly the user, but if successful, the drain on the target is even greater. Those skilled in converting and guiding people are more able to channel the required holy power. The skill requires you to have a free hand to properly manipulate the holy force.This skill is one of the latest additions to the ghost liberator guild. Forces of chaos have risen in the recent years, and something was needed to stand a chance against them. Chaotic spawns are fierce creatures, and dangerous opponents, but oftentimes when the true form of the spawn is revealed, it is found to be just another power-hungry mortal, who is about to flee from the combat. Facing a mortal is a much easier task than facing a huge mass of tentacles and weapons.Usage: use purifying strike at <target>

push.name: push
push.description: While fighting an opponent in a melee, there are many ways a skilled attack can gain an advantage. One of the simplest forms of fighting taught, is to step into the target and give him a solid shove. While the damage is light, this skill is easily mastered and the basis for many fighting styles. The stronger the fighter, the harder he can push his opponent.

quick chant.name: quick chant
quick chant.description: Anyone who employs magic of one sort or another, will testify that casting spells takes time. The mysterious power, which mortals call magic, does not jump ready for ones use at a single thought. It takes time and concentration for one who wishes to employ magic, mainly in the form of spells. Of course, there are times when that amount of time needed for one to cast a spell is not available. Fortunately many years ago, a scholar in the ways of magic discovered that by using carefully crafted abbreviations, one could speak the words needed to harness the power of magic more quickly, just as we use contractions and  slang to ease our verbal form of communication. Of course, this is  a much more refined art than simple speech. But given the proper training and instruction, one can use these techniques to shorten the time they require to wield their magical powers.

radiant slash.name: radiant slash
radiant slash.description: Radiant slash strikes an opponent with holy energy. The energy is harmless to non-evil opponents. The surroundings need to be lit for the skill to work. The basic techniques of slashing and attacking greatly increase your chances to score a hit. You need a long blade wielded in your primary hand for the skill to work.Yet another technique mastered by Samuel de Montfort. Sometimes your opponent ignores physical hits and you don't happen to have a spare sword with you, you can try radiant slash. The attack is more or less magical in nature, burning your opponent from inside out. The only shortcoming of this attack is the fact that it requires plenty of light.Usage: use radiant slash at <target>

raise mount.name: raise mount
raise mount.description: Faithful followers of Tzarakk have been known to employ anything in their service - even the corpses of the already dead. While this may sound like a powerful capability, there's a drawback - the corpses animated by chaos cannot heal on their own, making them more or less disposable assets.

rampage.name: rampage
rampage.description: A powerful servant of Tzarakk has no regard to his or her mount. He or she can, without pity, make the mount attack like its life depended on it - as it most often does, as servants of Tzarakk are not known for their forgiveness. Skilled users may attempt to hit their foes with their wielded weapons as well as they are near enough. Please note that this skill is the pinnacle of the Tzarakk followers combat abilities, and hence lots of different things affect the skill.

rampant cutting.name: rampant cutting
rampant cutting.description: As a reaver's dedication to the forces of destruction increases, so does their focus in causing decisive, debilitating hits in combat. This skill is an improvement over the skill scythe swipe, in that the reaver can sometimes strike a second blow immediately after the first, causing significantly greater pain and damage. Like scythe swipe, an opponent destroyed through the use of this skill feeds the reaver's desire to wreak havoc.

rapid maneuvering.name: rapid maneuvering
rapid maneuvering.description: While strategy is an important aspect in successful warfare, there is something that can never be entirely replaced with premeditated plans. That is tactics on the combat field. Rapidly changing conditions require a commander who will make the right decisions without hesitation and most of all, does it very quickly. Using rapid maneuvering, a great commander is able to guide his entire army by yelling them orders and therefore help them complete their tasks quickly. The disciplined people are also known to be more prone to follow orders of the commander.

rapid rotation.name: rapid rotation
rapid rotation.description: Slings, even used by experienced slingers, can be awkward. Slings use a curved path to build up momentum, which can take some time. This skill cuts down on that time, giving you insight on how things spin, which will get a shot off faster.

rapid shot.name: rapid shot
rapid shot.description: The more arrows you can fire from your bow in a short time, the more damage you can do. This skill lets you grab, notch, aim and fire an arrow from any kind of bow more quickly.

rapid winching.name: rapid winching
rapid winching.description: Crossbows are notoriously slow, so much so that many warriors choose to fire one shot, drop their crossbow, and pull out a hand weapon, assuming they won't have a chance for a second shot in time. Usually, they're right, especially with the larger crossbows. This skill teaches the nuances of crossbow reloading -- tips and tricks that lowers the amount of time it takes to prepare for a second shot.

reave armour.name: reave armour
reave armour.description: Reavers are dedicated in their unholy religion to destroy all items that have value. It is certainly true that anyone in combat places great value on the armour they wear and the weapons they wield. For this reason, reavers will attempt to destroy them. This skill aims a blow at the target's prized armour and weapons, without any great concern as to which one is struck.

reave shield.name: reave shield
reave shield.description: Reavers revel in the destruction of their opponents, a task made more difficult when said opponents try to defend themselves. As such, reavers learn this skill to break their opponent's shield, leaving them open to attack, throwing off their battle strategy, and possibly demoralizing them as well. A single use of this skill will weaken the target's shield, and repeated uses will shatter it completely.

reave weapon.name: reave weapon
reave weapon.description: In the ongoing effort to cause as much widespread devestation as possible, reavers find triumph in the act of killing armed opponents and smashing their weapons. The use of this skill is a step in that direction. The reaver rains blows down at the target, applying equal force to the intended victim as well as whatever weapon or shield the victim tries uses to fight back.

reaver strike.name: reaver strike
reaver strike.description: Reavers firmly set upon the path to annihilation can prepare their body, as well as their mind, for wanton acts of violence and death. This skill is a result of that preparation. The reaver strikes as many as three times, letting blood, fur, and flesh fly in the following carnage. As with rampant cutting and scythe swipe, an opponent destroyed through the use of this skill gives the reaver appropriate rewards. The second and third strikes occur in the rounds directly following the first.

reaving.name: reaving
reaving.description: Once one is familiar with the cleaving manuever used by most axe-wielders, he might try to hone his skill enough so that he is able to, after successfully cleaving his opponent, quickly turn and reverse directions with his swing, which allows him a second attack without delay. While the reverse action may seem like a natural movement, with an  axe, tricky enough to wield on its own, and the fact that cutting through flesh and bone also hinders movement, this is not an easy task.

rebellion.name: rebellion
rebellion.description: Once thoroughly trained in the art of destruction of physical things, reavers turn towards other things of value that can be destroyed. Such things include governments, society, even civilization itself. They are rewarded for this kind of philosophy with this skill, an augmented riot skill, that can make better use of a large party of like-minded individuals. The rebellion not only damages the victim's body, but tears at his mind as well, as he or she is surrounded by a terrifying mass of angry flesh. The skill's actual duration depends on the number of rebels. Syntax: use rebellion at <target> (the rest works itself out)

rebuke.name: rebuke
rebuke.description: One of the key lessons learned by an animal trainer is this: if you wish to be seen as a master and not as food, you must be thought of as a source of great pain, when necessary. A sudden strike to a tender spot can make any beast leap back, throwing it off its game. This skill makes use of that in combat, allowing the user to inflict a distracting blow on a creature of any type, possibly breaking its concentration. You need to wield a whip or poker to use this skill.

recanting.name: recanting
recanting.description: Recanting is a process by which two potions can be combined into one potion of  greater strength. Alternatively, two partially-full potions can be mixed into  a single flask to save space.  Syntax: use recanting at <potion> and <potion 2>  Neither flask can be empty for this to work

refining.name: refining
refining.description: Once an ore has been taken from the earth, it still must undergo refining in order to be able to be used. Ore taken straight from the ground usually consists of only a small percentage of the desired material. This must be seperated out, through sintering, or some other method. This purifies the ore. Some ore deposits may require several refining steps in order to draw out enough impurities to be able to work  with the material successfully. The higher quality the ore, after refining, the higher quality material that can be produced from it.Usage: use refining at <material type> in <work bench>

refit mount gear.name: refit mount gear
refit mount gear.description: While many a brave soldier has ridden to victory on the back of a trusty horse, and many an intrepid explorer has brought back riches on the back of a mule, not everyone uses such common mounts. Yet what can be done to give protection to a war-rhino, or allow a rider greater control over an alligator? This skill allows gear made for one type of mount to be resized and adjusted to fit another. Syntax: use refit mount gear at <item> for <mount> Appropriate tools and some extra material are required.

release ghost.name: release ghost
release ghost.description: Get rid of ghosts in a benevolent and profitable way. Those skilled in tempting people will get better gains from releasing ghosts. Releasing powerful ghosts is very good deed indeed - maybe good enough to deliver you from the flames of hell and gain your way into heaven. This technique is a bit scorned upon, but effective. Do remember that you can release ghost even without this skill.Sometimes you can't help but beat some sense into good people, too. This is of course bad for your conscience. You can alleviate the bad feelings by having a nice chat with a ghost and then releasing it into the light. It is said de Montfort never used this technique himself, but then again, who would admit being a power-hungry ghost-abuser.Usage: use release ghost at <ghost name> OR        use release ghost (releases current selected ghost)

relentless.name: relentless
relentless.description: The boldest and bravest knights have adapted the saying 'You can't keep a good man down' in a rather dramatic way. Should such a knight take a blow that renders him unconscious, their inner strength and determination can force them back on their feet again. They will not be in any condition to fight, but at least they can guide their companions away from danger. Relentless is constantly in effect, but it does not always work. A knight who is not leading a band into battle has less to lose and, as such, will not make use of this skill. In addition, some blows can be too severe to recover from, and some kill the knight instantly without a chance to stand up. In any event, it takes a lot of effort to regain consciousness this way, and the knight will find himself exhausted and only barely able to move.

relic handling.name: relic handling
relic handling.description: This skill allows you to wear a relic while you are in combat. Success ratio is increased for elders and synod members.

repair armour.name: repair armour
repair armour.description: Armour, while it offers the wearer protection, is usually not immune to damage itself. Good armour must be properly maintained, or it will slowly deteriorate and become useless. Those who possess high quality armour, if they are able, check their armour for dents and tears after every fight, if possible. If repairs are necessary, it must be taken to a blacksmith or armourer, who possesses the correct materials with which to make the repairs. Many castles and towns have their own local blacksmith, due to the high demand of the warriors in that area. Some areas even have several competing factions.

repair item.name: repair item
repair item.description: Time, the elements, and even results of human actions, accidental or purposeful, can take their toll on the physical state of many items, tables, chairs, statues, anything that one assigns any value to. If something does befall your favorite vase, you only need to take it to the local repair guild. They are always happy, for a small fee of course, to take your item and return it as good as new. Many who work in these guilds, are training to become armourers and blacksmiths. Occasionally, there will be a free-lancer who also lives off his work repairing items.

repair weapon.name: repair weapon
repair weapon.description: The most important possession any warrior has, is his sword, or axe, or whatever weapon he uses. A warrior's weapon is as important to him as a spellbook is to a mage. Over time a weapon may gather knicks, and scratches, and those can turn into cracks and chips. If these are not taken care of on a regular basis, the weapon could break under the stress of normal use. It is a good practice to regularly have one's weapon checked and repaired in order to keep it on tip-top shape.

rescue.name: rescue
rescue.description: One advantage of fighting with comrades at your side, is that if you are somehow knocked unconscious, or just  plain hit hard enough to knock you senseless, one of your comrades can sometimes assist you, if the time comes to flee. By being able to keep track of the battle, one can see when a fallen comrade needs assistance, and can sometimes give that assistance in order to remove him from the battle safely. Check 'party rescue' and 'party rescuelist' commands for further info.

ride through flame.name: ride through flame
ride through flame.description: One thing many people know is that animals have a strong, sometimes overwhelming, fear of fire. Beastmasters have learned to train their animals to suppress this fear, or at least to suppress the symptoms. They do this by hitting the animal repeatedly, until the animal fears the rider more than any flame. You must wield a whip or a poker to use this skill.

ride through frost.name: ride through frost
ride through frost.description: Those who study animals learn that cold is not usually their best friend. Many animals migrate to warmer climates rather than face the harsh winds of winter. Others choose to hibernate, and some simply die. Beastmasters know of this aversion animals have to the cold, and train their mounts to ignore it by beating them until they respond. You must wield a whip or a poker to use this skill.

ride through pain.name: ride through pain
ride through pain.description: Many members of the animal kingdom have instincts that lead them to be more bark than bite. The lion's mane, the bright stripes of the coral snake, and the antlers of the stag are more often used for show. However, a mount that is not used to fighting could balk or even retreat when faced with a foe capable of dealing it severe damage. As such, the beastmasters train their mounts to be more afraid of painful punishment from their riders than from anything else they might encounter. You must wield a whip or a poker to use this skill.

ride underground.name: ride underground
ride underground.description: More than the heat of fire, the bite of frost, and even the pain of injury, many animals are afraid to be caged. It is an instinctive, primal fear that is difficult to overcome. A trapped animal tends to panic, leaping at shadows and snapping at anything it doesn't trust. This makes them useless creatures as mounts or pets inside or in other tight spaces. A well-trained beastmaster can overcome this fear only through proper application of punishment and rewards.You must wield a whip or poker to use this skill, which only works on an animal not currently being ridden (it can be led). If you are carrying any food items the animal likes, up to two will be used as treats to enhance the likelihood and length of a successful training session.

riding.name: riding
riding.description: While it is said the journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, there are many that would argue that it begins with finding the right horse. Riding makes the trip faster and more comfortable, allowing you to go farther with heavier gear and not arrive too exhausted to fight. While horses are typically easy to manage, other, more exotic animals require more skill to ride. Riding can be made easier with the use of certain types of gear.

rift channelling.name: rift channelling
rift channelling.description: Vortices are infamous for their ability to draw the magical energies out of every living being in the room. However, this energy is required in order for it to grow to a stable level, hence must be supplied.Fortunately, with experience comes an understanding of just how this magical power is absorbed, and a greater talent for giving that energy in the proper form. In essence, you are generating the energy needed at a smaller cost to yourself. This skill benefits all affected beings, whether they are directly connected to the vortex's magics or not.

rift energy flow.name: rift energy flow
rift energy flow.description: The flow of energy from the rift worlds is difficult to manipulate and direct. This skill not only increases the amount of energy available to the riftwalker, it also allows the energy to be more accurately focused.

rift world resistance.name: rift world resistance
rift world resistance.description: This skill will allow an explorer of a rift world to resist its inhospitable environment for a longer period of time.

righteousness.name: righteousness
righteousness.description: While being able to fight the forces of evil on the battlefield in order to protect what is sacred is one of the most important things for a templar, it is still nothing compared to being righteous. Without the virtue of righteousness a templar is merely a soldier instead of an avatar of good.

riot.name: riot
riot.description: Reavers are not fond of chess, or any other game with restrictive rules and organization. They can never understand why the pawns, knights, and other pieces don't rush down the board all at once and drown the opposing king in a mob. The same idea applies in combat. The typical rank-and-file, parry-and-thrust mentality common to most trained warriors does not sit well with them. With a cry of frustration, they and other impatient allies can swamp a single victim with a frenzied beating. Effective as this skill is, it only works if the target is outnumbered. The actual duration of the skill depends on the number of rioters. Syntax: use riot at <target> (the rest works itself out)

riposte.name: riposte
riposte.description: Those fighters who practice a defensive style of fighting do not limit themselves to defensive tactics. Once they possess the ability to parry attacks, they gain the ability to counterattack. By throwing their opponents attack to the side, they are able to complete the move by hitting their opponent, who is still in mid-thrust. Fighting someone who has mastered this technique can be frustrating, besides deadly.

runescribing.name: runescribing
runescribing.description: Runemages channel their magic through runestones, but in order to do so, they must carve the rune onto stones that have been shaped for that purpose. The carving is a rather careful process and requires quite a bit of concentration. Find a blank runestone to use this skill on, and 'use runescribing at rune <rune> on <runestone>'.

runic research.name: runic research
runic research.description: Runemages are known to gather their knowledge not only through lectures and books, but also from the thorough research that they conduct in the outdoors, meticulously examining ancient mineral deposits and old trees for runic writings.

sabre derobement.name: sabre derobement
sabre derobement.description: Derobement means avoiding your opponent's attempt to strike or take your blade (usually during his preparation to attack). Note that the derobement is a deception: specifically, a deception made with a point-in-line.A difficult defence technique used in fencing.

sabre feint.name: sabre feint
sabre feint.description: Feint: an attack into one line with the intention of switching to another line before the attack is completed. Used to draw your adversary away from the true attack.Feint is a complicated defense technique used in fencing.

sabre fence.name: sabre fence
sabre fence.description: For some barbaric guilds the battle is a simple continuation of 'raising your weapon and smashing the enemy's skull with it', to a point of utter boredom. There are more interesting ways of fighting, and this is one of them. In fencing the comprehension of different techniques and how to combine them (to create a 'cadence' into your fencing) is vital. A combination that works wonders against one foe may fail against another. You need to be flexible, you need to be clever.

sabre invito.name: sabre invito
sabre invito.description: Invito means inviting an attack by taking up an On Guard in an exaggerated parry position; the act of deliberately making a tempo or offering an opening to the adversary in order to lure him to attack - and then beat him with a swift counterattack. Be careful not to make too wide an opening as you perform an invito...An extremely challenging defence technique used in fencing.

sabre lunge.name: sabre lunge
sabre lunge.description: From the usual on guard, extend the blade towards the target. The blade always goes first. If not then you will be telegraphing your attack, this slows down your attack and gives your opponent more time to react. Lift your front (right) foot as though you were taking a step, at the same time straighten the back (left) leg. The attack is finished with the back leg straight, the front leg bent, with the right knee over the right foot, no further.The simpliest and most common attack technique used in fencing.

sabre parry.name: sabre parry
sabre parry.description: Always hold your parries well away from your body. Practice getting the best angle possible to stop an attack. Make your actions smooth, using small circles. Parry the opponent's blade; do not hit it. The parry should be waiting for the attack, not moving against it. Always proceed from On Guard to the parry position. After the parry, return to On Guard. Vary the angle of the blade to what you feel would be the best position to defend.The simpliest and most common defense technique used in fencing.

sabre remise.name: sabre remise
sabre remise.description: Remise; immediate replacement of an attack that missed or was parried, without withdrawing the arm. Many fencers will, in fact, use a fast remise while closing distance to make it impossible for their opponent to get their riposte off.  These tactics require you to be able to make the actions into 'one-light' actions where you make the hit but your opponent does not hit you.A complicated attack technique used in fencing.

sabre riposte.name: sabre riposte
sabre riposte.description: Riposte is a swift counter-attack delivered after adversary's blow. It requires fast reflexes and good candence; otherwise you will expose yourself to your adversary's counter-riposte.An extremely challenging attack technique used in fencing.

sabre tension parry.name: sabre tension parry
sabre tension parry.description: Tension parry; resisting the pressure of an adversary's opposition thrust by forcing blade and arm into a strong opposition parry, which through brute force closes the threatened line. Tension parries are vulnerable to timely disengagements and may also result in pulling a muscle in the forearm.The most difficult fencing technique.

sabre trompement.name: sabre trompement
sabre trompement.description: Trompement is usually made at the end of a feint, deceiving your opponent's parry and hitting him. Note that deceiving your opponent's parry involves completely avoiding it. No grazing contact may occur, else the feint is considered to have been parried.A difficult attack technique used in fencing.

scaly tail.name: scaly tail
scaly tail.description: The oppressed lizardmen in their distress called to their god to help them. But their god did not want to give reward for nothing. Their god granted them the seed of knowledge of warfare. The elders began to share this knowledge to the young ones. Some masters have also been known to sharpen their tail scales.

scourge of dark steel.name: scourge of dark steel
scourge of dark steel.description: The vandals of Kharim spread the scourge on their travels. Only few ever survive from attacks of Kharim's elite legion. Scourge of dark steel has originated from past times when the first vandals of Kharim demolished and burned vast regions. The 'scourge' refers to the group of vandals while 'dark steel' refers to the black metal armours that they were wearing. The meaning of the expression has changed since and means one of the fiercest attack techniques that are used by Kharim's vandals. Technique is quite sophisticated, but brutal, and it is used to cause bleeding wounds that close quickly. While the assault itself doesn't cause much harm, the scourging mark that it leaves makes the previous wound more sensitive to any damage. Succesful adaptation to battlefield as well as adept use of shield are often regarded as noteworthy factors when attempting a scourging attack.

scouting.name: scouting
scouting.description: There are many times when a ranger must have a good picture of his surroundings, in order to plan his next move. With this skill he can take a look at the surrounding area with little effort. The better trained the ranger, the larger the area he can scout without trouble. Many times, one with a trained eye will notice a ranger, high a top of a tree, peering off into the distance. More than likely he is scouting an area, and definitely, he has already noticed you hours ago as you approached.

scrounge ammunition.name: scrounge ammunition
scrounge ammunition.description: Nothing is worse for the hunter out in the wilderness than to realize he has run out of arrows. A clever outdoorsman can make what they need, including ammunition. The results are often shoddy and barely hold together, but it's better than nothing. Syntax: use scrounge ammunition at <arrow/bolt/stone> If you have any 'torch creation' skill, you can add a small amount of fire damage to your result. Syntax: use scrounge ammunition at torch <arrow/bolt/stone> This skill only works outside.

sculpture.name: sculpture
sculpture.description: Sculptors pride themselves in being able to take almost anything and shape it into a piece of art. What determines what is art, may differ from person to person. The most common use for sculptures is to decorate castles and homes. They usually signify special events in the owner's life, or may be a tribute to a god, or a resemblance of a loved one. It's been said that the most talented sculptors are able to make their creations seem to come to life!Usage:Requirements for first stage:   - you must have enough material components (the more (weight) you have    the better your chance of success).   - the components must be located in the same room as you are.   Example: use sculpture at torch, pants, sword 2 (comma separated list)  Requirements for second stage:   - you must have a sculpture present at the same room as you are in.   Example: use sculpture at chair (assuming you named your artifact 'chair')

scythe swipe.name: scythe swipe
scythe swipe.description: This elementary attack skill represents the strategy, if that term can be used, of the initiate reaver. Completely lacking in style, grace, or finesse, the reaver simply tries to smash his or her weapon into the target, causing as much damage as possible. While the name of the skill reflects the reaver's chosen weapon, it can be performed with any implement the user is familiar with. Damage caused is affected by the power of the strike, the weapon used, and the user's ability in this skill and the chosen weapon. An opponent destroyed through the use of this skill rewards the reaver for their dedication to devastation. This skill can be used on inanimate objects, but there is rarely a reason to do so.

sever soul.name: sever soul
sever soul.description: To cheat death. That has been the goal of many an adventurer. With this skill, you can turn that dream to reality. When your soul dies, you dodge the scythe of Death himself, and live a hollow, soulless life afterwards.The skill is automatically on, and checked when your soul dies.

sewing.name: sewing
sewing.description: Sewing allows you to make clothes. You need two items to be able to sew: a needle and some material. If you are in the tailor shop, you can also dye the clothes a certain colour during the sewing process. The higher skill you have the better clothes you will make. The material you are going to sew must be on the ground. Syntax:  use sewing at <material> make <type> [dye <color>]. For a list of types:   use sewing at types You can also 'use sewing at cotton cloth' if you have picked cotton balls.

shield bash.name: shield bash
shield bash.description: While shields are usually used for protective purposes, they can also be used as weapons. By fooling your opponent into thinking that you are hiding behind the shield, you can catch him off-balance. Many skilled fighters can use their shield to knock their foes to the ground. Some shields are light enough that you can actually swing them, using them as a bludgeon. The more common approach is to use your weight and push the shield into the opponent, knocking him to the ground if possible.

shield wall.name: shield wall
shield wall.description: One of the most basic defensive formations any soldier knows, the shield wall has been used by many armies throughout the ages. When the entire front row of an armed group has a shield ready, they can move themselves in unison to deflect attacks not only aimed at themselves, but at their neighbors as well. The result is an overall improvement in both shield and armour effect in battle.Using a shield wall is tricky. Those maintaining the wall must all remain together or the wall will break. This applies not just when one of the members flees the room, but also when a less skilled combatant is forced to 'step' away from the rest of his teammates. When this happens, that combatant must 'step' back into place, while his fellow party members must 'step' in the same direction, to keep the wall solid.Discipline helps you maintain your formation. Leadership helps you form a better wall when you use the skill.

ship scouting.name: ship scouting
ship scouting.description: Tracking a ship is a nearly impossible task; only the best rangers are capable of doing it well. These masters have learned to recruit aid in their search, namely that of the creatures of the wild. Once sent on their mission, these creatures become messengers, which enlist still more creatures in their search. They will search for quite a while, although not indefinitely. Eventually, they will return to the spot where their quest began, and report on their discoveries, if any. This skill requires great knowledge of the world and how the animals in it live; as such, there are numerous ranger skills which boost the effectiveness of ship scouting. Also, over very long distances, animals tend to get a bit confused.

shipbuilding.name: shipbuilding
shipbuilding.description: Knowing the way of the seas and boatmanship and how ships are constructed, is a good idea for anyone who is interested in either building or buying a boat. Building a boat is an extremely long task, usually one goes to a shipyard and requests a boat be built. Once the order is placed, the buyer waits the normal several months and is then notified his boat is ready. Knowledge of the craft of shipbuilding is an invaluable asset when purchasing a boat, or when maintaining it, as you are able to do some of the simple tasks yourself, thus saving you money you would normally pay to a shipyard.

shopkeeping.name: shopkeeping
shopkeeping.description: Anyone who runs a store knows that simply putting prices on an item and waiting for a customer to pay it, is hardly enough to be able to run your store and make a profit. Knowing the buyers needs, and keeping track of the current prices of the local area help the shop owner get the best prices from his items. Also, a little knowledge in the bargaining tactics can help keep him from getting ripped off by those who wish to bargain the prices down towards their own desireable levels.

short blades.name: short blades
short blades.description: Once you have a weapon, such as a dagger or other smallish blade in hand, you will realize that using one is not as easy as some make it look. In order to effectively  make use of these crafty weapons, one must know how to wield them to make best use of their potential. Knowing when and where to attack your foe can make all the difference. While the best use of short blades is to make sneak attacks, such as a strike to the back of an unaware victim, they can come in handy in a fight if you have no better weapon available. Physical prowess can help even a master wield his weapons more effectively.

shortbow shot.name: shortbow shot
shortbow shot.description: This skill covers the very basics of bow and arrow use, with the simplest and easiest of bows -- the shortbow. Relatively fast to train as well as fire, the shortbow is a commonly used weapons by hunters as well as warriors. While fast and easy to use, the shortbow lacks stopping power, and can rarely penetrate armour or thick hide. As such, it is best used against small game or unarmoured targets. Syntax: use shortbow shot at <target> shoot <arrow>         use shortbow shot at <target>

situational warfare.name: situational warfare
situational warfare.description: While barbarians engage into combat very aggressively, there are legions that prefer much more considered strategies. Trained legionaries have a strict discipline and cause destruction in more controlled way. There are factors that may change results easily. It is important to know your enemy, and the battlefield in order to survive and to destroy effectively. Situational warfare is about the theoretical side of combat and allows legionaries to train in Kharim's arenas. While manner of lordliness has more emphasis in a real combat situation, it is always worth knowing the theory. In tough situations, learned practise might save one's life sometimes.

skinning.name: skinning
skinning.description: The hides of many animals is useful for making different garments, and in some cases, soft types of armour. Once a kill is made, skinning must begin before the corpse rots. The insides of the animal must be removed and then the hide cleaned. The hide is then cleaned, it may be treated at this point, and cut into the desireable shape. Finishing the hide may involve more shaping, stretching and cutting, or adding some features, such as straps and buttons. After all this is done, the resulting work is ready for use.

skulking.name: skulking
skulking.description: This skill allows you to skulk in the shadows. However, as movement is easy to detect, it only works for a while.

skullsplitter.name: skullsplitter
skullsplitter.description: One of the problems with putting all of your strength and weight into a single swing is that, should you miss, you are off-balance and unprotected. Knights know this, and plan their strategy accordingly.  This skill is all about timing. When a knight is fighting a foe that becomes momentarily incapacitated and unable to defend or retaliate, he may use this skill to strike with maximum force. Any weapon may be used for this skill. Note that some weapons work better against some creatures than others. Arms lore may help.

slash.name: slash
slash.description: Swordmasters for centuries have prided themselves with  the art they call swordsmanship. Graceful, yet deadly, the master of the blade is able to effortlessly slash through his opponents. A well placed strike with a blade can do  considerable amounts of damage, cutting through bone and flesh as if it was butter.

sleight.name: sleight
sleight.description: This skill allows players to take stuff without other players in the room noticing it. If the player getting the stuff succeeds there will be no message, but the player getting the stuff will not know if the skill worked. If you try to 'get all' your skill is halved. In case of special success the player doing the sleight will be told that the skill worked

sling shot.name: sling shot
sling shot.description: Tricky to learn, the sling uses a different firing motion than any other ranged weapon. At first, it seems clumsy and awkward, but it soon pays off, as the spinning motion builds up speed and momentum quickly and the release is relatively quick and oftentimes very painful. Note that, while a 'stone'-type nonweapon item can be used with this skill, 'bullet'-type weapons are far more effective. Syntax: use sling shot at <target> shoot <bullet/stone>         use sling shot at <target>

slingshot shot.name: slingshot shot
slingshot shot.description: This skill uses the smallest and least harmful of the sling-style weapons, the slingshot. With only minimal training, the skilled user can put a small, heavy bullet or stone into his victim from a safe distance, causing only small amounts of damage but making up for it with speed. Note that, while a 'stone'-type nonweapon item can be used with this skill, 'bullet'-type weapons are far more effective. Syntax: use slingshot shot at <target> shoot <bullet/stone>         use slingshot shot at <target>

small crossbow shot.name: small crossbow shot
small crossbow shot.description: Most people regard crossbows as one of the easier ranged weapons to use. They are relatively straightforward to learn, and most who practice find that loading, aiming, and firing a small crossbow tends to give good results without a lot of training. While crossbows are not the fastest weapons around, they make up for any lack of speed with a bit of extra punch from the bolts they fire. This skill covers any crossbow that can be reloaded without a stirrup or a winch. Syntax: use small crossbow shot at <target> shoot <bolt>         use small crossbow shot at <target>

sneak.name: sneak
sneak.description: This skill trains you to move stealthly around the world. When trained enough, you can enter rooms unnoticed. You can start sneaking with " use sneak " and stop sneaking with " use sneak at stop ". The affecting stat is dexterity.

songcasting.name: songcasting
songcasting.description: A bard with more % to this skill are more proficient in performing their songs. This skill is automatically in use. Better dexterity ensures also better playing skills.

songmastery.name: songmastery
songmastery.description: Long gone were the days of the True masters 13. One dark evening of remorse the God shed thirteen tears that all became hailstones of immense size, beating the realms. Each and every pummeling blast spread obliteration thorough the plane of existence we know. Thus happened the great deluge; lands were swallowed, mountains fell, canyons disappeared. From those shattered groundings it was decided. New masters would come to reign, to make the realm thrive even better! So He decided.

songscribing.name: songscribing
songscribing.description: Songscribing is used for scribing spellsong lyrics onto notebooks, from which they can then be memorized by bards who do not yet know the song by heart. Visit the guild store for the books.

soul channel.name: soul channel
soul channel.description: This animist skill lets you channel the skills and spells of your soul. It also affects how good your soul is using these skills and spells on its own. The duration of the skill depends on the technique you are trying to channel.Affecting soul's stats:  heal      - wis   slash     - str   ki attack - str and dex   light     - int and wisUsage: use soul channel at <heal|slash|ki attack|light> [on <target>]

soulbound fate.name: soulbound fate
soulbound fate.description: While commanders of Kharim are known to be excellent strategists on the battlefield, they are also known to command armies who lack traditional discipline. Legionaries of Kharim capture souls and enslave them to serve for them. While weaker souls are less likely to rebel, the stronger souls do not necessarily accept their destiny as easily. Aggressive souls may even pose a potent threat even though they cannot physically harm their master. Nevertheless, this threat is seen so remarkable that many legionaries consume significant amount of time in order to protect themselves from spiritual attacks.

soulspeak.name: soulspeak
soulspeak.description: This skill imparts the gift of speech to inanimate objects for a short period of time. Basically anything you can look at is a valid target - if it has a soul, that is.The legends tell of master animists, capable of keeping up a conversation with rocks and trees. While seemingly useless skill, there might be some things worth knowing that the non-living have sensed about their surroundings. An animist is never truly alone!Usage: use soulspeak at <item> about <whatever, preferably whole sentence>

soulsplitter.name: soulsplitter
soulsplitter.description: This fierce tactic allows an animist to strike a weak spot on the enemy, causing the creature's soul to shatter. These fragments of the soul are considerably weaker than the original creature, and vanquishing them causes great pain to the original. You can't kill an opponent by splitting his soul into small pieces, but you surely can make him weaker this way. Only certain creatures are suspectible to this attack. You need to be wielding a long blade or a bludgeon, or have a free hand and skill in martial arts. Skill in slash, pound or iron palm helps you hit accurately.Having your soul fragments destroyed is painful, and often causes great confusion in the target. Soul and body are connected, and broken soul can mean hard time fixing or regenerating the broken body. It is also easier to get confused in battle when your soul is damaged. Soul is a marvellous thing, though - it can heal over time.Usage: use soulsplitter [at target]

spell parry.name: spell parry
spell parry.description: A knight well-educated in both warfare and spellcasting can make use of this skill. He keeps his ears open for a specific spell chant, and then tries to react with this warning to deflect the spell called into being by that chant. If the knight is skilled and fast enough, the spell can be harmlessly deflected. Spell parry does not block every spell. Area and touch spells cannot be parried, nor can enchantments like curses. Only ranged, single-target spells can be blocked. In order to deflect a spell, you must wield a weapon or shield with the same damage type as the spell itself, or a shield with resistance to the spell's damage type. For example, to parry a fire spell, you must could use a flaming sword or a shield of fire resistance. (Magical weapons are needed, any properties from weapon material are not powerful enough)Syntax: use spell parry [to see list of watched chants]         use spell parry at <new chant>         use spell parry at <new chant> replace <old chant>         use spell parry at clear [removes ALL chants]

spiritual conduct.name: spiritual conduct
spiritual conduct.description: One of the most important things in mastering the art  of harming, is the ability to hit the target with the  spell.  No matter how capable the caster is in chant,  the spell still needs to be finished by landing a hit  on the target.  Knowledge of this skill helps guiding  the way of the priest, granting a steady-handed aim.

stab.name: stab
stab.description: The most common form of attacking when using  short blades, such as daggers and other small edged weapons, is the stabbing maneuver. The intent of this move is to bury the blade of the weapon into the flesh of the target. This takes a great deal of skill since  you must close into close-quarter range in order to do this. Those skilled in this art can easily use  their weapons to inflict deep trauma on their targets.

staff sling shot.name: staff sling shot
staff sling shot.description: The staff sling is rather like a small piece of artillery. Used properly, it can hurl heavy items to great distances, where they hail down on their targets with great speed and impact. The staff sling is a little on the clumsy side to use, and can't be used in close combat at all, but the effect more than makes up for these restrictions. Note that, while a 'stone'-type nonweapon item can be used with this skill, 'bullet'-type weapons are far more effective. Syntax: use staff sling shot at <target> shoot <bullet/stone>         use staff sling shot at <target>

stalwart stance.name: stalwart stance
stalwart stance.description: The best defence is always offense. While fighting several monsters at a time is second nature to the members of The Crimson Brigade, but the most important tactics lie in focusing the efforts on the most dangerous opponents while other members of your party deal with the lesser enemies. In order to effectively focus on the target, one must wield a proper weapon and a shield. A member of The Crimson Brigade who fully commits his actions against their opponent can inspire awe in their friends and instill fear in the foes. A member of the Brigade can use two optional commands during stance: 'focus on <target>' to change the locked target and 'break stance' to continue fighting without the stance.

stampede.name: stampede
stampede.description: Getting a single led animal to rush forward and ram or crush a victim, without actually riding it, is tricky. Getting a whole herd to do it is much tougher. Either way, this skill lets you do so with deadly effects. While the difficulty increases with more than one led mount, so does the damage.

stance of the righteous.name: stance of the righteous
stance of the righteous.description: Holy defenders employ this skill to great effect protecting the weak against the hordes of evil. With a rallying cry and a firm fighting stance, they prepare themselves for a brutal beating, turning their body and mind to the task of deflecting and avoiding blows.
