As their confidence rises, and the spirits of their enemies fall, they can even refresh their own lost energy as the fight ensues.

stapling shot.name: stapling shot
stapling shot.description: Crossbows have enough driving force to put a bolt through flesh, bone, even stone and metal. A particularly well-placed shot might be able to get through all four -- and, as such, put a bolt through someone's foot and halfway into the floor. It's painful, debilitating, and keeps them from running away for a few seconds. Syntax: use stapling shot at <target> shoot <bolt>         use stapling shot at <target> Note that whatever bolt you use will end up snapped in half, no matter what the outcome is.

stargazing.name: stargazing
stargazing.description: Long ago, there were not detailed maps for people to navigate the lands. Roads were non-existent outside the major settlements. Sailors, who never had maps or roads to guide them, discovered navigation skills, using the stars as landmarks. This art also works well for land navigation. Using a sextant can get you much better results than without.

stay.name: stay
stay.description: This straightforward command is used to make your beasts of burden wait for you to return. When so commanded, the target -- which you must be riding or leading -- will stop and will not allow another to ride it or lead it. How long the animal will wait is based on how well trained it is, and how commanding your presence is.

study creature.name: study creature
study creature.description: Knowing your enemies is vital, for both creating a proper protection and finding a weakness to abuse. Folklorists study creatures with this skill, but analysis of magic lore, consider and detect alignment are usually needed to analyse the input. Studying creatures is sometimes a dangerous business, since some creatures do not approve this intrusion on their privacy.

stun.name: stun
stun.description: One of the most powerful facets of hand to hand combat, is the ability to land a blow that knocks your opponent  senseless. A stunned opponent is unable to conduct his own attacks, defend himself, or flee, which puts him at your complete mercy. Those who are trained in the ability to execute these blows, are able to do it more often and for longer then those who are not.

stunned maneuvers.name: stunned maneuvers
stunned maneuvers.description: One of the most helpless situations one can get into while he is fighting, is when he is stunned. While stunned, one is virtually helpless, the fight could be over at that instant. Of course, with the proper training and practice, one might be able to shrug off the effects of being stunned. Not only could he recover from the effects more quickly, he could also resist the effects of a stun entirely.

stunning shot.name: stunning shot
stunning shot.description: Sling-type weapons require ammunition that is heavy and dense. The impact with such weapons can be quite potent, however, with a little practice and clever aiming, the effect can be more than merely painful. A hit to the head can daze, a hit to the torso can knock the wind out of the target, and an elbow/knee strike can throw the target off-balance. Experienced slingers use these and other weak points to try to stun their targets. Syntax: use stunning shot at <target> shoot <bullet/stone>         use stunning shot at <target>

support vortex.name: support vortex
support vortex.description: One unique aspect of vortices is that more than one person can help create them. In particular, up to two additional 'casters' may perform supporting roles, hopefully allowing the vortex to stabilize more quickly. Naturally, the faster the process is done, the less stressful it is for all concerned.This skill is automatically in effect when supporting a vortex; be aware however that you will be in direct contact with the magical energies involved, and hence will be drained more than regular bystanders.

surveying.name: surveying
surveying.description: This skill helps with creating ship maps. Having a captain who is also proficient at surveying will drastically increase a ship navigator's chances of successfully creating a map. For new adventurers, this is highly valuable as they might not have the finances to hire an experienced navigator.

swamp cultivation.name: swamp cultivation
swamp cultivation.description: From the early times even before the Church of Triadism had been founded, the worshippers respected their god by tending the swamps. The early devotees took care of the swamp and made sure it flourished. As Curath murdered his brother Galean, the blood was spilled to the swamp. With this blood, the Great Swamp gave birth to Burglefloogah. The triadists who worship Burglefloogah do this same thing. They use poisons and mixtures of blood to grow bad seeds and satomalums on the swamp. The most skilled triadists who know the most about swamp cultivation are able to grow both satomalums and bad seeds more rapidly than others.

swashbuckling.name: swashbuckling
swashbuckling.description: Sometimes the word is mightier than the sword. There are situations in in history that prove this trite saying correct. When the enemy cannot be slain by shedding blood, it is time to act differently. Common to all great rulers and leaders is that while they are excellent combatants, they are also superb orators. Their ability to speak and to manipulate masses is something that makes them powerful. Swashbuckling is a coined term to describe noisy and boastful swordsmen. It is based on a combat style using a sword and a buckler, thus swashing and making noise with the buckler. Nevertheless, such boastful emanation and skills in oratory attract certain people to join for the cause. Being part of a larger group gives people confidence and false sense of security. A skilled swashbuckler is able to make people agitated and uses peer pressure to force crowds into working the way he or she intended.

swift defence.name: swift defence
swift defence.description: This skill helps you negate speed penalty from parry on your primary weapon. This technique requires that you are wielding a shield on your other hand.

swift scalpel.name: swift scalpel
swift scalpel.description: Become a true expert at slicing and dissecting organs from corpses.

swim.name: swim
swim.description: Water covers two thirds of the world. Unfortunately, if  you don't know how to swim, you won't be able to traverse much without a boat, and boats are kinda heavy to carry along with you. Swimming is very useful, allowing one to easily traverse rivers, lakes and oceans. Make sure when you go swimming that you aren't carrying that iron platemail,  while you can still swim when loaded, it hinders you greatly, and you might not be able to swim at all if you are carrying  too much.

switch weapon.name: switch weapon
switch weapon.description: Some of the more powerful fighters in the land, do a little showboating. During a fight, they toss their blade from one hand, to the other. Some are able to do this with a blade in each hand, tossing them both in the air and catching them in different hands, all while not missing a beat. While most of us might not feel comfortable tossing our weapons in the air during a fight, being able to change weapons can come in very handy. Some weapons are better against some foes, and who knows, maybe a little showboating won't hurt a little?

take prisoner.name: take prisoner
take prisoner.description: A knight can prove his worth in battle by beating foes to a bloody pulp. However, a knight can also prove himself by capturing opponents. Rather than dull his blade on minor threats not worthy of his full attention, he can round them up and send them to the garrison at the knights' guild. Their possessions can be confiscated later. It is also possible to take stronger opponents prisoner. While tougher to do, it is stronger proof of a knight's ability in battle. Skill and charisma hasten the skill's use.

tame mount.name: tame mount
tame mount.description: The world is full of animals and monsters, some of which are cute and cuddly, others feral and dangerous. However one thing that seperates the intelligent races from these beasts is that beasts can be domesticated, tamed, and controlled. Through the ages countless types of animals have been brought in from the wild and made into servants, guards, and beasts of burden. It is a difficult task, requiring time, willpower, and (all too often) resistance to pain. However the rewards speak for themselves.

telescope operation.name: telescope operation
telescope operation.description: One of the tools rangers have perfected is the use of the telescope. The telescope is a terrific tool to gain visual information at great distances. Learning to use one to maximize its performance takes great skill, as this tool is a fairly new discovery.

tempt.name: tempt
tempt.description: While many may admit to being followers of good, or followers of evil, most of these fall into the casual believers, who may not show the true sides of their faith. Those who are already  strong in their belief may try to reinforce another's faith through instruction and encouragement. Many who turn out to be skilled in this art, become teachers and ministers in their faith.

theology of darkness.name: theology of darkness
theology of darkness.description: The story is told from father to son. It's a story that is believed to have happened sometime nearing the end of the Mosaic era. It was the time of the unrest that eventually led to witch hunts during which many innocent people lost their lives. One of these people that survived was Sawar of Taegor, who personally witnessed a very powerful intervention by Draen-Dalar. The story tells that Sawar was surrounded by people who wanted to burn him alive, when the sky turned to black and it started raining soot. Suddenly the torches the mob was carrying burned out and people started collapsing down until there was only a single person standing. That person was Sawar who had been praying for guidance from the god he was worshipping. Even this day, the Dark Gods are known to protect and grant power to their worshippers. It is also often the case that only the most influential members of the congregation get to have the access to study what is considered the most crucial of doctrines, the Theology of Darkness. This doctrine makes it easier to understand the whims of gods in their prayers.

theory of corrosion.name: theory of corrosion
theory of corrosion.description: Corrosive magics are one of the most feared kinds of magic, due to its destructive nature. Even winning a battle against a creature who wields this terrible power can leave scars of corroded flesh that will never fade. To this extent there are some twisted minds that have gone beyond even this and found ways to hone their skills to bring even more destrutive forces to  their arsenal.

theory of electrical engineering.name: theory of electrical engineering
theory of electrical engineering.description: Lightning is a very powerful force of nature, hence while many claim to wield its power, a few stand out above the rest and truly wield it with all its might. Some say those who have mastered this form of magic have traveled into the heart of a thunderstorm and grasped the very essence of their power there. Whether this is true or not, those who call themselves masters wield their power with much greater brilliance than those who cannot make  such a claim.

theory of mental power.name: theory of mental power
theory of mental power.description: Those who use the powers of the mind, are taught early on that most beings only make use of a small percentage of their mind's potential. Taking this into consideration, some may be able to truly unlock their mind's power and transform this into usable energy for their magic. Of the few that are able to unlock any psionic powers from themselves at all, even fewer are able to break past the idea of 'normal thought', and utilize their talents to their full potential.

theory of pyromania.name: theory of pyromania
theory of pyromania.description: Some may have been arsonists, or pyromaniacs in their childhood. Many may have caused much trouble during their upbringing playing with fire. Whatever the case may be, these are the type of spellcasters who truly control the element of fire. They are able make their spells burn hotter and fiercer then the others. Many say that this is due only to the fascination they hold of fire, and this is said to be a spot of madness. No matter what is said, the truth is that they truly have mastered their  powers.

throw control.name: throw control
throw control.description: This skill is checked whenever you throw a potion. Higher skill will guarantee  high levels of accuracy. The potion will have full effect when it hits the  target accurately.

throw weight.name: throw weight
throw weight.description: While size and strength generally makes one a better fighter, it takes some skill in using that extra power to its full effectiveness. Just being big doesn't mean you are a good fighter, in fact many giants have been beaten soundly by dwarves. It's not brute force that wins a fight, but skill, the size and strength only helps a bit.

tinkering.name: tinkering
tinkering.description: Tinkering! Quick fingers and a keen mind can create gadgets out of various materials and objects. Controlling what exactly is created is quite difficult, but such is gnomic life!use tinkering at <obj1>,<obj2>,<obj3> spend <minutes>Components can be pretty much whatever, but there are some limitations. They must be on the ground in the room with you.The time spent tinkering is announced in minutes, the range is 20 - 600 minutes. You cannot do much else while tinkering, but you can end the process at any point - it'll cost you the materials though.The created gadget is affected by at least the following things: starting materials (the three objects), time spent tinkering, your profiency in tinkering skill, your level, your background, your gender, your name, the moon, the weather, the season, the time, what you have eaten, who's your daddy and the current leading guild.Example: use tinkering at sword,shoe,bag spend 60

tinning.name: tinning
tinning.description: One of the greatest, neverending need for almost all creatures, is the need for food. Unfortunately, carrying a slain corpse around is not a very tasteful or easy  way to keep food at hand. Anyone who needs to survive for a while and provide a practical source of food for himself, learns to skin the corpses and refine the flesh and store it in containers, where it is much better  enjoyed, especially in the future. The more skillful one is at the art of tinning, the better the quality of the food he can store. Also, proficiency is needed in order to not break a tinning kit.

torch creation.name: torch creation
torch creation.description: One of the realities one must face in the world, is that it is usually light by day and dark by night. Those who need light to see, often come into trouble when night comes. While lamps and magical lights are readily available near civilized areas, out in the wilderness, sources of light are not easy to come by. For the most part, just setting a branch on fire doesn't do the trick, as the branch burns dimly and then out in a matter of minutes. Being able to find the right type of wood and ready it with special oil and cloth to make it burn brightly and for a long period of time is what makes the art of torch making.

totem challenge.name: totem challenge
totem challenge.description: With this skill animists challenge the evil part of an animal's soul. You need a totem weapon for this skill, wielded in your primary hand. If you don't specify a power level, average is assumed. Not all animals are suitable for this skill, but quite a few are.The valid power levels are poor, weak, average, excellent, awesome and divine.Usage: use totem challenge at <animal> [try <powerlevel>]

toxic immunity.name: toxic immunity
toxic immunity.description: Barbarians tough physical training has given them inherent abilities to shrug off or ignore most maladys that can inflict the normal adventurer. Poisons that may make a normal person bed-ridden for a week, may not even be noticed to a strong barbarian. This ability is also useful not for only natural occuring poisons, but also helps against attacks which come in the form of toxins and poison.

track.name: track
track.description: There are few tasks more difficult, then following someone who has a head start on you, and you have no idea where they are headed. Rangers are highly trained trackers, able to follow trails left in the wilderness that are sometimes over a week old. A skilled tracker can even defeat the normal counter measures to being tracked, such as doubling over ones tracks.Usage:  use track (no target) or          use track at monster/playerWhen you specify a target only the tracks of that target are being  looked for, and you will follow the tracks if found. You can stop  following with 'stop'. Otherwise you look for any tracks.

trample.name: trample
trample.description: The mere mass of a rider and his mount can be enough to crush his opponents underfoot (or hoof, as the case may be). A skilled rider can use his steed's weight as a weapon, either with a running start or by rearing up. Either way, the effect can be devastating. Of course, knowledge of combat riding is required for effective use of this skill.

tree herding.name: tree herding
tree herding.description: Treeherders, the shepherds of the forest are the selected few who fully understand the nature of all trees, even the magical ones. From acorn to sappling to a fully realized tree, it only requires good soil, water and lots of love and care. Using this skill, treeherder can count his children and grow new ones.

true reaving.name: true reaving
true reaving.description: This skill is the most heartless, brutal, and overall most fun attack the reavers have. When used, it allows the reaver to strike again and again, hitting every single piece of armour, clothing, jewelry, and all other worn items the target is using, in addition to their weapons and shield. The fierce beating damages the target and all gear in use, and can be repeated until they have all been completely destroyed. The only items spared from this barbaric assault are items carried, but not worn, by the target.

tsunami push.name: tsunami push
tsunami push.description: This skill might seem harmless to an untrained observer, but anyone proficient in the martial arts knows how dangerous it is. Using more of the power of the spirit than the body, the attacker focusses all his chi into a single push. If successful, the victim will be thrown backwards, as if hurled by a creature many times your size. The victim may also be knocked around during the trip, which is distracting to say the least.

tumbling attack.name: tumbling attack
tumbling attack.description: One of the most difficult aspects of combat, is  attempting to hit an opponent who is actively attempting to avoid your attacks. If you are able to calculate your opponents move ahead of time, you may be able to feint and catch him off-guard. This tactic can effectively negate some of defensive maneuvers of your opponent.

tumbling dodge.name: tumbling dodge
tumbling dodge.description: The truly dextrous often at least try the art of gymnastics or tumbling as a child. This skill is based on the same overall ideas for a much more pragmatic purpose -- evading blows in combat. By leaping, flipping, and rolling around, the user makes himself a lot harder to strike in battle, in exchange for all melee attacks they would normally make themselves. High dexterity is crucial for this skill!

turn undead.name: turn undead
turn undead.description: This skill forces weaker undead beings to return to their plane of existence. User needs to hold a relic to be able to turn undeads. Purity of heart and a mighty relic increases chance to turn bigger undeads. The use of this skill is considered a good act.

turnblade.name: turnblade
turnblade.description: Knights study the mechanics of battle very carefully, trying to find any shortcomings in their own combat ability just as they do for their opponents. Many a knight has come to blows with a creature with far greater attack power, which mortal weapons cannot surpass. This skill is suited for such times. By using a foe's own strength and power against him, a knight can use this skill to effectively cause a creature to hit itself. Unfortunately, smarter monsters learn quickly from their mistakes, and react accordingly.

unarmed parry.name: unarmed parry
unarmed parry.description: This skill helps you to parry incoming blows with your bare hands, it is automatically in effect, the actual parry chance depends on your set parry. Usage: parry <0-51> The points you put to parry are deducted from your hit bonus. Parry without arguments shows your current defence/attack state

upgrade armour.name: upgrade armour
upgrade armour.description: Every armour, from a simple cloth shirt to a king's crown, can have at least one part that's not as good as the others. With this skill, an experienced armoursmith can swap out a worse part with a better one, improving the armour's overall quality. Skill and components needed vary by target's starting quality:Exceptional+ needs 51% skill, one strip of primal material and 5 enchanted parts. Good+ needs 26% skill, 5kg divine material and 5 exceptional-quality parts. Standard- needs 5kg exceptional material and 5 good-quality parts. The 'parts' are grips for held-slot items, and armour parts for everything else.Each armour can be upgraded up to three times -- worse armours can be upgraded more than better ones. Each upgrade 'tier' goes up to a maximum 5 out of 5, and must be completed before the next one can start. The effect the merchant can give is based on this skill chance, repair armour skill chance, int score, and their mastery of the material of the armour. Syntax: use upgrade armour at <armour> The armour, the components, and all required tools must be in the merchant's inventory.

upgrade item.name: upgrade item
upgrade item.description: Stoves, furniture, books, lanterns -- every item eventually starts to show wear and tear. Parts fray, leak, or don't move like they're supposed to. This skill lets an experienced handyman replace broken, badly-fitting, or damaged components with better ones, improving the item's quality. Skill and components needed vary by target's starting quality:Exceptional+ needs 51% skill and one strip of primal material. Good+ needs 26% skill and 10kg divine material. Standard- needs 10kg exceptional material. No 'parts' are needed. Each item can be upgraded up to three times -- worse items can be upgraded more than better ones. Each upgrade 'tier' goes up to a maximum 5 out of 5, and must be completed before the next one can start. The effect the merchant can give is based on this skill chance, repair item skill chance, int score, and their mastery of the material of the item. Syntax: use upgrade item at <item> The item can be in the merchant's inventory, or on the floor. The materials and all required tools must be in the merchant's inventory.

upgrade weapon.name: upgrade weapon
upgrade weapon.description: Every weapon, from a simple stone club to a general's war sword, can have at least one part that's not as good as the others. With this skill, an experienced weaponsmith can swap out a worse part with a better one, improving the weapon's overall quality. Skill and components needed vary by target's starting quality:Exceptional+ needs 51% skill, one strip of primal material and 5 enchanted parts. Good+ needs 26% skill, 5kg divine material and 5 exceptional-quality parts. Standard- needs 5kg exceptional material and 5 good-quality parts. The 'parts' are grips for shields, and weapon parts for everything else.Each weapon can be upgraded up to three times -- worse weapons can be upgraded more than better ones. Each upgrade 'tier' goes up to a maximum 5 out of 5, and must be completed before the next one can start. The effect the merchant can give is based on this skill chance, repair weapon skill chance, int score, and their mastery of the material of the weapon. Syntax: use upgrade weapon at <weapon> The weapon, the components, and all required tools must be in the merchant's inventory.

vampiric blow.name: vampiric blow
vampiric blow.description: The followers of Kharim use this offensive skill to leech health from their opponents and transfer it to their own bodies. While any weapon is good enough to inflict damage, a chaos sword is needed to get the full benefit of the vampiric act of draining.

vandalism.name: vandalism
vandalism.description: Vandalism allows one mean old barbarian to leave a short message on the walls of a city. There are several predefined messages or you can write one of your own. This being a very naughty act will result in some bad response if caught in the act. Syntax: use 'vandalism' [direction of wall] [write <message>]

vengeful haunting.name: vengeful haunting
vengeful haunting.description: This skill tries to channel a ghost into your enemy. If successful, the target will be confused for a while, and hindered for a longer while. The attack also deals some damage. This is a very evil act to do against all but the vilest of opponents, and somewhat evil against even them. The channeling requires great deal of concentration and can be done only on unsuspecting target. It resembles ordinary ghost channeling, so it is not an offensive-looking skill. Skill in ghost channeling is required for this skill to work.Evil. Sometimes you have to be evil to do good. With this skill, you channel a ghost through your enemy, not through yourself. When inside the opponent's head, or whatever it uses for control and thinking, the ghost does what it can to hinder the enemy. The effects vary from compulsion to start a pumpkin farm to more devious loss of battle skills, depending on the ghost who does the possessing. It is suggested in the order that only the most pure people may attempt this necromantic skill, but the need for power to slay the evil has made many a liberator use this skill. Remember, with great power comes great responsibility.Usage: use vengeful haunting at <target>

ventriloquism.name: ventriloquism
ventriloquism.description: Sometimes there are situations when a fast mind, not a fast blade is the only remedy. There are many tricks that the masters are able to employ. One such trick is the art of throwing one's voice. By carefully using several distracting methods that draw attention away from themselves they can talk, and give the false impression that the sound is coming from somewhere besides their own mouth. Of course this may not get you out of all situations. Many who have learned this skill only do it as a pastime.

vessel of death.name: vessel of death
vessel of death.description: When Death is calling, the soul answers. When soul has exited the body, the person is dead. But there are exceptions to the rule. Kharim's legionaries are known to command souls whether it is a soul that belongs to them, or to someone else. While the souls attempt to answer to the call of Death, legionaries may prevent this by turning body into a spiritual vessel which prevents the soul from leaving. Nevertheless, souls usually are not submissive and it may prove to be troublesome or consuming to command souls and nobody can continue doing it for a very long time.

veterinarian.name: veterinarian
veterinarian.description: Druids are masters of the natural world, but also strive for the balance between man and beast. Training in this skill drastically improves the effect of most healing spells (including runic heal and regeneration) on any tamed creature.

vial throwing.name: vial throwing
vial throwing.description: With this skill one may throw holy vials upon any living creature, shattering the glass and releasing the holy water. Thrown upon evil or undead beings, blessed water will burn the skin causing  severe damage. Blessed water heals the wounds of pure people and gives some minor protection against forces of evil. Beware foul vials containing unholy blessing as they will nourish the seed of evil. Skill percent as well as 'mastery of holy vials' affects chance of hitting the target. Effect depends on the amount of water left in vial and strength of blessing. You must hold the vial to be able to throw it.

vital points.name: vital points
vital points.description: It must be some secret martial arts technique.

vortex analysis.name: vortex analysis
vortex analysis.description: Sometimes, it seems like a vortex is simply never going to grow, and that you are just pouring mana down a large drain, never to be seen again. With this skill, you can finally know for sure!The trick is in recognizing the various little eddies and currents that are flowing within the pool of magic. In truth, anyone with the proper training can do this for any vortex, whether they are magically bound to it or not.

wandmaking.name: wandmaking
wandmaking.description: One of the more powerful natures of magic is the ability to be stored, or imbued onto items enchanting them. While the scope of this type of magic is beyond many, there are some who are able to craft items, enchanted by magic. Most magical items and artifacts are the result of enchantments. The simplest form  of enchantment is the storing the power of a spell into an item  to be discharged later at will. Most of these types of items are  used as wands, as the nature of the enchantment and the spell  allow the easiest manipulations into these items. To be able to  imbue a wand with a spell requires much knowledge and concentration.  Only spells which a user is vastly proficient in can be melded  into an item, and even then there is much uncertainty that it  will even work at all.

warhorse philosophy.name: warhorse philosophy
warhorse philosophy.description: Hooves of the centaur warriors have wrecked havoc at the battlefields as long as centaurs have existed. But the attack is still unrefined and undirected leaving much room for improvement. The centaur instructors developed new tactics to make the hoof attacks more precise and cause more severe injuries to the opponents. The skill can only be learned fully in practice.

wave crest strike.name: wave crest strike
wave crest strike.description: The amount of physical damage one can do with a single hand in a single motion is limited. Aiming for vulnerable spots, like the neck, helps. This skill extends that thinking to the next level. By trying to hit the two major arteries on the side of the neck, you can throw off the rhythm of your enemy's pulse there. In a heated battle, even a short stutter in the flow of blood to the brain can cause exceptional damage and distracting pain.

way of the scythe.name: way of the scythe
way of the scythe.description: The most powerful reavers have reached an ascended philosophy on the subject of destruction. To them, it is no longer about the strength of their arm or the sharpness of their blade. It is not even about knowing when or where to strike. The will to destroy comes from within, from the dark energy that throbs in the heart of every reaver, and needs only to be let out. By drawing upon this power, the ascended reaver can use his or her skills to strike blows that shatter shields and rend flesh while using a weapon as seemingly ineffective as a broken stick.

way of the tarmalen.name: way of the tarmalen
way of the tarmalen.description: Mastering the Way of the Tarmalen is useful for every healer from journeyman to master. The closer to Tarmalen you get, the more revelations you will see and experience.

whips.name: whips
whips.description: Any long, flexible, lashing weapon is a whip. While their original purpose is to cause long, shallow wounds that are painful but not usually lethal, some more dangerous whips have been invented that use the same basic technique. Wielding a whip is more of an art than a science, as the twisting and swirling of the weapon draws an energetic, if bloody, design in the air. Masters of the whip can tear through muscle or even bone with a well-placed lash, whereas a novice is more likely to cut himself than his target.

wilderness survival.name: wilderness survival
wilderness survival.description: Wilderness survival is automatically in effect.  Being proficient in wilderness survival allows you to live off land and therefore when you are outdoors you do not get hungry nearly as often.

winged horse kick.name: winged horse kick
winged horse kick.description: The reason why some weapons have all the weight at one end is simple: the force is greatly magnified when you use leverage to your advantage. Such weapons as warhammers and battleaxes do massive damage when swung in a wide arc. This skill lets you use your foot in the same way. By leaping with a twist and swinging with all your might, not only can you cause more damage than a standard kick, but you can kick through more than one target, or even send them flying into each other.

wipe tracks.name: wipe tracks
wipe tracks.description: This skill can clear all the tracks from a room, making it virtually impossible to hunt someone. Skilled users can also instruct their parties on how to move without leaving tracks.

woodland stealth.name: woodland stealth
woodland stealth.description: This skill allows a player to move stealthily and undetected outdoors. This skill also works indoors but your chances of success are lower. Using camouflage also helps while using woodland stealth. This skill is automatically in effect for rangers, others need to really TRY to succeed.

wrath of hells wind.name: wrath of hells wind
wrath of hells wind.description: A reaver whose lust for destruction does not end at the burning of a single target finds this skill very useful. Using a flaming weapon (the type does not matter, so long as the reaver is skilled with it), a powerful swing, and some dark energy, he or she can send a burst of fire directly at the ground. This causes a mix of flames, smoke, and bits of burning char to lash out at his opponents, burning and choking them. You must be in combat to use this skill.

wriggle free.name: wriggle free
wriggle free.description: Trained by those who value their mobility over their raw power, this skill lets you try to slip out of the grasp of anyone who grapples you. Use of all arms and legs to break out is assumed, as the user kicks and bashes frantically in the attempt to escape.

zapping.name: zapping
zapping.description: Wands are the simplest form of enchanted items, items that store magic inside them for later use. While these are relatively simple compared to artifacts crafted by gods or the like, they are not simple at all. Nasty consequences can befall those who attempt to use items such as wands with no knowledge of the type of magic that allows wands to hold and discharge spells.  While some say that using wands is as simple as pointing a finger, those who are not familiar with wands and attempt to use them can bring about disastrous results. Carrying one wand is always safe, when carrying more wands the skill zapping will help pointing out when you are pushing your luck too much. Everyone knows the first question any apprentice asks when being taught this skill is: 'Which end do I point again?'

absorbing meld.name: absorbing meld
absorbing meld.description: With the spell the caster can link himself with their rift entity, allowing their minion to share a portion of their pain. The spell will activate when the caster takes a large amount of damage. The combined power of the casters entities will decrease this damage threshold, and also increase the spell duration. Knowledge of the spell will allow more damage to be shared with the rift entity. The damage is distributed but not lessened (unless the riftwalker is particularly powerful), and can still kill. A magic entity is known to enhance this spell in the following ways:* Enough 'Defensive valour' will increase how long this spell lasts. * Enough 'Defensive talent' and you will be able to refresh the spell. This spell uses 4 rift sparks.

absorption aura.name: absorption aura
absorption aura.description: A master channeller knows the rules about energy redirection and storage like no other. They can focus this ability into the absorption aura. Not only will this anti-energy field siphon away some of the mana, fire, and lightning damage coming at the caster, but it will store it for later use. Any damage prevented by this aura can be added to spells of the same type the caster uses while the aura remains intact. The aura can only store a fixed amount, dictated by the caster's mastery of channelling. Any energy over that is released back into the environment, in a safer, even beneficial, form.

achromatic eyes.name: achromatic eyes
achromatic eyes.description: The little fly, dragon they once called Him had an obsession towards the other races of his own size. No sprite was he, but still this faerie dragon wanted to converse with others. Sadly, others were incredulous of this little wingbeater. Had he no other choice but to conjure up his lil' magicks and weave a song that made them think alike..  (duration: song's %) (power: song's %, charisma and guildlevel)
achromatic eyes.spell_vocals: Stand confused with lack of comprehension, pagan of mine for I know of the true belief, while death calls you, compel your soul to the true belief, for I offer you this redemption in the harmony of my true belief..

acid arrow.name: acid arrow
acid arrow.description: The most basic of the true acid attack spells, is the spell acid arrow. Upon command, a thin stream of acid, much the size of an arrow, leaps from the caster's fingers onto the target, where it loses shape and splashes the  hopeless victim. While this spell has a relatively low damage potential compared to the more powerful acid spells, for the effort it takes to cast, it is feared because it can be used against a target's equipment.

acid blast.name: acid blast
acid blast.description: The most powerful acid spell that can be cast against a single foe, is the spell acid blast. Not only burning the armour of the target, this spell causes tremendous damage to the target. This spell takes such a drain on the caster's resources that it is usually only used by those who are very proficient in acidic magics.

acid rain.name: acid rain
acid rain.description: There are some cases when one might wish to rain down fury upon a group of foes. The spell acid rain was made for just such an occasion. By summoning a rain of acid that falls from the skies, a caster can hit several targets at once. This spell takes a great deal of concentration and effort to be able to attain its deadly effects.

acid ray.name: acid ray
acid ray.description: This spell is a powerful attack spell. It is a true acid spell, like the spell acid arrow, however it is much more powerful. Instead of just a arrow of acid, a beam of acid flies towards the target. This spell requires a bit more concentration and effort then the spell acid arrow, but also gives much more powerful results.

acid shield.name: acid shield
acid shield.description: The acid shield is a fizzing paper-thin layer of a powerful chemical that hovers just off of the subject's body. When this chemical touches acid or other corrossive objects, the danger is reduced as the object and the shield react with each other, diluting or possibly eliminating the acid before it contacts the protected individual.

acid storm.name: acid storm
acid storm.description: Undoubtedly the most powerful and demanding acid  attack spell known, is the spell acid storm. Similar to the spell acid rain, this spell affects a group of targets with acid damage, but the similarities stop there. Instead of raining acid, this spell  creates acid that envelopes the target and swirls  around it for a few seconds. The intensity is remarkable. It also takes tremendous amount of concentration and effort is needed to activate this spell.

acid wind.name: acid wind
acid wind.description: A more powerful show of the potential of acidic magic spells then the spell disruption, is the spell acid wind. While not using any actual acid, it causes a sharp breeze  to swirl around the target. While the breeze isn't actually acid, it is very acidic in nature. It can damage the target and also do damage to his equipment. It is said that this is  one of the slowest and most painful ways to kill a foe that cannot escape.

aegis.name: aegis
aegis.description: Aegis is an effective way to prevent damage to armours and weapons during  combat.  Component: adamantium and item.

agility accelerator.name: agility accelerator
agility accelerator.description: This spell affects the recipient's dex. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

air shield.name: air shield
air shield.description: The spell conjures an air mask before the target's face, allowing the target to breathe underwater.  However, the longer the spell has been on, the less you can stay submerged. The mask also helps against poison cloud. Your stats, spell percentage and masteries help with the spell.

airsteel.name: airsteel
airsteel.description: It is good defence spell improving protection.

amnesia.name: amnesia
amnesia.description: This spell affects the recipient's wis. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

aneurysm.name: aneurysm
aneurysm.description: Those who follow the evil gods are granted the power with which to cause harm to their foes. One such spell is the wicked spell known as aneurysm. With a mere touch, they are able to cause great pain and injury to the target. Not designed to kill, this spell still gives the target horrific pain, mostly in the head region, which is the most sensitive spot to target with such a spell. It is said there may be no defense against this type of attack, which is why it is so feared. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

animal aspect.name: animal aspect
animal aspect.description: With this spell you can give someone the aspect of an animal.Usage: cast animal aspect at <player>

animal soul link.name: animal soul link
animal soul link.description: Animal soul link creates a duplex link between you and your animal soul mount. With this link, you can gracefully dismiss your mount, refresh it or drain power from it. The mount must be conjured into being first, but it need not be present - it helps, though. Draining your mount is difficult and best left to more skilled casters.Usage: cast animal soul link at <dismiss|refresh|drain>

animate golem.name: animate golem
animate golem.description: The ultimate act of channelling is to force life energy into inanimate objects. This is not merely telekinesis, but the creation of an elemental spirit within lifeless matter. While extremely draining, the caster can create a semi-intelligent magical machine that obeys his simple commands. Different materials react differently to the process of animation, just as they react differently to other situations. First-time casters should cast this spell at themselves for more information.

anti magic field.name: anti magic field
anti magic field.description: The spell known as anti-magic field is a peculiar spell indeed. Once cast on an area, no magic can be cast. It also creates an aura of such unease, that no skills can be attempted while inside. This spell is a terrific defensive spell, which can greatly hinder the power of an attacking foe, or group of foes. Placed in the right places, it is a deadly weapon, denying a party their magic and skills.

appease ghost.name: appease ghost
appease ghost.description: With this spell you negotiate a ghost to stay in your ghost army a while longer. You need both appeal and wise words to cast confidence into a doubting ghost.This technique was a bit reluctantly approved by the master ghost liberator, Samuel de Montfort, into the training program of the guild. While having the obvious benefits of allowing you to use the power of a powerful ghost longer, it is viewed as borderline evil act.Usage: cast appease ghost        cast appease ghost at <ghost name>

arches favour.name: arches favour
arches favour.description: Young Braik's admittance piece to the hall was found late one night on a dusty shelf in the hall's library after many sleepless days of searching. It was more luck than anything that he even stumbled upon it, for it had been hidden behind a few of Amarth's more abstract works. The music was almost too faded to read. Indeed the title itself was too faded to read except for the letters 'fav'. However, Braik scribed it out anew, renaming it 'Arches Favour'. With great skill Braik played the difficult, if unorthodox piece and was admitted as the third master bard.
arches favour.spell_vocals: In the Shadows cast down by the moon, a certain Elven lord he strolls among the common folk, cloaked and hidden from recognition. The dark streets of the Keep of Shadows, vehement Inns, dancing women appeasing patrons.. A vigorous gleam in his eye, a nod of knowledge and satisfaction; dreams slowly fulfilled as the notes of time pass, participating and watching the twists of life, Lord Shadowstring, the artful archwizard, grant us a fragment of chance.

area entropy.name: area entropy
area entropy.description: This spell is used to age all players in the room. Thieves have a special skill they can try to concentrate to to get resistance to this spells effect

armour of aether.name: armour of aether
armour of aether.description: An extremely old spell handed down by the masters of protection, the armour of aether is a nearly invisible yet invulnerable force field that hovers a mere hairswidth from the target. It absorbs impact and bends before blades, greatly reducing the effect of weapons, hurled rocks, dragon's claws, and the many other attacks adventurers face that shed blood or break bones.

arms lore.name: arms lore
arms lore.description: Those that spend time on the battlefield would do well to study it -- the warriors, the tactics, and of course the weapons and armour used. While nothing beats firsthand experience and knowledge, this spell can help in other cases. Casting this spell at any battlefield item taps into the pool of collective memories of times past, searching for information about the item. Knowledge of identification and high intelligence are crucial for the use of this spell.

artificial intelligence.name: artificial intelligence
artificial intelligence.description: This spell affects the recipient's int. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

attune racial protection.name: attune racial protection
attune racial protection.description: A feature of racial protection spell is that it can be relatively easily attuned to another race. This spell does the attuning. Everyone in the room is affected, which can sometimes be a real drain to the caster. Attuning the protection also resets the time left on the protection, but the protection provided is lowered a bit with every attuning. Usage: cast attune racial protection at <race>

aura detection.name: aura detection
aura detection.description: This spell allows the caster to see what spells are affecting the target. The target can be almost anything (a player, a monster or an item). This spell does not detect all spells, but it is close to perfect. Knowledge of identification lowers the mana cost of this spell.

aura of chaos.name: aura of chaos
aura of chaos.description: This spell allows you to conjure a powerful aura of chaos around you, which damages foes who utilize melee combat against you.  However, it is not available for everybody, as it requires your blade to deal some other than physical damage and your blade needs to be fed with sufficient amount of life energy.  The aura doesn't stay up for free, though.  It requires a constant upkeep to maintain it. You can dispel your aura by command 'dismiss aura'.
aura of chaos.spell_vocals: Forces of Chaos, heed my call!

aura of hate.name: aura of hate
aura of hate.description: Hate and anger run strong through most people. Aura of hate has a tendency to let these emotions and feelings express themselves. By making one hate more and become more aggressive, adrenaline flows freely thoughout the body. This gives one a feeling of supreme power and provides both extra stamina and a little will power to continue going even in the toughest times.
aura of hate.spell_vocals: Feel your anger and strike with all your hatred. Use your aggressive feelings and let the hate flow through you.

aura of irreverence.name: aura of irreverence
aura of irreverence.description: The servants of darkness consider themselves more worthy than the regular folk. While the regular people are captivated by the matters mundane, the servants of of darkness see that they serve a much higher purpose and their servitude to the god makes their life hallowed. They share a similar feeling of irreverence as Burglefloogah did when it was born from the shameful actions of the murderous Curath. This powerful spell used by the servants of darkness is known to drive a person to a lonesome path filled with scornful thoughts. It's the path of the frog god and it comes with great power. Those who share the evil mind of the god are known to get the best out of it. The aura of irreverence may only be sustained by a person in good health.

aura of power.name: aura of power
aura of power.description: This spell affects the recipient's con. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

aura of wind.name: aura of wind
aura of wind.description: First developed in a failed attempt to allow land-based creatures to breathe underwater, the aura of wind is a personal atmosphere that surrounds the affected creature and moves with it. This layer of air provides resistance against depressurizing effects and also supplies oxygen in situations where it is hard to breathe. Suffocating, choking, and drowning are less damaging and can be avoided completely in some cases.

awake enthralled.name: awake enthralled
awake enthralled.description: Creatures who has been received the gift of enthrallment can be awaken from their slumberto obey their master. Enthralled rise from the roots of the wicked soil sickened by the Nergals blue flame.

awareness.name: awareness
awareness.description: Magic has long been used to enhance physical and mental attributes. One such spell is able to increase the mental awareness of the target. Once this spell is cast, all things become clearer. Wisdom is one of the most sought after attributes, as it helps one understand even the toughest problems and makes the hardest decisions easier. With this spell, heightened awareness is available for a short time.

banish.name: banish
banish.description: You can send a person away from your current location. The target will end up in a random location. Mastery of locating reduces the mana cost of this spell.

banish angels.name: banish angels
banish angels.description: Many creatures are different from the mortal men who roam through the realm. Some of these creatures are not regarded to be living while they're not considered to be dead either. Some creatures such as imps and hellhounds for example are considered to be demonic and originating from other worldly planes. All these creatures share specific weaknesses that the forces of good have learned to take advantage of. Very similar is the case with angels. These powerful and divine creatures make formidable adversaries but some diligent priests have found that they do have their vulnerabilities. They do not normally belong to the world of men and thus they can be expelled by the might of Draen-Dalar.

banish demons.name: banish demons
banish demons.description: One of the most evil entities an adventurer may come across, are the creatures that inhabit the planes of hell, such as devils and demons. All of them are fierce and dangerous opponents, capable of great destruction and carnage. To combat such incarnations of malevolence, there exists a rite that attacks the very core of their being, its link to existence on this plane. While this spell is usually not powerful enough to banish them outright, it can cause great stress and pain as the demonic entity must spend effort and energy in order to maintain its physical form on this plane of existence. Banish demons is the single most powerful dispel spell, but it can be used only against demonic entities such as devils and demons. When successfully cast, the divine purifying forces gather inside the caster, ultimately violently erupting through caster's relic in one big burst, exploding upon the demonic target. Knowledge of dispelling is required to fully master this spell. Every successful cast is a tribute to the God Las, and will not go without a reward.

banish mount.name: banish mount
banish mount.description: Sometimes a follower of Tzarakk wants to let his steed rest, or perhaps even release it from a predicative situation. Tzarakk frowns on such banishments, however, as he considers them a waste of time - hence, the steeds are handled like they had died in combat, and there will be the same delay before you can resummon.

bastardly balm.name: bastardly balm
bastardly balm.description: The templars set up their camp and went to sleep while Gabriel stayed up on guard. He had taken an oath to serve Aveallis and Faerwon, but now Gabriel found himself at crossroads. The teachings of the brotherhood of Kofgaad no longer seemed close to his own heart. When the priests of Draen-Dalar arrived to attack the camp, they witnessed an unexpected sight. Gabriel had slaughtered each one of his friends while they had been asleep. The priests looked at Gabriel and one of them drew blood from his finger, spread it across Gabriel's forehead, and then stated: 'You are one of us now.' and the one who had lost his way suddenly saw the light amid the darkness and accepted the path of Draen-Dalar. Bastardly balm bestows the blessing of Draen-Dalar upon a person and those who accompany the emissaries of darkness and aid them in their harmful ways will become rejuvenated in the process.

beacon of enlightenment.name: beacon of enlightenment
beacon of enlightenment.description: It is remarkable how much more you can accomplish if you have a proper mentor to guide you. This is true not only in daily life, but in the realm of magic as well. A true master of magic, equipped with proper means of delivering her message to her disciples, is often an invaluable asset to any group of magic-users. Indeed, the benefit of having a proper mentor is very often mutual as the teaching party must exert herself to clarity her understanding of things to pass it on.Or as Seneca put it in his undying words:"Homines, dum docent, discunt" - "Men learn while they teach."A target can benefit from several sources of enlightenment at once, but there is a limit of how much guidance one can really receive.

bearskin.name: bearskin
bearskin.description: It is good defence spell improving protection.

beckon rift entity.name: beckon rift entity
beckon rift entity.description: Commands your rift entity travel to your current location.

bind rift entity.name: bind rift entity
bind rift entity.description: Your entity will gradually grow in power and size as it experiences more of this world. When your entity reaches medium size, you can bind it to yourself giving it a permanent name. You can cast this spell without the required sparks in order to check the availability of the chosen name. Syntax: cast bind rift entity at <name> This spell uses 500 rift sparks.

black hole.name: black hole
black hole.description: This ancient and powerful spell calls upon the most primordial forces of Chaos itself, creating a rift in time and space. All unsecured items and creatures in the room are torn by powerful gravitational forces and dragged towards the inky void behind the vortex. Meanwhile, as the air is pulled from the room, bits of debris fly about like shrapnel, living creatures suffocate, and hollow items may burst. Only the caster, his teammates, and any item firmly nailed down can escape the wrath of this dangerous spell.
black hole.spell_vocals: Azzarakk, take this sacrifice I offer thee!

blade of fire.name: blade of fire
blade of fire.description: Chaos Lords are given not only some of the fiercest weapons known, in their Chaos Blades, but also can cause their blades to emit a magical fire, which burns anything the blade comes into contact with. It is said that the flames are so powerful that they can even burn under water.

blast lightning.name: blast lightning
blast lightning.description: This spell is similar to the spell lighting bolt, but it holds much greater potential, instead of a relatively small bolt of lighting, this spell is able to produce a stronger bolt, almost to the equivalent of a small storm. When this spell is used, the target will experience some involantary muscle spasms. The bolt is hot enough to  scortch the outer skin quite badly. Since electricity effects the muscles, it is also very painful.

blast vacuum.name: blast vacuum
blast vacuum.description: One of the most powerful spells that use air against the target is the spell blast vacuum. Similar to the spell chaos bolt, an active pocket of air is sent at the target where it is released, sucking all the air around the target away. The difference between the two, is that the spell blast vacuum creates a much larger and more powerful pocket. When this spell hits the target, the pressure outward from the target is so great that the targets outer skin actually expands, enough that it can be noticed by the naked eye. Blood vessels rupture and can cause open wounds. Some internal organs can also be affected, causing great pain.

bless armament.name: bless armament
bless armament.description: Prayers to bless this or that item are muttered all the time. This spell allows one to channel that blessing and make it much more potent. Blessing an item can cause it to become much more aware of the alignment of the creatures that you are fighting. This only works on wieldable items and objects. The caster's alignment effects the potency of the blessing.

bless ship.name: bless ship
bless ship.description: The seas are dangerous places, and losing brave sailors is not uncommon. It is thus no surprise that ship crews and their families began to turn to their religious leaders for blessings to help protect them on long voyages. It took a while for the priests to convert their skills in blessing individuals to something that would be effective for whole ships; but they succeeded, and this spell is the result.You can only bless a ship you are standing on.

bless vial.name: bless vial
bless vial.description: Nuns have special ability to bless water and then use it to boost protective auras or as a weapon against evil and undead fiends. Caster must have special glass vial full of pure water in hand and she must define the amount of spellpoints used in the blessing. When successfully cast the vial rise high above caster whirling rapidly, the mana is then bind into the liquid turning it to a holy water. Blessing's strength depends mainly on the amount of spellpoints used. Purity of heart and mastery of holy vials improve the spellpoint/blessing ratio and strength of blessing. Minimum amount of spellpoints one may define is 50. Vials are sold at the convent of White Rose. Usage of the spell: cast 'bless vial' <amount of spellpoints>.

blessed warmth.name: blessed warmth
blessed warmth.description: The warmth and sunshine of the summer months promotes growth in all living things. By casting this spell, a druid can call upon this power and soothe the wounds of himself and his friends.

blessing of faerwon.name: blessing of faerwon
blessing of faerwon.description: This prayer calls for a blessing of Faerwon. If granted, this prayer will enhance the target's abilities in combat. Faerwon does not grant his blessing to those who are not pure at heart. It is possible to pray for this blessing upon yourself, but Faerwon does not approve of selfish deeds.
blessing of faerwon.spell_vocals: Benedic, Faerwon, nos et haec tua dona quae de tua largitate sumus sumpturi.

blessing of intoxication.name: blessing of intoxication
blessing of intoxication.description: Many people feel they work better under the effects of alcohol -- smarter, faster, better looking, and the like. While their claims are questionable, this spell gives them the real thing. By using strong spirits, the caster can infuse the good feelings of being drunk into another player, and suppress the bad feelings. However, even magically infused alcohol has its limits. Syntax: cast blessing of intoxication at <player> use <booze>
blessing of intoxication.spell_vocals: I'm drunbk and I am all powerfuly!

blessing of kofgaad.name: blessing of kofgaad
blessing of kofgaad.description: Sisters of Kofgaad, the nuns of old mastered various spells now forgotten. One of the powerful ones was an ability to transcend ones mind to higher plain of awareness. Thus enhancing ones mind with the wisdom of the saints. Sisters of Las have been seeking this same ability for decades and the most powerful nuns have succeeded in doing so. Purity of thy heart together with hint of sacred water can illuminate ones mind to new heights.

blessing of tarmalen.name: blessing of tarmalen
blessing of tarmalen.description: One of a good aligned priest's abilities is to cast a spell which calls upon his gods to give extra stamina and power to the target of his spell. The gods grant the target a tremendous amount of additional physical regeneration. With this type of blessing from the gods, one can easily work all day long without tiring, or needing to stop to recover.

blight of the shunned.name: blight of the shunned
blight of the shunned.description: In every high or low society there are honourable people and without honour, you're less than nothing. They say that there is even honour among thieves. And those who do not have honour have no place in the society. They become the shunned ones, much like Burglefloogah and the voiceless of the swamps. But if one doesn't have honour, one can have respect. Respect is rarely given, but it may be earned, sometimes with merit and sometimes with fear. The voices of the voiceless will never be heard until they're too many and too loud and then it's already too late. The shunned ones overtake the night and they shun the ones who once shunned them. It's their blight. This death spell uses the power of the mummies to make the enemy slightly more susceptible against all kinds of attacks, while it also creates one bigger weakness - one which the priest often knows best to exploit.

blood seeker.name: blood seeker
blood seeker.description: Be it the edge of a blade or the point of a spear, there is a significant part of each weapon where the fun begins. (Or, in a different point of view, ends) This reaver spell calls upon released destructive energies to alter the shape of a weapon, making the significant part more effective -- one could say making the weapon put its best foot forward. The larger the significant portion, therefore, the greater effect this spell can have. Syntax: cast blood seeker at amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon.

blurred image.name: blurred image
blurred image.description: Illusions have had many uses, mostly trickery and entertainment. One more practical use is to cast a spell on a target which bends rays of light around them, causing anyone who can see them, to see a slightly distorted image. This causes any physical attacks to be somewhat mis-aimed, since they are not based upon the true position of the target. While it far from guarantees complete protection from physical attacks, every little bit helps.

bolt of knowledge.name: bolt of knowledge
bolt of knowledge.description: A folklorist offensive spell, drawing power from the known weaknesses of the target's race, gender, alignment et cetera. Well studied creatures are more vulnerable to this spell. As a psionic attack, the caster is somewhat drained by the attack - this also means the spell can devastate a lesser mind. The spell creates a link between the caster and the target, which can be used, through intense concentration, to deal further harm to the target.

bookworm.name: bookworm
bookworm.description: This folklorist spell transforms the caster into a bookworm. Legend has that this spell was conceived in a drunken orgy of younger members of the school of folklorists. Since then, it has become an useful tool. You can only cast this spell at yourself, and you can end the effect at will.

bulwark of death.name: bulwark of death
bulwark of death.description: The slaads gazed at the hideous thing that stood there at the rocky highlands with a sword in his hand. There was contempt in their eyes as this ugly thing physically resembled like one of their own. It was their enemy known as the Bulwark of Lorenchia, the troll Grundor, who played a crucial role in forming the Lorenchian Guard. As Grundor and his men decimated the slaads, only few were left. They were driven back to the swamp where they were consoled by the denizens of the darkness. Even today Grundor's accursed name instills fear to the soul of slaads, but the world of men is not the only one with great defenders. The shunned of the underworld have champions of their own and bulwarks come in many form. This prayer of death bestows the protective power of the mummies upon the target but has some drawbacks as it temporarily drains the vitality of the person who is beneficiary of this spell and its drawbacks last longer than its benefits unless the spell is renewed. However, some talented gypsy clerics have learned a way to renew the aging cells, thus reversing some of its ill effects.

call armour.name: call armour
call armour.description: Like call scythe, this spell brings a usable set of armour to the reaver, who can use it in battle rather than risk their own hide. Destructive energies the reaver has released by the breaking of armour is called back, forming a solid, if temporary, echo of the destroyed items. This armour is a gift from the forces of destruction for that reaver alone, and its quality and appearance match how pleased these powers are with the reaver's efforts. Syntax: cast call armour at amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon.
call armour.spell_vocals: That which I ask, I shall return tenfold

call forth enthralled.name: call forth enthralled
call forth enthralled.description: There are times when minions lost their way to their master or they are unable to follow their masters steps. For occasions like that servitors of Lord Nergal have studied spell which quickly transfers minion to masters location through space-time tear. Usage: cast 'call forth enthralled' oioioi-auau-ui

call pigeon.name: call pigeon
call pigeon.description: One very practical spell is the one that is able to magically summon a small homing pigeon. This pigeon is able to carry small items to a designated spot, chosen by the caster, usually the caster's home. This type of magic is very useful to secure special items that may have been found while adventuring, but that for some reason cannot be carried, perhaps to hide it from someone who is looking for it. Syntax: cast call pigeon at <item/list of items>         cast call pigeon at ship:<ship name> <item/list of items> This second version will bring the item(s) to the cargo hold 1 of the named ship, but you must be its captain.

call scythe.name: call scythe
call scythe.description: Reavers, in their love for the destruction, rarely get attached to physical items. However, entering a battle without a weapon is not necessarily the key to victory. By using this spell, a reaver can bring to him a weapon, a gift for that reaver alone from the immortal lords of destruction. The power of the weapon is related to how pleased those lords are with the reaver's efforts. However, this costly gift should be used as a last resort, when no other weapon is available, since calling too often upon the lords of destruction is not wise. Syntax: cast call scythe at amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon.
call scythe.spell_vocals: It is time for the harvest of bone and blood

campfire tune.name: campfire tune
campfire tune.description: Almost forever have bards of all realms done singing late in the evenings. Gathering around the campfire, they sing their protective and refreshing songs and play tunes that make the toughest giant fall asleep. This one is exceptionally magical and heals everyone near the bard.
campfire tune.spell_vocals: What child is this, who laid to rest on Mary's lap is sleeping, angels greet with anthems sweet while shepherds guard are keeping? This, this is Christ the king, whom shepherds guard and angels sing. Haste, haste to bring him laude the babe, the son of Mary!

cantrip.name: cantrip
cantrip.description: What fun is magic if you know what it does?
cantrip.spell_vocals: Vita non est vivere sed valere vita est

cash flow.name: cash flow
cash flow.description: Once an old wizard had a ingenious plan. Through magical and mechanical means, he found a way to allow people to send money through time and space. He was able to teach this spell to anyone who cared to learn it, and thus he was a central 'remote' bank for them. At a word, they could use the spell to transfer cash to the wizard's shop where he then transfered it physically to the caster's bank account, keeping a small commission for himself. It is said he was able to retire and live in luxury with this discovery, which secrets he still holds to this day.

catchy singalong.name: catchy singalong
catchy singalong.description: Little Captnapalm had a purpose in life. He was born a troublemaker. The Elder tried to raise him with discipline and even sent him to boy scouts. Instead lil' Captnapalm studied the Art of Disorienteering and the Science of Confusion. Favourite mischief he had was to harass people with nonsense and simple ditties. There was nothing more rewarding than to see poor old people's focus break when they couldn't get some stupid melody or a meaningless whistle out of their heads.

cause critical wounds.name: cause critical wounds
cause critical wounds.description: One spell that the followers of the dark gods use, is one that is able to cause wounds to the target. With only a touch, the target's midsection is instantly given a deep wound. This type of attack is virtually impossible to defend against, so great is the power of the dark gods. Those who wield such power are a great terror and it is best said to deal with them before they are able to come into contact where they are able to wield their deadly powers. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

cause light wounds.name: cause light wounds
cause light wounds.description: Followers of the dark gods are given great powers with which to spread evil and destruction through the world. One such power is the ability to cause wounds on a target with a mere touch. The weakest spell of this type is able to open up sores and cuts on the targets hands and feet. There is no known counterspell to these attacks, the target must only hope to survive and seek out a healer or rest to heal the wounds. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

cause serious wounds.name: cause serious wounds
cause serious wounds.description: Followers of the dark ways have many different weapons available to them, given to them by their gods. One such weapon is a spell which is able to cause deep cuts and bruises to the arms and legs of the target, with only a touch. Upon contact, the wounds instantly open up. Those who use these spells are feared, since the gods have given them a weapon against which there is no defense. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

celestial haven.name: celestial haven
celestial haven.description: With this spell a devoted nun may protect her current location with such a strong blessing that it prevents undead and evil entities from entering. The duration and strength are based on her intelligence, wisdom, mastery of shielding and purity of thy heart. With high purity of thy heart the haven may also refresh other pure beings inside its shelter. When this spell is cast no evil beings may be present in the room.

chain lightning.name: chain lightning
chain lightning.description: The spell chain lightning is one of the more unique spells that are out there. Not only does it summon a  powerful bolt of lightning, but instead of hitting a single target, it is able to jump from one target, onto another, and another and so on, controlled by the will of the caster. From afar, this spell is almost comical to watch, as the  lightning bolt jumps from target to target. Of course, if you are one of the targets, it's not very comical at all.

channelball.name: channelball
channelball.description: Channellers are very good at bringing forth magical energies, and the effects of this spell show that. The caster creates a kind of projectile that impacts with great force, then explodes. Since the channeller is grabbing energy at short notice, they cannot be picky where it comes from, and therefore some comes from the caster's own body. The damage of the spell increases as the caster becomes better at controlling the flow of magical energy.

channelbolt.name: channelbolt
channelbolt.description: After mastering raw magic and taming fire, channellers turn to the next more difficult energy form -- lightning. With this spell they can fire electrical energy with little more than a wave of their hand (plus some fancy channelling). The strike itself carries quite a wallop, but the painful effects of an electrical jolt can be just as effective as the damage caused.

channelburn.name: channelburn
channelburn.description: After learning the secrets of controlling the flow of raw magic, the next easiest energy source to channel into being is fire. It takes only a little effort to twist energy into heat. The caster creates small but concentrated packets of firey energy, throwing them as quickly as they materialize before they disperse. While these packets are not terribly easy to control, their sheer number makes up for the lack of accuracy with sheer knock-down force. Unlucky targets are even set ablaze, and many times the target's corpse (if any remains) is concealed by a cloud of smoke and ash.

channelray.name: channelray
channelray.description: The ultimate channeller attack spell, this potent beam of energy fires in a straight line from the caster's hand towards the target, blasting anything in its path. Particularly strong channellers can send the ray of energy through their target to hit objects or creatures lurking behind it. While the width of the beam is rather low, the spell makes up for its lack of area by inflicting heavy damage on those targets it strikes.

channelspray.name: channelspray
channelspray.description: Competing with channelray as the ultimate channeller attack spell, the channelspray is both similar and different in concept. The caster creates flaming projectiles which are hurled in a tight arc, exploding immediately upon contact with the ground, armour, or flesh. The impact and flames from this spell can be quite destructive, however the range of the spell is quite short, and many targets can seek shelter from the flames by hiding behind appropriate cover.

chaos bolt.name: chaos bolt
chaos bolt.description: While some asphyxiation spells only create pockets of airless space, this spell goes much further. Instead of creating just an airless space, the pocket of space also is strengthened with chaos magic so any air around the pocket is also sucked away. When this pocket hits the target, the air around the target collapses away. Not only is the wind knocked from the targets lungs, the sudden change of air pressure around the target is also hurt as blood vessels nearest the outer skin explode.

charge staff.name: charge staff
charge staff.description: The one item every druid requires, is his or her staff. Through this staff, their druidic power is channeled and brought forth into this world. Without their staff, they are unable to channel their power effectively. The staff therefore must be imbued with some of the power of the caster in order to effectively draw the power of nature from the environment. Constant use of the staff, causes it to lose charge. This requires the druid to charge the staff at regular occasions or risk losing much or all of his power at a time when he may need it most.

chill touch.name: chill touch
chill touch.description: The simplest cold based attack spell is the spell chill touch. Often misunderstood by the layman, one does not have to actually touch his opponent. Instead, this spell calls forth a small chilly blast of arctic power, that gives the target a very strong and sudden chill. The power is  strong enough to do a little damage from the sudden cold.

clairvoyance.name: clairvoyance
clairvoyance.description: Clairvoyance is the ability to be very aware of one's surrounding areas. Normally only special races have this ability, minotaurs for one. This ability can be, however, simulated through magical means. With the correct chant, one can be given a glimpse of his surroundings, as though he had the ability itself.

clandestine thoughts.name: clandestine thoughts
clandestine thoughts.description: Tama Tail-kinker was writing her latest composition down, when she suddenly felt like someone was looking over her shoulder. She quickly played a few angry notes with a certain rhyme, and the nuisance was gone.
clandestine thoughts.spell_vocals: To all the eyes around me, I wish to remain hidden, must I be seen when so far I have namelessly ridden. To all those who relentlessly me seek or hound, covet I nothing but mayhaps a trifling wound.

cleanse heathen.name: cleanse heathen
cleanse heathen.description: This spell was created by the first nuns of BatMUD but during the wars against primal forces of Chaos, the spell was lost, until it was accidentally recovered by Sister Valentina. The soul of wicked being is as black as coal and can be turned against its keeper. This spell requires one full vial of blessed water which is thrown high in the air, upon the target and when successfully cast, ray of lightning shatters the vial into millions of pieces and magically alters the holy water, which then rains over the target, damaging the protection of Chaos thus making it more vulnerable against holy attackers. This spell can be stacked and only those who master the holy art are known to be able to cast the spell in the middle of a bloody fight. The effect of the spell is based on caster's wisdom,intelligence,level and strength of blessed vial. Mastery of shielding and high purity of heart are required when facing mighty evil beings.
cleanse heathen.spell_vocals: Ala itkeä iletys, parkua paha kuvatus

cleanse weapon.name: cleanse weapon
