heal all.description: Affected players: All This spell heals affected players in the mud 50+1d50 points. The players will know who healed them. This is considered a very good act. The caster can choose which players are not effected by the spell by ignoring that player with the ignore command (see 'help ignore' for more information). You must specify the minimum number of players that you want to have affected as the target of the spell, for example:  cast 'heal all' 10

heal mount.name: heal mount
heal mount.description: A faithful mount is like a trusted weapon in many respects -- with time, one learns how it moves and reacts, and learns to improve both offense and defense with it. However, they both tend to take damage in combat. Keeping a mount in good condition is just as important as keeping one's sword sharp and one's shield repaired. While not true healers, a knight can soothe an injured mount with his voice, taking away the fear and pain until the wounds have a chance to heal themselves. If a noble mount should become angered or upset, this spell may calm its emotions so it can be ridden again.

heal self.name: heal self
heal self.description: Not suprisingly, one of the first forms of magic that was perfected was the magic to heal one's own wounds.

healbound harmony.name: healbound harmony
healbound harmony.description: The ability of Followers of Tarmalen to heal and aid fellow adventurers is admirable, but their natural talent does not end there. As they perform their craft they have the ability to bound themselves in harmony with one other soul, and through them share their healing with everyone in the group and thus spreading their knowledge as experience. The harmony sometimes pulses so strong, that it replenishes the Follower, or even the whole party. If one wishes to break this bond, they can command 'harmony renounce'.

heat reduction.name: heat reduction
heat reduction.description: Fire has always been one of the most feared elements due to its destructive and relentless abilities. Not only is fire found in its natural form, but many creatures use fire as a form of attack. Many magical weapons burn brightly from magical fires. Due to the common presence of a threat from fire, a spell was created that created a red aura around the target. This aura was able to absorb some of any fire damage done to the target.

heavenly protection.name: heavenly protection
heavenly protection.description: Heavenly protection is a powerful cover against the attacks of evil and undead opponents. This spell can be casted only upon pure people. Duration and strength of the protection are based on caster's intelligence, wisdom and relic. High mastery of shielding and purity of thy heart are required to fully master this spell. The protective aura can be boosted by sprinkles of holy water.

heavy weight.name: heavy weight
heavy weight.description: While magical summons and banishing spells are powerful tools, they are not without remedy. One such remedy is the anti-summons spell called heavy weight. This spell binds the target with magics that prevent summons. This magic is strong enough that the target will not be able to cast most summon spells himself. Sometimes the magic can be defeated as it is not 100%, but currently this is the only anti-summoning spell that is well known. There are rumors that somewhere there are scholars who even now, try to find the right incantations to improve this spell, just recently there has been a discovery of a spell that will remove heavy weight before it wears off. . .

hemorrhage.name: hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: The followers of the dark gods have been granted many powers with which to inflict pain and suffering on others. By drawing on the power given them by the dark gods, they can, with a touch, cause pain in their targets by causing internal bleeding in the target's body. This is extremely painful, and worst of all, it does not kill. It is only meant to bring endless pain. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

herbal healing.name: herbal healing
herbal healing.description: Herbal healing is a folklorist healing spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast this spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally healing herbs offering more power. Some other powers of the herb used are also enhanced by this spell. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal healing' <target> use <herb>

herbal poison blast.name: herbal poison blast
herbal poison blast.description: A folklorist offensive spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast the spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally poisonous herbs being more effective - some are even poisonous enough to cause a lasting effect. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal poison blast' [target] use <herb>

herbal poison spray.name: herbal poison spray
herbal poison spray.description: A folklorist offensive spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast the spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally poisonous herbs being more effective. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal poison spray' [target] use <herb>

herbal remove poison.name: herbal remove poison
herbal remove poison.description: Folklore tells of many ways to cure a poison. One is sauna, one other is rest, but most other remedies are less mundane and more magical. Combining the healing power of herbs with simple magic, a folklorist is able to cure most poisons. You need a herb to cast this spell, and the herb must have inherent healing ability. Usage: cast 'herbal remove poison' <target> use <herb>

here and after.name: here and after
here and after.description: Death can be seen as permanent or as a state of transition. Death is the only thing that is between life and afterlife. The servants of darkness are able to affect the matters between life and unlife. While death is a very difficult concept to handle, a few attempts have been made in warding friends from death, some of them more successful than others.

hoar frost.name: hoar frost
hoar frost.description: One of the powers wielded by the masters of nature, is one of climate and temperature, the power of winter. Using the power stored inside a crystalline plant, they are able to summon forth a hoar-frost which immediatelly envelopes the target. The sudden change in temperate is very brutal to the unprepared, and can cause great harm, especially to uncovered extremeties.

holding pattern.name: holding pattern
holding pattern.description: This incantation prepares the mage to enter a trance where she is ready to unleash single blasts instantenously. Maintaining the trance is extremely delicate, and it can only be maintained for very short periods of time. High mastery helps, but even the strongest minds can only concentrate for brief moments. Actually unleashing the spell is even harder, any distractions can seriously affect the casting. The best way to complete  the trance without distractions is to stay away from other players, as any distracting presence can seriously affect the outcome. Being in trance in the presence of bigger opponents may be dangerous, as you are not concentrating fully at the combat. Unleashing powerful blasts from the trance is taxing, causing the next trance to take more time to establish.

holy armada.name: holy armada
holy armada.description: Faerwon watches over all Holy Wars, wherever they may be. But as the peoples of the world began travelling the seas, new forms of combat broke out which were much less direct than before. So, in order to protect his followers, Faerwon blessed them with a new spell; one which would bring aid to entire ships at a time, rather than just a couple of individuals. Those knights who had greater power could channel this spell more effectively, bringing larger and more potent benefits.

holy bolt.name: holy bolt
holy bolt.description: Holy bolt is an awesome spell of holy type. When casting, fear can be seen even in the eyes of the most biggest and malicious undeads. This spell is only used by the most skilled and able nuns. When successfully cast, massive amounts of divine force starts to coil around caster's relic forming a brilliant pulsing bolt of pure holy energy. When bolt is big enough caster hurls it upon target, inflicting horrific pain as bolt explodes. Upon successfull cast the caster might receive divine inspiration, halving the cast-time of any next spell. Might of the saints with a doze of high discipline improves the effectiveness of the spell. One must still beware the awesome destructive power as the power of this spell has seduced numerous nuns to the dark path.

holy glow.name: holy glow
holy glow.description: With this spell you hide yourself in a cloak of blinding light. The light is holy in origin, thus it only works against evil creatures.Some ghost liberator paladins dislike this spell because they like to face their enemies 'like a man', but none can deny the usefulness of this spell. It is very useful on scouting missions, to see what kind of opponent you are facing, and if you need to call for backup. Alas, many a liberator has fallen prey to the evil hordes they have been snooping on when the spell ends - a sound reminder of the short duration of this trick.Usage: cast holy glow

holy hand.name: holy hand
holy hand.description: Holy hand is the weakest offensive spell of holy type and is often used by apprentice nuns. Holy hand only effects undead beings which are known to strongly resists other forms of magical attacks. When successfully cast, target is embraced and crushed by white holy light emitted from the caster's relic. Purity of thy heart enhances the effectiveness of this spell.

holy lance.name: holy lance
holy lance.description: Holy Lance was first discovered by Sister Broqyanne who found a way to mold the Holy Power into the shape of lightning, striking its foe with great speed. The lightning-like shape made the focal point small thus piercing even the strongest dark defences. She soon discovered that the damage component was rather small but the piercing effect left the foe vulnerable to Holy Force for a short period of time. She soon took this new art into effective use by first lancing her foe a couple of times or more and then using more damaging spells like Dispel Undead or Dispel Evil to exploit the exposed weakness. She would then lance the foe from time to time to keep it vulnerable to Holy Force. This lance-bolting technique Sister Broqyanne developed also had another great effect. By blasting the weakened foe she was able to gain illuminated state, channeling enormous amounts of Holy Power into even more sharp holy lightning, literally splitting her foe into half. Sister Broqyanne, now a powerful Saint was a gifted and fearsome nun. She was widely known to hunt down the biggest, slimiest and nastiest of monsters.

holy way.name: holy way
holy way.description: Long ago it was decided that followers of Tarmalen should be able to gather together easily in order to discuss issues relevant to them all. By using holy way, one follower is able to transport himself to another follower, though only within limits of the surrounding continental realm.

holy wind.name: holy wind
holy wind.description: Holy wind is an awesome spell when facing horde of fiendish undeads. When successfully cast the celestial wind sweeps through caster's surroundings, severely damaging all undeads. Holy wind is a faint sweep of divine power eminating from the wing strokes of the six winged angel, Seraphim. High purity of heart and might of the saints are required to fully master this spell. Holy wind is a symphony to the glory of Las.

icebolt.name: icebolt
icebolt.description: A more powerful version of the spell flaming ice, this spell creates a large bolt of super cold ice, that strikes the target. Not only damaging the target from the force of the impact, upon contact with the bolt of ice, skin will freeze, sometimes enough that it can become brittle. Also the power of the bolt remains enough that the ice reforms around part of the target, then shattering.

identify.name: identify
identify.description: Many items litter the realms. Some are carried by creatures and men, others are laying in hope of being found by some lucky (or unlucky) adventurer. A small portion of these items may be enchanted with special powers and abilities, most of which are not visible to the naked eye. The spell 'identify' is able to discern the workings of many items and can tell some of its attributes. Those who have studied lore and legend and the workings of magic are much more effective in this art.

identify relic.name: identify relic
identify relic.description: Holy relics, used mostly by nuns, are known to have many separate forces bind to them. Years of studying revealed three main streams of power that were upheld by certain groups of saints. These forces were used to banish undeads, dispel evil fiends and cast protective auras. When powerful nun was slain she was transformed into a powerful saint in realm unknown to mortal men. When successfully cast, the caster feels all the different streams of holy magic, their strenght and saints controlling the flow. The magic saint controls is always same, you may study the saints in the library in convent of White Rose.

immolate.name: immolate
immolate.description: By casting this hideous spell, hellfires shoot from the earth to burn not only the intended victim but everything it is touching. Tales have been told of warriors burned so badly that not even their armour survived.

immolate scythe.name: immolate scythe
immolate scythe.description: Most reavers have a fascination with fire that extends beyond healthy admiration. To them, fire is an inspiration, an energy source which has no goal other than to grow in power at the expense of everything it touches. Following this burning desire, reavers have developed this spell, which sets the blade (or other appropriate part) of their wielded weapon ablaze. Destructive energy is not required for this spell.
immolate scythe.spell_vocals: Let this strike true, to burn from within

imprisonment.name: imprisonment
imprisonment.description: No monsters or players may leave the area while the spell is in effect. The players outside can enter, but then they'll be trapped.

infravision.name: infravision
infravision.description: One ability many races in this realm possess, is the ability to see in the dark. This ability allows them to navigate freely in  darkness, without the hinderance of showing their presence with their own light source. Usually an ability that is gained over many generations of living in dark environments, it can also be temporarily instilled through magical means.

inquiry to ahm.name: inquiry to ahm
inquiry to ahm.description: The caster makes an inquiry to Ahm the Ever-changing (the Demigod of Reincarnation) to find out the target's reinc tax. Deciphering the answer is easier if one is proficient with the runic siglas, and high wisdom also helps - novice Druids may end up far from the truth.The spell can also reveal attributes that are lost for the reinc.

instant fermentation.name: instant fermentation
instant fermentation.description: Fermentation is one of the oldest forms of science known to civilized society, and perhaps with the most pleasant results. Normally, the transformation of sugary fruit juices to an alcoholic drink takes time, and the flavors takes time to mellow and meld as well. This spell drastically speeds up the process, creating a healthy dose of booze in seconds.

intelligize.name: intelligize
intelligize.description: This spell affects the recipient's int. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

invisibility.name: invisibility
invisibility.description: One of the most useful spells from the illusion  schools, is the spell of invisibility. This spell will  make the target and all his possesions invisible to the naked eye. There is no better way to go places you normally shouldn't be caught in. Of course there are also magical ways to detect invisible beings, this spell does not offer total impunity.

iron will.name: iron will
iron will.description: One of the most dangerous times for any warrior in battle, is when they are knocked senseless and left unable to defend themselves. Death is usually only an instant away, as foes readily jump to take advantage of such a striken target. One protective spell grants the target an 'iron will' with which to shrug off hits that may normally leave them at their assailant's mercy..

item dispersion shield.name: item dispersion shield
item dispersion shield.description: Channellers, like all other mages, know what kind of wear and tear their hazardous lifestyles can exact on garments or gear. Blasts of fire, spills of acid, and sizzling lightning are day-to-day occurances with them. After learning to channel the energy from inside an object to them, they learn how to pull the energy from outside the object, thereby pulling some of the harmful energies -- kinetic, thermal, whatever -- to them. While this can (and indeed often does) hurt quite a lot, flesh heals and steel doesn't. Channellers often cast this spell on their prized golems, but it will work on just about anything. You can cast this spell at yourself to check how many shields are still active.

jesters trivia.name: jesters trivia
jesters trivia.description: Curiosity was a dominant trait in Loremaster Laaban's character. He wanted to know things that not many cared for, but there was a problem; not always would people open their minds to him for a peek. He would not falter though, not give up, and his insistence resulted in a new song to be sung by all the curious bards.Hint: type 'bjester'.
jesters trivia.spell_vocals: Green skins, white skins, black skins, purple skins. Big minds, small minds, dumb minds, silly minds. Can you see through yourself, I care not, for I can. I can see what you wear and what you bear, disguised or not, you're a book for me to read.

join soul.name: join soul
join soul.description: With this spell you re-join your soul into your being after soul separation.Usage: cast join soul

killing cloud.name: killing cloud
killing cloud.description: One of the most deadly spells known, is the feared spell, killing cloud. When this spell is cast, a heavy mist appears, that envelopes the target area. Any foes caught in the mist are instantly overcome by a mixture of hundreds of deadly poisons. Some victims fall dead instantly as the poisons overload the nervous system. Others simply melt away as poisons eat away at flesh and bone at a mind boggling rate. Those that survive a killing cloud, are instantly on the throes of hell.

kinematic projection.name: kinematic projection
kinematic projection.description: Psionicist deal primarily with a battle of minds. However, in the pursuit of perfecting their own minds, psionicists have learned a few tricks. For instance, it would not be hard to use their mind to manipulate the world around them.   Telekinetic propulsion is a means of taking an object normally fired from a ranged weapon - arrows, bolts, bullets, and stones - and accelerating them to a frightening speed. Usage: cast 'kinematic projection' <target>

kinemortological protection.name: kinemortological protection
kinemortological protection.description: Every creature has its strong sides and its weak sides. This spell draws its power from assessing the strong points of a creature and then creating a protection against those. Be it the touch of a ghost or the claws of a ghoul, this spell protects its target. As the name suggests, not all creatures are affected by this spell, only undead creatures.

kings feast.name: kings feast
kings feast.description: Haydn was a cute little sprite, also a bard. She used to walk in the forests, admiring the tall trees and cute animals (she also used to kick the irritating animals). Once she met a pixie that was in trouble, caught in a web of a bloodthirsty spider. She cut the web with her sharp knife, released the pixie, and since then the pixies have answered to the call of the bards.
kings feast.spell_vocals: If you look behind a spider web, when it is covered with frost, You may see a tiny pixie, who perhaps is a little bit lost. That tiny pixie is full of spirit representing goodness and light, The embodiment of joy and laughter, of passion and sheer delight. In a world of pure imagination, and a mind full of magical dreams, An enchanted forest can exist, and so can a pixie it seems.

last rites.name: last rites
last rites.description: Through the ages, priests have been able to develop a way, with the help of their Dark Gods, to transfer strength when in dire need, based on their teachings in the harming arts. From its limited beginnings as a tool to protect themselves at the last moment, the priests have been able to increase the power and focus of this spell.  By chanting an evil incantation the priests invokes the Dark Gods to help him when he is about to engage in combat. The spell does so by assisting those who are helping the priest in spread harm in the name of their Gods. Whenever the target's instinct is to flee from his aggressor, this evil prayer calls upon the strength of the priest to allow him to continue his fight. Although the Dark Gods do not pleasure intervention into the mortal realm often, they will do so on occasion. Also, at times the Dark Gods may be inclined to aid their priests to astonishing degrees.

lava blast.name: lava blast
lava blast.description: One of the most powerful fire based attack spells is the spell lava blast. This spell gains its tremendous power by tapping the essence of lava, one of the most powerful forms fire can take. Instead of directing flame, or fire energy, a stream of red hot, molten lava springs forth onto the target. The results are terrifying as the target's flesh burns away as the lava envelopes the target. The changing of fire energy into molten lava takes a fair amount of effort and concentration, making this a rigorous spell to cast, but it is also the most powerful composite fire spell that is able to affect a single target.

lava storm.name: lava storm
lava storm.description: While lava blast is as powerful as fire spells get, the spell lava storm enables that power to be cast upon multiple targets. Through this spell, the caster calls forth enough fiery lava to spray an entire area, burning his foes all at once. Enormous effort and concentration is required to bring this much power to bear. This spell is usually too burdensome for all but the most powerful mages to cast.

laying on hands.name: laying on hands
laying on hands.description: This spell heals target slowly, as long as neither he nor the caster moves or fights. The effect increases slowly.

legacy of enthralled.name: legacy of enthralled
legacy of enthralled.description: Once parasite takes over a hosts mind, the host weakens as a sign of rebellion against foreign consciousness. Through magic and evolution Followers of Nergal are able to lend their own power and life force to hosts carrying their own blood. Usage: cast 'legacy of enthralled' help        cast 'legacy of enthralled' jane grant minor wisdom

lessen poison.name: lessen poison
lessen poison.description: While removing poison is usually the best way to deal with that ill, some poisons simply cannot be removed from the victim through any means. This means that either the victim will die, or simply survive the poison and outlast it. One way to aid these  unfortunate souls, is to use magic to give them protection against the poison coursing through their veins. If you can weaken the poison enough, surviving it will be much easier.

levin bolt.name: levin bolt
levin bolt.description: This spell is a powerful spell that uses magic energy against its foe. While this spell is somewhat similar to the spell magic missile, it has several very important differences. Instead of throwing a small bolt of pure magical energy, it  is able to draw more power that enhances the power of the bolt, not only the size, but also the amount of energy, even if the size of the bolt was not increased. While most magical attack spells emit energy that is bright yellow, this spell, due to the highly concentrated energy, shines pure white.

levitation.name: levitation
levitation.description: This spell will levitate the caster above the ground utilizing only the power of the mind. In function this spell is almost like the commonly used spell floating, but to a true psionicist there's a world of difference. For them this spell is pure, a display of complete willpower, whereas floating is more like a petty magic trick.

life leech.name: life leech
life leech.description: The spell drains up to 100 hit points from target, and adds them to the caster's hit points. Casting this spell is considered to be an evil act. You need to be level 15 for this spell to work.

life link.name: life link
life link.description: One of the more unique spells taught by followers of the good gods, is a spell which allows a priest to create a link between himself and another. This link allows them to share physical pain, which can  sometimes allow the both of them to survive an ordeal that may be too great for anyone to face alone. This is a relativly  dangerous spell, since many times both the caster and the target can be lost if the pain is too great for both of them to survive.

lift of load.name: lift of load
lift of load.description: This spell utilizes the magical power of laughter and allows the target to carry more than they normally could.

light.name: light
light.description: While most activities which require the light of day can be planned to coincide with these hours, there are times that this is just not possible. One of the easiest forms of magic, is to use it to create a source of light.  Magic itself usually glows, due to its unstable power when it is beheld on this plane of existance. Therefore bringing a controlled steady magical light is a trivial task for users of magic. The more powerful the caster, the longer the light will last. To dismiss the light, just touch it.

lightning bolt.name: lightning bolt
lightning bolt.description: With this spell, one is able to harness the power of lightning, and direct it forth to the target, in one long bolt. While not of the magnitude of lightning seen in most thunderstorms, it still can cause terrific pain and burning to the target.

lightning shield.name: lightning shield
lightning shield.description: The lightning shield is an energy effect that masks the electric properties of the object it surrounds. Since the protected target now appears to electricity as an inert object, most or all of the damaging energy will go around, rather than through, the aura, and spare the target some pain.

lightning storm.name: lightning storm
lightning storm.description: One of the most powerful spells that harness the power of lightning, is the spell lightning storm. Upon command, several strong bolts of lighting jump from the hands of the  caster, and hammer the target area. Anyone foes caught inside are hit by the powerful lightning bolts. This spell is a very powerful spell, and much effort and concentration is required to conjure multiple lightning bolts.

living poison.name: living poison
living poison.description: Undead creatures have no blood circulation, or living tissue, and are as such immune to most poisons. This spell changes all that. It infects an undead with a living poison, which renders its target vulnerable to poison attacks. The process, while being a painful one, does not harm the creature, but is still considered an attack by most.

lock biter.name: lock biter
lock biter.description: Most locks are metal, and those that aren't still usually have thin, delicate parts. Acid, being fluid, can easily flow into such tiny places and eat away at them. Usually, this opens the lock, but other results have been known to occur... The skill 'cast alchemy' lets you make stronger acid for tougher locks.

lunacy shield.name: lunacy shield
lunacy shield.description: In long, strenuous combats, many warriors find themselves taking damage from an ever-changing number of magical sources. They might face a fiery demon in one minute, only to face a chilling spectre the next. In this mayhem, switching between magical protections is either difficult or impossible. Faerwon grants his followers the lunacy shield to protect them from such madness. This single spell protects its target from whatever type of magical damage they have suffered the most of recently, and updates itself to keep pace with the chaos of battle. Spell percent and mastery affects how much of the damage is prevented. Higher wisdom makes the spell change damage types faster.

lunar inspiration.name: lunar inspiration
lunar inspiration.description: The most studious of mages look for answers everywhere -- old books, ancient tables, forgotten scrolls, and even the celestial bodies. There are some who say the only difference between genius and madness is measured by success, and if the moon is known to cause fits of insanity, then it should prove fits of brilliance as well. This spell grants the caster increased wisdom and intelligence, the exact nature of which sway with the phase of the moon. Method of runemagery is the mastery of this spell, but certain boons and banes have an even greater effect.

magic dispersion.name: magic dispersion
magic dispersion.description: Magical energy has always been used as a powerful weapon. Due to this, certain spells have been woven that take the opposite magical aura. Similar to the field spell, anti-magic-field, this spell is able to create an aura around the target which is able to lessen the amplitude of pure magic that attempts to penetrate it to attack the target. A result of this, is a reduction in damage done when these types of attack spells are used.

magic eruption.name: magic eruption
magic eruption.description: The spell magic eruption is one of the most fearsome spells witnessed on this side of hell. The caster raises both arms, then chants the words and throws his arms down to his side. At that instant, an area designated by the caster is completely enveloped in a golden flash of light. The magical energy swirls for several seconds before burning itself out. Anything that is unfortunate enough to be caught inside, is bombarded by fiery  magic and energy. Not many things are left living inside a magic eruption.

magic missile.name: magic missile
magic missile.description: One of the most common spells used to inflict damage on one's opponent, is the spell magic missile. This spell conjures a small bolt of pure magical energy and directs it at the target. While this spell is considered by many to be a magical damage type attack spell, virtually all mages are taught this spell as their first attack spell. Not only is  it a simple spell to learn, since it uses pure magical energy, it gives the student a chance to learn other basic concepts about magic.

magic mount.name: magic mount
magic mount.description: Walking is not always a viable option. This spell summons a magic mount, a pegasus. A somewhat skilled rider can ride it, for others it works as a beast of burden. You can only have one magic mount at a time. You can dismiss the mount with 'cast magic mount at dismiss' and increase the duration with 'cast magic mount at refresh'. You can also locate your mount with 'cast magic mount at locate'. If you and your magic mount get separated, you can call your mount with 'cast magic mount at summon'.

magic wave.name: magic wave
magic wave.description: The spell magic wave is not only a very powerful attack spell, but also very impressive to see. The caster utters the command and waves his hand from one side to the other, tracing a glowing path that hovers for an instant.  It then leaps outward, catching anything in its path. The wave moves outward from the caster until its energy is spent.

magica pandemonica.name: magica pandemonica
magica pandemonica.description: Mila took a small herbal pouch from her pocket. Carefully smelling that the small piece of chickweed root hadn't gotten rancid, she reluctantly took a bite. "That is disgusting.", Mila exclaimed. Krystina watched her closely as she was spitting it out. She stood there watching Mila, unimpressed. "Try again.", she said to Mila. She took another bite from the chickweed and grimaced while reciting her prayer. Daniela looked at Krystina with a worried look on her face as a strong wave of pressure struck Mila down. "Don't, worry, child. This is not her end.", Krystina said, "This is her beginning.".This powerful spell is known to enhance one's arcane capabilities, but it is also known to be a dangerous process itself and physically exhausting to the body. This prayer of has some drawbacks as it temporarily drains the vitality of the caster, unless the spell is renewed. Some talented gypsy clerics have learned a way to renew the aging cells, thus reversing some of its ill effects.

magnetic levitation.name: magnetic levitation
magnetic levitation.description: Using the power of electro-magnetism, this spell causes a single metal item to rise into the air and follow the caster around, even across teleportation. The magic of this spell means that metals other than iron and steel can be enchanted -- gold, silver, even adamantium can be affected. There is no limit on the number of items a single caster can affect with this spell, however, each item will slowly drain magical energy from the caster at a rate based on its weight. The skill 'cast control' will give some added benefits.

major heal.name: major heal
major heal.description: One of the most powerful healing spells known, is the spell major heal. While some of the weaker spells may still be very effective, most cannot recover the damage from more then one wound at a time. This spells is so powerful that several wounds, as long as only one of the wounds is a major wound, can be healed at once. Internal damage can be healed without any complications.

major party heal.name: major party heal
major party heal.description: When there are times that a multiple target healing spell  is required, the minor spell may not be enough. For these instances, there is a more powerful spell, that will heal major damage to the entire party. Many foes in the world are capable of causing damage in great amounts that may affect the entire party, therefore, a healing spell capable of undoing this damage is needed.

make scar.name: make scar
make scar.description: The dark gods thrive on chaos and destruction. Anything that possesses beauty and order, is a thorn in their sides. Thus, they grant their followers many tools with which to disrupt that which is good. One of these powers, is the devilish ability to permantly marr the physical looks of another. Disfigurement leaves lasting marks that not only can scar the person's outer appearence, but, if they have a weak heart, it can scar their soul as well.

mana barrier.name: mana barrier
mana barrier.description: Magic users are known to be vulnerable to physical stress, as they rely on their wits instead of armour to survive in this harsh realm. However, some of them have conjured up the means to use their intellectual prowess to channel this stress away from them. While the common practice is pretty easy to learn, the true masters of shielding can make it more effective, and even concentrate on the barrier to make it vanish as they please.

mana beacon.name: mana beacon
mana beacon.description: Often misunderstood as a simple illumination spell, the mana beacon throws a beam of light so bright and high it can be seen for kilometers around, even in full daylight. However useful a portable landmark of this kind might be, the light is not its primary purpose. An experienced mana mage can use these beacons to ride the light, transporting from one to the next effectively instantly. The 'cast teleportation' skill creates a longer-lasting beacon.

mana drain.name: mana drain
mana drain.description: Magical power has never been without limit. Usually one is limited by the amount of magical power he can conjure forth and hold in himself for an indefinite period of time. Once this amount is exhausted, he must regain his magical abilites through time, or other means. Those who shun order, may try to use a spell that takes magical power from others around them, and gives them a portion of that power. This spell is greatly disdained by those who consider themselves true wielders of magic, since the amount gained by the caster is less then that taken from others, and has no other useful affect, hence, a portion of that magical energy is lost forever. It is said that magic is limited, not only in individuals, but also in this very realm, and if it is not used carefully, it could vanish.

mana shield.name: mana shield
mana shield.description: In order to combat an increasing number of chaotic mages who cast the disdained spell mana drain with frequency, a magical shield which prevents against such drains was developed. Those who believe in the true order of magic use this spell whenver they encounter one who wishes to sap them of their power.

mark of death.name: mark of death
mark of death.description: When the inevitable death approaches, people relieve stress by believing that everything will be alright in the afterlife. Even the cruelest of men often respect the enemy and wish to give them a proper burial and do not necessarily wish ill for their victim in the afterlife. However, some men are not that compassionate. The history knows men who sought the servants of darkness to perform the mark of death, to make sure that the life of their enemy would continue to be miserable, even in the afterlife.

mass summon.name: mass summon
mass summon.description: At times when the troops are on the battlefield, it may be necessary to call ones comrades to battle in a hurry. Through the use of teleportation magic, navigators have proven helpful to their leaders in summoning their party members to battle through the focused channeling of teleportation magic. While the use of such magic is quite powerful, the use of such widely applied powers has proven to be disastrous in confined spaces.

mellon collie.name: mellon collie
mellon collie.description: Depression is a strange thing. It can cause a creature to lose their will to live and carry on. This can be devastating as one can well imagine. When a creature is depressed it tends to be weaker and hit less frequently then one that is full of life and vigorous.

melodical embracement.name: melodical embracement
melodical embracement.description: Sarmangoth sighed. Working with younglings could be so draining sometimes. Suddenly the thought hit him; if he turned the lesson into a song then maybe those pied pipers would remember! Yes! Indeed, they would remember.. Inspiration made his fingers grind his chosen instrument of power with precision so accurate, long, long lost to the bards of the second wake. After that, his tutorlage was sought not just by bards but also by paladins, magicians and common people for years afterwards..
melodical embracement.spell_vocals: Once there were two knights and maidens They'd walk together Out in the gardens In all kinds of weather The maidens had other plans for the two knights They'd give them potions And make them see dreams and lights

melody of the misadventurer.name: melody of the misadventurer
melody of the misadventurer.description: A bard is seldom vindictive, never mean. He uses his powers as a court jester, to make the mighty see sense and ridiculing the truths carved in stone. But there are times when the words go unheard, and harsher methods are required.Puhuri wrote this song so that even that can be done with style befitting a bard.
melody of the misadventurer.spell_vocals: Young bard he saw, a misjustice done, he took his instrument and pointed as a gun

mental glance.name: mental glance
mental glance.description: The discovery of magic gave mortals the chance to taste having god-like powers. Feats once only dreamed up became possible to those who learned to harness this new art. It is said that the gods watch those who live in the mortal world, some for amusement, others for different reasons, some good, some bad. The mind has always been one of the key tools in harness magical power. One ability available to those who care to learn it, is the ability to spy on another. From afar, they can create a mental image of the environment of their target, who may or may not feel the presence of the enchantment.

mental watch.name: mental watch
mental watch.description: One of the more devious spells ever devised, is an enhanced version of the spell mental glance. Called 'mental watch' this spell allows the caster to leave his eyes in a place, yet not be there. He can see all that goes on, in fact, this magical vision is even more powerful then the naked eye, sometimes revealing the thoughts of those who are in that room. This spell has been the cause of several large wars, one side discoved that another had tried to gain an advantage in negotiations, causing a great war that still breeds distrust among both sides, even though the actual fighting has been over for generations.However, there are some limitations regarding the use of this spell. Information acquired with it may not be made public. The caster is adviced to become familiar with 'help snooping'.

mesmeric threshold.name: mesmeric threshold
mesmeric threshold.description: Being the masters of the mind, psionicists possess the power to induce it into a special state of trance. When used upon a person this power numbs him to the stimuli, which would in other circumstances make him lose his concentration. However, when the stimulus is strong enough this trickery is hardly enough. Each time the mind is put to a test the mental overlay created by this spell is weakened.The study of mental strength begins from oneself and therefore the psionicist can control his own thoughts more easily than those of others. Theory of mental power and knowledge of mental defence increase the effect of this spell.

meteor blast.name: meteor blast
meteor blast.description: The spell meteor blast is the first spell learned by fire mages that is considered a composite spell. Not only is the energy of fire brought forth, it is first melded into a much more devastating form.  In this spell, the fire takes the form of tiny flaming meteors that fly and crash into the target, burning him and making his day a generally bad one. Due to the extra effort needed to form the fire energy into the desired state, more effort is required for this spell then by any of the pure fire spells.

meteor swarm.name: meteor swarm
meteor swarm.description: One of the more powerful characteristics of fire is the ability to cover a large area at once. That very ability gives the spell meteor swarm, devastating power. An entire group of enemies can be struck at once with the showering meteors. Not only is this a composite spell, but also an area attack spell. This makes it a demanding spell to cast, but very handy against multiple foes.

mind blast.name: mind blast
mind blast.description: Those who study the vast untapped powers of the mind and meld it with magic are capable of terrific feats. Their powers grant them many vicious forms of attack, they are able to harm their foes with a mere thought. One of the first disciplines learned with offensive capabilities, is the one known as 'mind blast.' This technique, while basic relative to other psionic attacks, still is a fearful experience to one who has never been in combat with a psionicist. Momentary dizziness and a sharp headache are the results of this spell.

mind development.name: mind development
mind development.description: Those who study the powers of the mind, learn early on that limitations on their own powers are only false limits set in their own minds. Once they fully understand this, they are able to temporarily exceed the normal limitations of their mental and magical power, if even for a short time. Those who are more disciplined can defy these limitations for an extended period of time, much longer then amateurs and recreational practicers of this art.

mind disruption.name: mind disruption
mind disruption.description: One of the more powerful forms of attack used by psionicists is the spell known as 'mind disruption.' Through minor concentration they are able to mentally attack the mind of their victim. This sudden introduction of foreign mental power instantly overloads their mental thought processes. Not only does this cause intense pain as it attacks the nervous systems in the mind, it also is known to black the victims out for a short time, as their brains are temporarily overloaded from the attack.

mind siphon.name: mind siphon
mind siphon.description: Followers of Nergal have inherited ability to command and order their parasites through mind melting. Using this ability cultist are able to further bolster parasites capabilities during battle by acting as a leader and commander for their minions. Giving the spell a target lets master control minions actions in battle. Usage: cast 'mind siphon'        cast 'mind siphon' help        cast 'mind siphon' minion target jane

mind store.name: mind store
mind store.description: One of the unique abilities a psionicist has, as a general rule, is a near perfect photographic memory. Even great sages, older then the mountains, can never dream of possessing the ability to memorize knowledge as well as a powerful psionicist. One application of this power, is the ability to 'map' and memorize their current location. Once this is done, only a mere thought is needed to instantly bring them back to this point. This is a powerful ability indeed.

mindseize.name: mindseize
mindseize.description: Even though this spell is normally referred to as mindseize, the name is not entirely correct. It does not actually seize the mind itself, it seizes an image of the mind. Getting mental images helps a psionicist better understand how the mind works, and perhaps more importantly, what weaknesses there are and how to use them. Being subject to intrusion into one's mind is likely to throw one off balance for a second or two. Naturally it's more useful to get insights into the minds of powerful beings. The actual image can only be gotten at the precise time of death, but it is possible to cast this spell in advance to get a grip of the target's mind. Trying to extract an image from a target that has an incompatible mind might result in severe pain for the caster. This spell only works on monsters.

minor heal.name: minor heal
minor heal.description: Once it was established that there was indeed a limit to the extent of healing that curing magic could accomplish, a few priests started to research some different approaches to obtaining better results with magical healing. The first successful spell, was able to easily outmatch even the best known healing spell at the time. Large gaping wounds were instantly healed and mended. Even damage to internal organs could be mended, however precariously. This spell also led way to several more powerful healing spells as well.

minor party heal.name: minor party heal
minor party heal.description: While many spells are able to heal the wounds of one target, there are some spells that are able to heal the wounds of  several at once. This type of magic is very useful when traveling in large bands and some healing is needed uniformly. This spell is able to cure most light wounds with ease on a large group.

minor protection.name: minor protection
minor protection.description: Minor protection is traditionally known to be a folklorist defensive spell. The effect is similar, and thus not cumulative, to the spells protection from good and protection from evil, but this spell protects the target whatever its alignment may be. The protection offered is not too great, but every little bit counts when the going gets rough.

mirror image.name: mirror image
mirror image.description: One family of magicians which have been around since the conception of magic, is that of the illusionists. Using magic to fool the naked eye was one of the first testing grounds of magical power. One of the most useful applications of illusionary magic, is that of the mirror magic. By casting this spell, duplicate images of the target will appear, confusing any attacker into hitting false targets. Unfortunately, moving will cause the mirror images  to disappear.

mobile cannon.name: mobile cannon
mobile cannon.description: This spell can be used to teleport the target to a location known by the caster. Give the name of the target and the location as the target of the spell. For example: cast 'mobile cannon' anipa The swamp Mastery of location reduces the mana cost of this spell. You will need the skill Location memory to use this spell. The actual spellcost depends on the distance of the travelled trip.

money is power.name: money is power
money is power.description: This spell can be used to convert money to experience. All money carried by the target will be converted to experience. The amount of experience given per gold depends on the caster's ability to cast the spell. Knowledge of metamorphosis raises the experience ratio. If you cast the spell on yourself, you get more experience than if you cast it on another player.

monster lore.name: monster lore
monster lore.description: When in battle, the most useful advantage one can possess is knowledge about one's enemy. Knowing how hard of a challenge you face should affect your strategy, your expended effort, and how much backup you choose to bring. This spell taps into the collective memories of thousands of warriors for any clues as to how a monster, or something like this monster, might act in a fight. Knowledge of identification and a high intelligence are required for good results. Since this spell relies on previous battles with monsters, not all of the information necessarily applies to the target.

moon sense.name: moon sense
moon sense.description: It is a commonly known fact that the one of the greatest factors that involve magic is the moon. For reasons not understood, the moon and its state has a great influence on the magic of this world. Since it has such great impact on spellcasting, it is useful to know what the moon may be doing at any given moment. By calling on the favor of Lumine, Mistriss of Twilight, the goddess of neutrality, the current state of the moon can be revealed, since the moon is neutral in its favor, affecting both good and evil without discretion.

mould ring.name: mould ring
mould ring.description: You can mould a ring from a material and a gem. Your skill, mastery, the  material and gem you use will dictate how good a ring is. Materials will be  used from your environment (all ore present of the specified type).  Syntax: cast mould ring at <mould> gem <gem> material <material>  Components: material, gem, and a ring mould.

musicians alm.name: musicians alm
musicians alm.description: All of the Shadowstrings haven't been so honest than Amarth is. One of his ancestors found out that if a song was charming enough, he could actually find people helping his welfare. After finding out the GOOD sides of this song, all bards suddenly started using it (wonder why?).

natural renewal.name: natural renewal
natural renewal.description: There are many creatures, most notable undeads, that are able to use dark magic to weaken their foe for a lengthy time. Physical and mental attributes are always at risk to be lowered from a curse when fighting such creatures. In the event that this happens, this spell is able to restore the attribute to  its original level and provides a level of residual protection.

natural transformation.name: natural transformation
natural transformation.description: Springtime is when nature emerges as a changing force, altering the land and making everything new. Animals migrate in search of food, hungry after the winter. New plants grow to replace those that died after the harsh winter. This spell causes a similar change in a natural environment which has not yet been tainted by the hands of technology.

necrotic bane.name: necrotic bane
necrotic bane.description: The stranger takes a step forward. Another step, followed by another. The stranger keeps walking, but not alone. He is followed by horseflies, carrion-crawlers and vultures. He is already dead and the creatures sense it. One last step and he stops in front of a woman. He takes a look at her visage while his mouth, nose and eyes fall off his face. Sa'hr is a relentless mistress...

neutralize field.name: neutralize field
neutralize field.description: One of the unique problems those who face magic using foes, is the ability of powerful magic users to create magical fields that can hinder, or even completely stop their efforts. In order to combat this type of obstacle, a counter spell was created that conjured a magical sphere that hovers in the air. Upon contact with any magical field, that field is instantly disrupted, even if the field was created in an area already occupied by the sphere.

new body.name: new body
new body.description: The most advanced form of bringing life to a dead soul,  involves not only raising the soul from the dead, but also restoring the body. The new body is fresh and whole, but will take time to meld to the soul which returns from the dead  virtually intact. If the original body was weak, care must be taken, or the strain of changing bodies may be too much, since much of the soul's strength does reside in the body itself.

nightfall.name: nightfall
nightfall.description: This spell summons a magical darkness that spreads to the surroundings.

noble animal spirit.name: noble animal spirit
noble animal spirit.description: Just because an animal has fallen in battle, that does not mean it is not a worthy steed or companion. With this spell, a knight/animist can bestow the same protection on a summoned animal soul as the 'noble mount' spell provides on a living steed. It also provides the animal spirit with a set of barding as well. Syntax: cast noble animal spirit at <target> name <new name> adjective <adj> <adj> is like the personal race adjective Only one mount can exist with a given name at any time. A name of a mount that mysteriously vanishes cannot be used for a month.

noble mount.name: noble mount
noble mount.description: In a world where famous swords are wielded, legendary shields are equipped, and epic armour is worn, it is only fitting that a knight's steed could gain the same level of respect. This spell transforms a normal specimen of a mount into a named creature of superior ability and courage. Syntax: cast noble mount at <target> name <new name> adjective <adj> <adj> is like the personal race adjective Only one mount can exist with a given name at any time. A name of a mount that mysteriously vanishes cannot be used for a month.

nocturnal charm.name: nocturnal charm
nocturnal charm.description: Night is often said to be the time of the unholy and nocturnal creatures. When there's evil lurking, it usually lurks during the night. These dwellers of the night avoid light and consider darkness more comfortable. Some nocturnal creatures also draw their power from darkness and mysterious sources. While some denizens, such as many legionaries of Kharim, do not have the innate ability to revel in the night, there's a magical charm that can bestow the gift to everyone.

noituloves deathlore.name: noituloves deathlore
noituloves deathlore.description: A story goes that when Noitulove started playing with his first instrument (stolen and given to him by a thievish friend), the FIRST time he played it, it just happened - everyone's ears started bleeding. After that, he couldn't make it to happen again until just late years.. Related to a poor area attack song.
noituloves deathlore.spell_vocals: Thar! Rauko! Mor! Ris-Rim! Fuin-Heru! GOR! Gurthgwath!n

noituloves dischord.name: noituloves dischord
noituloves dischord.description: In the early dawn of Shadowkeep's construction, Noitulove, already a notorious bard of the era, did some serious researching at the stones from which the Great library of Shadowkeep was formed. He found out in his exclusive and ear-destructing experiments that when one plays an instrument from the right distance, volume and pitch - you actually can target the sound into one direction and create a horrible tune which no one can bear without getting his/her/its eardrums disrupted or badly hurting! (power: dexterity)

nourish enthralled.name: nourish enthralled
nourish enthralled.description: Minions controlled by parasites are only as strong as the parasite in command. By nourishing and feeding the parasite, the strength and characteristics of the minion can overcome what others consider impossible. Parasites can be nourished with either potentia or vitae harvested from the foes by parasites master.

noxious fumes.name: noxious fumes
noxious fumes.description: Similar to more common spell, poison cloud, noxious fumes can be very annoying and dangerous nuisance. The most powerful magicians of the art of toxicology have found a way to produce gas like substance containing venomous constituents. With intense body and mind consentration one can channel noxious fumes through his glands and skin. Since fumes tend to spread out fast in the air it is very important that the caster masters his spell well. Knowledge of toxicology helps focusing the gas into cloud like formation and thus avoiding the unwanted targets.

paralyze.name: paralyze
paralyze.description: Instead of bombarding their enemy's mind with psychic attacks, more powerful psionicists may find that a more subtle form of attack is more effective. By carefully concentrating on their foe, they can freeze the thoughts of their victim, in effect paralyzing them, leaving them helpless to attack. One can only be kept in check for a short time, if at all, as this is a very demanding task. Once the hold on the target's mind is lost, their thought auras are left scrambled for a short time, making it impossible to attempt this form of attack again, until the target's thought process stabilizes.

paranoia.name: paranoia
paranoia.description: This spell induces a state of paranoia in the recipient.It can be cast on monsters or players, but it will have little effect on a monster.

parasitic swarm.name: parasitic swarm
parasitic swarm.description: Through gift from Lord Nergal himself, followers of the Rot are able to control parasites and lesser insects in their favor. This ability has lead to practice of controlling swarm of parasites to inflict local colonies of diseases on victims skin resulting in pain and suffering as colonies erupt and poison the victim. This spell can stack effects depending on casters mastery.

patch item.name: patch item
patch item.description: With precise knowledge of alchemy you can get any item to absorb dragonscale  thus repairing it. This comes with a cost though, mixing draconscale with  other alloys lessens the seams of the equipment.  Component: item and dragonscale.

pathfinder.name: pathfinder
pathfinder.description: A pathfinder's way is like no other man's way; either it leads to destruction or happiness. Wandering bards have often been known to find their way home even from the deepest of jungles and forests. A rumour goes that it is not safe, though. Not from many mouths have I heard this, but some say that the dangers could be evaded with a feather of the efreeti - why, no knowledge has been whispered to my ears. I do hear such items to be sold by Dwarkil, of Shadowkeep. Experiment with your own risk, certain death awaits?                                     -- Amarth Shadowstring targets: keep, inn or nothing for start location.
pathfinder.spell_vocals: Fo fu fe fum, Lord of the Winds, I know Thy ways, I know Thy names, I know Thy rest. Fo fu fe fum, show me paths or slay me now. Fo fe fi fum.

personal force field.name: personal force field
personal force field.description: While there are many reasons a channeller would want to bring energy towards or into their body, there are just as many times when the reverse is desired. Flaming dragon breath, bolts of lightning, or other hazards of adventuring life are also forms of energy, and the channeller would like nothing more than to move them far away. The personal force field is a spherical shell that can aid in repelling such attacks. However it takes a lot of energy to maintain the field, and this drain spikes when the field is actually struck. It should be noted that channeller spells can pass from inside the field to outside, but many other spells cannot. Furthermore the field is an energy effect, not a physical construct, so while it will allow air to pass through the same can be said for arrows and swords.

pestilence.name: pestilence
pestilence.description: Pestilence is an evil thing. One who has studied enough and knows the ways of evil can, with the help of the gods, call down the effects of one of the four horsemen onto another player.
pestilence.spell_vocals: Harken to me and hear my plea, disease is what I call to thee

phantasmal reflection.name: phantasmal reflection
phantasmal reflection.description: A cited proverb says: "Mirrors do everything we do, but they cannot think for themselves.". While it is not known who first came up with this great wisdom, it is probable that they hadn't heard of legionaries of Kharim who are able to animate their own mirror images by giving them a soul and taking advantage of placid reflective surfaces, such as large mirrors or lakes. Against the common belief, such creatures are able to think and are controlled by the soul that has been transferred to the mirrorized body. While these artificial undead wights act freely, they must submit to the calls of their creator.

phaze shift.name: phaze shift
phaze shift.description: The action psionicists refer to as shifting phazes, is just another name for their form of teleportation. By referencing a location stored in their memory through the technique known as 'mind store,' they are able to shift their mental AND physical beings into that location, as long as they have a firm mental picture of that location.

planar gate.name: planar gate
planar gate.description: Perhaps the most powerful of the Wanderer's spells is the Planar Gate. This vortex stabilizes into a bidirectional gateway that players may cross at will, although with each crossing the bridge becomes more unstable. Mastery of rifts greatly improves the number of crossings that may be made, as well as the time for which the bridge will last. The target of this spell is always a player.

poison blast.name: poison blast
poison blast.description: While most methods of poisoning a target rely on ingestion, or penetration of the skin by some method such as a dagger, poison mages have found a much simpler way to go about this. By hitting the target with a short burst of energy based upon their knowledge of magical poisons, a toxin can be introduced into the target without outward physical penetration. This spell generally causes very sharp pain, but no long term effects. Some creatures are vulnerable enough to toxins that they may experience some vomiting and some other irritation to their digestive systems.

poison scan.name: poison scan
poison scan.description: Poison, unlike most hazards faced by adventurers, has a way of sticking around long after the original attack. The best way to prepare for it is to know when it's coming. This spell tests the target's ability to do poison, venom, or toxic damage to you. It works on monsters, trapped boxes, mysterious liquids, and a few other things. Strong poison is the easiest to detect. Cast information increases the spell's sensitivity.

poison spray.name: poison spray
poison spray.description: With the spell poison spray, the caster can call forth a fine mist of poison that can spray an entire area of foes. This poison when inhaled attacks the respiratory system and also can cause damage to the eyes. Contact with outer skin  causes boils. Many overlords use a poison mage to clear out rioting peasants, as using poison will not damage physical property, but still has the wanted affect on the targets.

power blast.name: power blast
power blast.description: This spell is similar to the spell poison blast,  except that the energy used against the target is much greater, resulting in a much more powerful poison. Mindnumbing pain will incapacitate many weaker victims. The nervous system will also be attacked, causing some convulsions. Those who have survived a poison blast can attest that it is an experience that they did not enjoy  at all.

prepare flask.name: prepare flask
prepare flask.description: This spell can be used prepare an empty flask for potion mixing.

preserve corpse.name: preserve corpse
preserve corpse.description: This spell preserves a corpse so that it will not rot away. The corpse must be on the ground or in your inventory. mastery of arctic powers lessens the strain caused by this spell on the corpses, lessening the chance of disintegration.

prismatic burst.name: prismatic burst
prismatic burst.description: This is a powerful offensive spell that allows the caster to use mage staff to assemble elements acquired from the schools of magic. The elements are then transformed into projectiles that will hit the target. Damage caused by the spell depends on the element that is used to create the projectile. This spell can only be cast once per target. The damage done by the spell depends on knowledge of the spell and elements.

protect armour.name: protect armour
protect armour.description: Magic has always been cherished for its abilities to protect items. One of the more ironic uses of this power, is the granting of magical protection to various forms of armour, which is designed to afford protection of its own, on the wearer. Armour through day to day use, is subject to much abuse and wear. Magical protection is usually one of the best ways one can preserve the life span of his armour. It is a lot cheaper than buying a new shiny platemail every week.

protect item.name: protect item
protect item.description: While this is a rarely used spell, there are some items that demand its use. Extremely precious items, such as heirlooms and other valued treasures may call for special protection against harm. This type of magical protection is in demand in areas where natural (or unnatural) disasters are common, threatening the existance of the item.

protect mount.name: protect mount
protect mount.description: Many warriors keep their prized possessions safely guarded, by thick doors, watchmen, traps, and, when called for, magic. If that prized possession happens to be a living creature, then even more care is taken. This spell guards a mount or similar beast of burden, making it more resistant to all forms of attack, and also allowing it to recover from damage faster than it normally would.
protect mount.spell_vocals: it's ok, I won't let anyone hurt you

protect weapon.name: protect weapon
protect weapon.description: While weapons are used to inflict death upon one's foe, the very weapon itself may be subject to harm. Only the most durable, and usually magically enchanted, weapons are unbreakable, and this quality of weapon is very rare indeed. Most weapons if not used properly, or through some freak accident, may fail during battle. Weapons may splinter, crack, or even shatter under the extreme rigors of combat. Magical spells may offer some protection giving the wielder of that weapon a little more peace of mind, knowing that he is less likely to find himself without his trusty sword, when the time comes where he needs it most.

protection from evil.name: protection from evil
protection from evil.description: Protection from evil provides good protection against evil fiends and somewhat minor protection against undeads. When successfully cast target is surrounded with invisible layer of holy force. Duration and strength of the aura depends on casters abilities. The more evil the attacker is the better cover is provided. The duration and power of the protection are based on caster's wisdom and alignment. Mastery of shielding and a good relic are required for best protection. The protective aura can be boosted by sprinkles of holy water. Old nuns with high purity of heart are known to be able to enhance the protection thus giving shelter against other evil actions.

protection from good.name: protection from good
protection from good.description: Those who fight the unholy war against all that is good, have been able to cast enhancements that make them resistant to many forms of attack. Through a dark ceremony, they are able to create a magical aura upon the target that serves as a ward against good. This is an invaluable aid in the one true war, the only one that matters.

psi blast.name: psi blast
psi blast.description: A much more powerful version of the basic psionic attack mind blast, is the spell known as psi blast. With a mere thought, the caster inflicts intense mental pain on the target. The sudden pain suffered by the victim has a chance to render them helpless as their mind attempts to recover from the attack.

psibolt.name: psibolt
psibolt.description: One form of attack that psionicists is one that allows them to draw upon their mind and form a short, but powerful burst of mental energy. This bolt of mental energy is focused on the target, and attacks their mind. The resulting effects on the target include intense pain and may in extreme cases, render the victim helpless for a brief second as they recover from the attack.

psionic phalanx.name: psionic phalanx
psionic phalanx.description: The secret of the psychic phalanx had been thought lost for eons, but has recently been revealed to the mortal realm once again. It is a trick of the mind, as the target's brain waves are given a barely noticable telepathic link to every other living creature out to the horizon. When the affected creature is struck by a spell or other affect that could damage his mind, some of the damage is split amongst these links. The victim, therefore, escapes partially or totally unharmed, while the links divide the remaining damage over so many creatures that they feel nothing at all.
psionic phalanx.spell_vocals: all for one, gather around me

psionic shield.name: psionic shield
psionic shield.description: This spell drains the caster's maximum spell points and raises the hit point maximum for a certain duration.  Powerful shields require slight upkeep.  Those with high enough knowledge of mental defences can specify the amount of spell points they wish to allocate to the shield.  Keyword max also works.

psychic crush.name: psychic crush
psychic crush.description: One of the most dangerous forms of attack used by psionicists, is a powerful spell called 'psychic crush.' Using their minds, they obtain their opponents mind, and put it in a mental 'grasp.' Once this is locked in, they use their power to create a mental force that attacks their foe's mind, virtually crushing it from the fury of the attack. Tremendous damage is suffered as the attack overloads the victim's mind. The magnitude of the attack is great enough that the nervous system also undergoes a great deal of duress, sometimes causing the victim to remain helpless for a few moments after the attack as he loses control of his body as his mind attempts to clear itself after the attack.

psychic purge.name: psychic purge
psychic purge.description: Psionicsts, normally possessing terrific offensive capabilites, may find themselves helpless against a foe who has some sort of inate, or magical resistance to their mental attacks. Upon encountering such a foe, they are not helpless however, this battle simply becomes a battle of minds. The psionicist's mind attempts to overload and weaken the defenses of the target's mind. A successful psychic purge, can lower the ability of the target to defend himself from mental attacks for a short time, allowing the psionicist to press the attack.
psychic purge.spell_vocals: aamad ato naav aanarub atyak ala

psychic sanctuary.name: psychic sanctuary
psychic sanctuary.description: In an attempt to protect one's self or another from devastating psionic attacks, a spell has been devised that puts an aura of uncertainty around the mind of the one who wishes to be protected. This aura makes it more difficult for a psionic attacker to probe the target's mind, thus making  them expend extra effort which decreases the magnitude of any attack of this form.
psychic sanctuary.spell_vocals: toughen da mind reeez un biis

psychic shackles.name: psychic shackles
psychic shackles.description: When psionicists battle their foes, the main objective of their spells isn't always aimed to cause as extensive damage as possible. Every now and then, it is more desirable to make a surgical strike at a certain location of the target's mind. These attacks are often aimed to impair the target's performance in combat. The mental shackles assault the id--an unconscious part in person's psyche--and place mental blockades that deter the actions of the target. As a result, performing seemingly simple tasks might be deemed unthinkable in practice.

psychic shout.name: psychic shout
psychic shout.description: Psionicsts are not limited to attacking single targets. One method of attack that can affect more then one target is a psychic 'shout.' This involves the caster, creating with his mind, a large burst of mental energy that is released into surroundings. This mental energy attacks the mind of anyone who happens to be in the target area. This spell is refered to as a 'shout,' due to the loud verbal command needed to execute this spell. Once the command is uttered, the effects are instantaneous, making it seem like the verbal command, or shout, is the cause of the damage to the targets, not the mental portion of the spell.

psychic storm.name: psychic storm
psychic storm.description: The most devastating form of attack used by psionicists, is the spell 'psychic storm.' The caster, with his mind, draws deep and conjures forth a tremendous amount of mental power. Usually the amount of power in this spell is so great, even the caster may not be able to completely control it all. The caster then releases this energy into the target area, devastating the minds of anyone who is there. The effects are similar to having a psychic crush cast on each individual in the area.

putrid blood.name: putrid blood
putrid blood.description: Victims blood becomes infected, causing severe physical pain as their body tries to reject its own blood as poisonous. As the disease runs its course the victim will have increasingly difficult time to concentrate on anything requiring focus. This spell is in effect while emitting aura through embracing gifts bestowed upon the acolyte by Lord Nergal and thus it cannot be casted by normal means.

quicksilver.name: quicksilver
quicksilver.description: Some magic enables one to perform normally inhuman feats. The spell known as quicksilver enables one to dodge attacks that would normally hit one's self. Granting enhanced agility and speed, those who are enchanted with this spell have a huge advantage over those who aren't. Requires a quantity of quicksilver.

racial protection.name: racial protection
racial protection.description: A folklorist defensive spell. Protects the target against the members of one race. You must have studied the race before you are able to create the protection, and the protection is slightly better for well-studied races. The protection offered is better than that of the more wider range protective spells, such as zoological protection. Usage: cast racial protection at <player> race <race>.

rain.name: rain
rain.description: Druids who have mastered the elements of nature are able to summon the weather to their aid. Using their druid staff, they can create a magical field in an area which simulates rain, which can produce a large amount of water, even local flooding. There are tales of unique and crafty uses for this type of magic...

raise dead.name: raise dead
raise dead.description: Even if every precaution has been taken, death is not  unavoidable. The world is simply too harsh and demanding and living forever is but a dream. Once a person dies, he is left  as a ghost, trapped in hell. If one knows the right magic, he may be able to raise that person from the dead. This spell requires that the ghost be willing to be brought back into this cruel world, or the spell will have no effect. This is the crudest of the spells of this type, and therefore, the least forgiving on the dead soul.

rapture of the deep.name: rapture of the deep
rapture of the deep.description: Few travellers take to the seas, and even fewer try to learn the songs of the sea. Those who do are invariably changed, as they seem to gain an inner peace; however, some become so enthralled that they never wish to leave the oceans. There are people that claim that these few had gained some mysterious power from the deep, which changed them into the first merfolk. Whilst legends such as these can not be proven, it is definitely true that these rare songs spring from some primal and vital power.
rapture of the deep.spell_vocals: Salvage from the ice cold tomb, reveal the passage yonder womb. Float, not sink to darkness deep, for tomorrow we'll let the grim one reap.

reanimation.name: reanimation
reanimation.description: This spell reanimates a dead player. A part of experience is lost in this uncertain and utterly disgusting operation. Component: You need a fresh corpse for this spell.

reap potentia.name: reap potentia
reap potentia.description: Harnessing the cruel rites Nergal has granted him/her, the cultist begins a ritual which will slowly drain the expertise and mental acuity from the victim, weakening them considerably and draining them of their knowledge which can later on be passed on to their thralls.

reaping of bile.name: reaping of bile
reaping of bile.description: Acid is a substance most treat with caution and respect, but not reavers. A liquid that eats through flesh, bone, and metal with equal ease is like a beacon of hope to them, showing them that even water can be cruel at times. Through the use of this spell, a reaver can coat his or her wielded weapon with acid, which will not damage the weapon but will eat away at anything it touches. Destructive energy is not required for this spell.
reaping of bile.spell_vocals: Grant this the caustic touch, to cleanse the world

recall animal soul.name: recall animal soul
recall animal soul.description: With this spell you can recall your animal soul mount back next to you, from wherever it is. Or almost. Some limits apply, like you cannot usually recall your mount across continents.Usage: cast recall animal soul

regenerate rift entity.name: regenerate rift entity
regenerate rift entity.description: A riftwalker can heal their entity by drawing rift energy from the void and focusing it on their minion. Knowledge of rift energy flow is known to help the effect of this spell. It also works on other riftwalker entities, allowing you to assist in the regeneration of anothers entity.
