The energy flow is disrupted when in combat, however 'Energy revival' will allow a certain amount of healing to still happen. If a riftwalker casts this spell on his/her own magic entity, the spell will be reflected back on the riftwalker, healing him/her. The more knowledge of 'Energy revival' the magic entity has, the more the spell will heal the master.

regeneration.name: regeneration
regeneration.description: Virtually all battles have one thing in common: casualties and wounded. Even if it is a bloodless effort, physical and perhaps magical effort are spent towards the final result. Time may not be on the side of those who survive, time needed to recover from the battle and prepare for the next. Using magical spells, the time needed to recover can be reduced, by increasing the rate at which one is able to recover from physical and magical exertion.

reincarnation.name: reincarnation
reincarnation.description: Once one has used up the precious amount of 'life energy' granted him in his lifetime, he may be forced to start a new, in a different life. The soul may stay intact, the body is gone forever, returning to dust. Some even choose to start a brand new life on this world when they are bored with their current one. This is a drastic measure and a feat only accomplished through powerful magical means. One should take great care in choosing this path, as there is no return. You need a water lily flower to cast this spell.

relocate.name: relocate
relocate.description: Another twist of the summoning genre of spells, is the spell relocate. With this spell, one is able to travel instantly to another location, that is targeted by choosing another person to relocate to. Certain areas will block relocate spells, but where it is possible, this is a very handy spell indeed. In fact, long ago, an entire castle was raided due to this spell. It could withstand any siege, but a crafty warlord had a group of mages relocate into the castle and open the gates. Ever since, many strongholds now have preventative runes against summoning magic cast upon them.

remote banking.name: remote banking
remote banking.description: This spell allows you to do remote banking. This means that you can do anything that can be done in the bank room. For example:>cast 'remote banking' withdraw 1000

remove curse.name: remove curse
remove curse.description: Adventurers on their travels occasionally find cursed items, and Alas, some of them too curious or too impatient to identify the item also try wearing or wielding it before finding out what it really does. This spell is used for helping unlucky persons with worn or wielded cursed items, though sometimes it might serve a purpose to not to remove the cursed item, so that person might learn not to wear an item before knowing what it really does.

remove poison.name: remove poison
remove poison.description: Poisoning seems to be a common occurance to today's adventurers. Some show their prowess by suffering through the pain and effects of the poisons to prove that they can. If that isn't your style, this spell's for you. It will attempt to remove your poison. Syntax to remove all poisons from a target: cast remove poison at <target> Syntax to remove a specific poison: cast remove poison at <target> <poison>

remove scar.name: remove scar
remove scar.description: There are many events that can cause a player to undergo malevolent physical changes. Death, and other harsh events can cause scars, that will be carried for life, marring the victims physical appearance. Fortunately, the followers of the good gods can call to their gods and with spells, remove these scars, making the victim whole once again.

replenish ally.name: replenish ally
replenish ally.description: Just as channellers can pull energy from their friends into themselves, they can also reverse the process to give any surplus energy they have drained into their exhausted allies. In a sense, they are merely draining in reverse. The process is more cumbersome and tricky than the more natural transfer of energy into the caster, but at times it can be more than worth the extra effort. Syntax: cast replenish ally at <party member> amount <number>

replenish energy.name: replenish energy
replenish energy.description: Druids not only learn the magical spells dealing with nature, they also learn the magical abilities of many items that nature makes available to them. One such ability, is that of the plant mistletoe. With this plant, they are able to transfer physical endurance from themselves to another, who may be in more need of it.

replenish party.name: replenish party
replenish party.description: An extension the 'replenish ally' spell, this sacrifices the caster's spell points and distributes them to other _player_ party members in the same room. Party members missing the most energy are the ones who benefit from the most replenishing. Syntax: cast replenish party at amount <number>

repulsor aura.name: repulsor aura
repulsor aura.description: Masters of protective spells know that magical energies can be deflected or diverted by the strength of the target's aura. As such, they developed this spell, a kind of synthetic aura that can drastically reduce, possibly even eliminate, offensive energy attacks that attempt to pass through it.

resist curse.name: resist curse
resist curse.description: Curses come in many forms. It can be a personal plight someone sees as a curse or a powerful hex bestowed by a witch. The latter curses are used to turn enemies into frogs. Frogs, toads and slaads are all familiar to the frog god itself. Burglefloogah sees all of them as its own kin. While many servants of darkness might welcome transformation into the form of their god, they're also familiar with the process of transformation and are able to protect against it.

resist disintegrate.name: resist disintegrate
resist disintegrate.description: One of the most feared ways to meet one's end, is disintegration. This spell removes the target and his belongings from existance. Fortunately, there is a counter spell, that is used to temporarily protect one from meeting this particularly nasty demise. It's not quite known how this spell works, but it can prove very useful if one encounters some foe that has the dreaded power of disintegration.
resist disintegrate.spell_vocals: bii thee dzname uv tii blaaaz drazon

resist dispel.name: resist dispel
resist dispel.description: Some time after the spell known as dispel magical protections was learned, it was decided a counterspell would be necessary, lest protection magic become useless. A spell was discovered through laborious research that was able to meld a protective spell onto an individual with enough strength that it could not be dispelled. All that is needed, is to cast the resistance spell before the protection spell, and that spell would be safely bound to the target.

resist entropy.name: resist entropy
resist entropy.description: Death is inevitiable. While many causes of death allow one to be magically raised in some way, each time usually drains one's life force. This life force is directly linked to one's age and vitality. As one grows older, he has less time on this world. Naturally magical ways to preserve this precious time were sought after. One spell allows one to protect himself from aging and losing that precious energy to the void, though only for a short time, as aging and time cannot be stopped indefintely, all things must come to an end. This particular enchantment only resists aging cast by spells that age the target, usually cast by evil undead monsters, who take one's life energy for their own.

resist temptation.name: resist temptation
resist temptation.description: One can resist flip easily with this spell. Casters wisdom affects to the duration of the spell and the alignment and the purity of thy heart affects to the strenght of the shield.

restful sleep.name: restful sleep
restful sleep.description: This spell helps you and your party sleep extra soundly. It doesn't give you the ability to put anyone into sleep, just helps people sleep better. The spell uses up the current selected ghost, or a ghost you target.One of the more peaceful ways to use the ghosts, restful sleep asks a ghost to guard your party's sleep. The ghost is unable to fend off dangerous creatures and the like, but it is capable of handling non-mundane things like bad dreams, resulting in more restful sleep. This is once again a rather late addition to the guild, one which could have saved Samuel de Montfort's life, had he known this technique.Usage: cast restful sleep        cast restful sleep at <ghost name>

restore.name: restore
restore.description: Due to the chaotic nature of the world around us, there are many ways out there that one may be changed into something other then what nature had intended. Many magical beings revel in  turning things into frogs, or other forms to amuse themselves. While this may be amusing to that being, the target could, potentially be stuck that way for the rest of his life. To remedy such occasions, restoration magic is able to return one to his original form.

resurrect.name: resurrect
resurrect.description: A more advanced technique used to return life to a dead body, is to resurrect it. This is more involved then simply raising the soul, and therefore, brings back much more of the soul intact from the planes of hell. The downfall is that it is also more testing on the physical body. Care must always be taken not to overdraw on the body's strength and vitality, or the results may not be what is expected.

resurrect soul.name: resurrect soul
resurrect soul.description: With this spell you resurrect your killed soul from heaven. This ritual is very taxing, even more so soon after the demise. You need a soul resurrection staff for this spell.Usage: cast resurrect soul at <staff>

retool armament.name: retool armament
retool armament.description: Knights gain power for their strikes based on their knowledge of the target, and can get the maximum effect from weapons specifically designed against those creatures. This spell allows a knight to magically alter their weapon to specifically target a specific race, causing knight attack skills to be more effective against that race. Syntax: cast retool armament at <weapon> race <race to slay> The effect is permament until recast at a different race.

rift pulse.name: rift pulse
rift pulse.description: A skilled riftwalker can pull a small amount of energy from the rift world, transform it into an incredibly cold substance, and hurl it towards an opponent. As the power of the riftwalkers entities grows, the amount of energy the riftwalker can extract from the rift world will increase.

rift scramble.name: rift scramble
rift scramble.description: This spell will scramble the link between a rift entity and the world where it was created. Disrupting the link effectively means the entity will lose less power when it dies. However, the entity master will suffer a reduction in the amount of experience he/she gains. This spell will use a variable amount of rift sparks depending on the number of deaths since the entity was last pacified.

rune of warding.name: rune of warding
rune of warding.description: This spell creates a controlled disturbance in the time-space continuum in front of an interdimensional rift.  The disturbance assaults unwanted passers-by with an electric shock that can be felt.  Mastery of locating reduces the mana cost and lengthens the duration of the spell.  Mental attributes, along with the studied percentage of the spell add to the power of the spell.The caster may allow, list, and clear the permissions of the trap.   Permit/allow     : <name>/party/<name1 name2 name3...>    Clear            : [name]/[name1 name2 name3...]    List             : <name>/<permissions>

runic heal.name: runic heal
runic heal.description: Druidic magic relies on nature, and naturally posesses the ability to heal wounds. While considered nomadic and barbaric when compared to the more refined healing magic found at temples, it still is able to cure most forms of wounds, and may be the only form of magical healing available, especially outside of inhabitied areas, such as deep forests, which many druids prefer to make their home.

saintly touch.name: saintly touch
saintly touch.description: Saintly touch is the weakest spell used mostly by young nuns to dispel evil creatures. When successfully cast, purifying white flames are extracted from caster's relic, burning a symbol of purity into target's forehead while inflicting horrific pain. The amount of damage caused depends on the target's alignment. Knowledge of dispelling increases the effect.

sands of time.name: sands of time
sands of time.description: The name for the spell was given by Sawar of Taegor, who was one of the disciples of Valian Loranha and Eidein Syxoph. When Sawar started researching the spell from the old books, he was already over 100 years old. His much younger students were very eager to learn the spell, but they didn't have the wisdom to understand the cryptic words of the old books. Thus they turned to Sawar. Sawar on the other hand wasn't in very good health back then, mostly because of his old age. His younger students were worried that he might die before he was able to learn the spell and teach its mysteries to them as well. Sawar was aware of this and once he learned the spell, he humorously gave the spell its name "sands of time", referring to an hourglass and his health condition. Thus the spell itself has little to do with time. But the spell that Sawar's students learned was very valuable. It made them more powerful when cast upon an enemy. What made the spell even more powerful was that the more powerful the enemy was, the more powerful the students also felt themselves. And the weaker the enemy got, the more powerful the students once again grew. Although the students had been worried of Sawar's old age and health, he still lived a few years, before he passed away in the old age of 113 years.

satiate person.name: satiate person
satiate person.description: Starvation has plagued this world since the beginning of time. While most civilized areas have enough farmland to support themselves, war, famine, disease and other unforseen events can create a shortage of food, which leads to starvation. The followers of the good gods, in an attempt to help aleviate suffering, have found ways to supplement the food sources. Through magic they can keep one sustained almost indefintely.

searing fervor.name: searing fervor
searing fervor.description: The ancient wise men and spellcrafters believe that everything in cosmos is formed by basic elements. Fire is said to be the strongest of the elements. It has lots of potential power, but it is also said to be as fierce as it is difficult to tame. The magi have used fire to inspire them, to soothe mind and the inner flame within one's heart. Controlling the pace of the beating heart however is not entirely safe as the heart gets physically exhausted and may get strained. According to the magi, this is a good example of the difficulty when it comes to taming fire. However, there are occasional sightings of wizards being able to tame the fire completely without the nasty side effects.

see invisible.name: see invisible
see invisible.description: This spell allows target to see invisible things. It lasts for a limited time depending on the level of the caster.

see magic.name: see magic
see magic.description: Magic is truly a permanent part of our world, and comes in many forms. Usually it is useful to know the nature of some magical auras on objects one may come across. One spell that comes in very handy, is a rather simple spell that shows the elemental brand of magic that enchants a certain item, it also shows an aura if the item is enchanted at all.
see magic.spell_vocals: ahne paskianen olen ma kun taikuutta nahda tahdon

see the light.name: see the light
see the light.description: One priest, who was pondering over the problem of getting new converts to his faith, the faith of the good gods, stumbled upon an ancient scroll. Upon examination of this scroll he  realized that he could use the enscriptions of the scroll to  magically force people to drift towards the good gods. Of course this means that the conversion is not whole-hearted. At the last convention of the high priests, it was decided that this should only be used as a last resort to attempt to save the most evil and wretched souls.

separate soul.name: separate soul
separate soul.description: With this spell you can separate your soul from your body. This can be extremely hazardous to your health, but it is usually worth the risk.Usage: cast separate soul

sex change.name: sex change
sex change.description: One of the more perverse spells known is the spell sex change. This spell enables the caster to change the sex of the target. It is generally taught by good priests as a remedy in order to reverse the effects of having the spell cast by someone with evil intentions. Most priests are made to swear only to use this spell for curing purposes, in order to restore one to his/her original sex.

shadow armour.name: shadow armour
shadow armour.description: It is best defence spell improving protection.

shapechange.name: shapechange
shapechange.description: Druids, who have become attuned to nature and its inhabitants, are able to call on the patron gods who favor the animals. Certain gods take the form of animals when they visit this realm, to better serve their interests. Magical spells are taught to druids which grants them power from that god and gives the abilty to change into the form that god takes when he decides to walk among the mortals. Bears, owls, unicorns, and shrikes are a few of the choices one may attempt to change into. Rumours tell that masterful casters can also change their shape to panther, wolf, tortoise, ape, parrot or monkey. This is only a temporary change, lest one become trapped in the form of an animal, while useful is not a desirable effect to become permanent.

shattered feast.name: shattered feast
shattered feast.description: Reavers are not nihilists in the purest sense of the word. They do not believe in the destruction of everyone, merely the destruction of everyone else. They believe that, by engaging in seemingly wanton acts of rampaging, they can escape destruction themselves. This spell is a reflection of that belief. The powers of destruction reward the casting reaver by healing wounds that might otherwise kill him or her. However, the reaver must have paid for this gift in advance by destroying items or creatures of sufficient value to the powers they worship. Syntax: cast shattered feast at amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon.
shattered feast.spell_vocals: That I have set free, return to me

shelter.name: shelter
shelter.description: No monsters or players may enter the area while the spell is in effect. The players inside the area can stay there, but if they leave they may not return until the spell has ended. The spell caster may destroy the shelter at any time while inside the shelter by typing 'remove field'. The shelter also heals all living creatures that are inside the shelter.

shield of detoxification.name: shield of detoxification
shield of detoxification.description: This spell is a miracle of magical alchemy turned into a defensive spell. The aura created by the spell is a layer of poison antidote so thin it can barely be detected, looking like a thin sheet of greenish water. While hard to see, the effects are quite obvious, as the shield partially or completely neutrilizes poisonous and venomous objects that pass through it.

shield of faith.name: shield of faith
shield of faith.description: This spell grants true believer divine protection. Person under effects of this spell suffers reduced damage from all sources. Faerwon, the God of Holy War, does not like selfish use of this spell.

shield of protection.name: shield of protection
shield of protection.description: It is good defence spell improving protection.

shield of transcendence.name: shield of transcendence
shield of transcendence.description: This spell surrounds the target with an aura of goodness. The strength of the  shield is dependant how wise and old you are.

shift blade.name: shift blade
shift blade.description: Applying your specialised alchemical knowledge, you transform the blade,  imparting it material energy.  Syntax: cast shift blade at <weapon> use <material>  Component: weapon and raw material

ship armour.name: ship armour
ship armour.description: There is a decent variety of armours available for ships, but there are nowhere near as many choices available as there are for individuals. Therefore, spells play a proportionally greater role in the ship's defense. This spell is thus particularly popular among captains, for it is capable of absorbing a great deal of damage well before anything can happen to the ship itself.

shocking grasp.name: shocking grasp
shocking grasp.description: Shocking grasp is the first spell taught to electric mages. Electricity is drawn to their finger tips, which they direct at their target. The common name of the spell is misleading, one does not actually have to make physical contact with the  target, instead the electricity flows into the target as the caster clenches his fist, 'grasping' his target. The effects of this spell is a dull pain that travels through the muscle  tissue.

singing shepherd.name: singing shepherd
singing shepherd.description: After a rough night out with Masterbard Captnapalm, Loremaster Laaban was writing poetry (because that is the kind of thing that bards do, and elven chicks dig it). Three liters of water and a lot of greasy food helped, and finally the following poem was born:      Squirrel in the dirt,       Squirrel in the pool.       Squirrel don't get hurt,       Trying to stay cool.After seeing this magnum opus (a masterpiece; bards like to use fancy words for reasons mentioned above) Masterbard Qurp got so depressed that he had but one option - to write a brand new song. He couldn't quite get Laaban's cool squirrels out of his head, though.
singing shepherd.spell_vocals: Squirrel in the dirt, squirrel in the pool, squirrel don't get hurt, trying to stay cool!

sleeping parasite.name: sleeping parasite
sleeping parasite.description: This disgusting spell is used in binding a malignant parasite inside a new host. The parasite is quite unnoticeable when it is in sleeping state and still attempting to infiltrate into a living organism. When the infiltration has been completed, the parasite is no longer in sleeping state and turns into malignant parasite attempting to feed its master by deteriorating the host. Malignant parasites eventually die when the host body generates resistance against the malignant growth, but advantage on the expense of others may be gained, even if the parasite would only prove to be a small nuisance.

slingshot vortex.name: slingshot vortex
slingshot vortex.description: Sometimes, you feel like shooting someone out of a cannon, to somewhere far away. And then, at other times, you want to send them far, far away, and your cannon just isn't that powerful. With this vortex, you can latch on to a distant destination, and then suck someone else through in your place. The trip is about like being launched out of a catapult, and often is not too pleasant for the traveller.The target of the spell is '<player> to <destination>', where destination may be another player, or any of the following:  Desolathya (deso), Furnachia (furn), Laenor (lae),   Lucentium (lucent), Rothikgen (roth)

sneezing powder.name: sneezing powder
sneezing powder.description: Crush a crystalline plant into some powder and throw the powder at someone  making them sneeze.  Component: crystalline plant

soothing sounds.name: soothing sounds
soothing sounds.description: 'Aggression rules!', shouted an anonymous bard at the institute's monthly meeting. 'We cannot let the world destroy itself!', was countered from the far back of the hall. 'It is also our duty to keep peace and happiness flowing strong in the world', instructed an elder bard. A simple soothing song calmed both of the arguers.
soothing sounds.spell_vocals: Now that two decades gone by and I know that's a long time, para tiempo means nada nunca. Cause I'm still the same asshole and I still wet my pants everytime that I see your face! (who are you?) Introduce yourself! (right on!)

soul chorus.name: soul chorus
soul chorus.description: With some help of magic, you create a chorus of souls out of the souls surrounding you. Certain amount of trust between souls is required, so only party members are affected. The ethereal music has been known to improve your health, give clarity to thoughts and offer guidance to misleaded people. It also makes work faster, as you hum your way through the menial tasks that are otherwise so boring.It benefits from having a blessed candle. The ones made by followers of Las are known to work. The candle must be hand-crafted, so no buying from shops.Usage: cast soul chorus

soul guardian.name: soul guardian
soul guardian.description: While commanders of Kharim have control over their troops, they also have power over the souls that are in their possession. Sometimes, in the heat of the moment, it might prove inevitable that additional help is needed in order to survive from the combat as the victor. Controlled souls are more loyal than living troops and therefore are quite optimal for performing tasks that a single person couldn't otherwise accomplish, such as guard duties at places where the surefire death awaits.

soul hold.name: soul hold
soul hold.description: One of the most powerful spells available to the followers of Tarmalen, is the spell soul hold. Once cast, this spell is said to protect the very life force of the target, enabling him to cheat death. Due to the nature of this spell, it must be cast in a pure place, a site dedicated to Tarmalen and its followers.

soul shield.name: soul shield
soul shield.description: Soul shield grants protection against various nasty spells and curses often cast by undead and some evil foes. Sprinkling holy water on the target increases the effectiveness of the protective aura. Purity of heart and mastery of shielding both affect the strength and duration of this spell.

sounds of silence.name: sounds of silence
sounds of silence.description: The paths to the conquering of new realms are surrounded by secrecy, Aydjen thought, and while she was roaming through unseen forests, undiscovered lands and dark caverns, striving in mighty battles against frightening demons and fiendish minions, her greatest fear remained in unleashing certain critical information to an unwanted public. Thus she let her fingers flow with beautiful grace, weaving enchanting sounds on her sitar. Suddenly loud noises turned into silent breezes, malicious shouts into unheard whispers in the wind.
sounds of silence.spell_vocals: Hear this charm, there in the dark, lurking fiends, devouring sharks. Lend me your ears, out in the mist. Where secrets lie, you cannot resist. The paths I traveled, the abyss I found, shall not be seen by any hound. Accept that, when these rhymes will end, only silence is your friend

spark birth.name: spark birth
spark birth.description: A riftwalker can use this spell to encapsulate a spark of otherworld energy. A death is required in order to form the rift spark, therefore this spell needs to be active when an opponent dies. There is a chance that some additional energy will be generated when the opponent dies, which will be converted into mana for the riftwalker. As the level of the adversary increases, the number of sparks increases, as well as the chance of additional energy, and the amount of mana gained. A magic entity is known to enhance this spell in the following ways:* Enough 'Offensive might' and you will be able to use the target 'all', and all monsters attacking you will be affected. * Enough 'Offensive prowess' and you will be able to refresh the spell. The skill 'rift energy flow' is known to increase how long the effects lasts.

speed.name: speed
speed.description: This spell affects the recipient's dex. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

spell empathy.name: spell empathy
spell empathy.description: This spell allows you to copy a spell from your partymember for a limited time. You can cast the copied spell as many times as you like for the duration of spell empathy. The targets % in the spell is the max you can learn it, the actual % comes from various factors.Usage:cast spell empathy at <player> try <spell> cast spell empathy Example:cast spell empathy at rauskis try armour of aether   -Try to learn 'armour of aether'-spell from your friend Rauskis. cast spell empathy   -Unlearn a previously learned spell.

spellteaching.name: spellteaching
spellteaching.description: This spell allows you to teach a spell to another player. Taught spell can be used once. Casting % of the spell is about as low as the teachers casting % of that spell. This spell is stackable. Taught spell must be cast within 10 minutes of learning the spell. You can't teach spellteaching.This spell may also be used by the members of the psionic council to allow other psionicists to study spells from them permanently almost as if they were in the guild.Usage:  cast spellteaching at <target> with <spellname>   cast spellteaching Example:  cast spellteaching at anipa with heal  - this example teaches anipa the heal-spell.   cast spellteaching - this allows other psionists in the same room with you to 'study'   from you, provided you are a member of the psionic council.
spellteaching.spell_vocals: moon fiksu, soot tyhma  - opi tasta taika

spider walk.name: spider walk
spider walk.description: It has something to do with spiders.

spirit drain.name: spirit drain
spirit drain.description: Many reavers find satisfaction in destroying their opponents through the use of brute physical force. Others find greater pleasure in blasting their foes to pieces with their attack spells. The latter type of reaver may find this spell to be of use. It raises the maximum amount of spirit energy a reaver can withstand, enabling the prolonged casting of hostile spells without having to stop and rest. Naturally, the target whose spirit energy is drained by this assault will be hampered by its effects, and is not expected to like it. Syntax: cast spirit drain at <target> amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon. Higher amounts and mastery will improve duration, but the maximum effect is based on the amount of spirit energy the target possesses.

spontaneous combustion.name: spontaneous combustion
spontaneous combustion.description: While fire is trickier than raw energy to control, it, too, obeys certain laws of elemental nature. Some say that fire follows the fuel, others that flame chases those who fear it most. Channellers know that heat can be tricked to find some targets more worth burning, and this spell embodies that trick. By binding thermal energy to a living creature's own energies, they encourage fire and flame to rush towards it like water flowing downhill.

star light.name: star light
star light.description: Not only can druids tap into the power of nature that fills this world, they can also make use of the sun, moon and stars. One such spell that comes from this aspect of their teachings, is the spell starlight. They are able to draw on the power of the stars, and fire beams of pure starlight at the target. The darker it is, the better the spell works, similar to fact that stars can rarely be seen in the daytime.

steed of tzarakk.name: steed of tzarakk
steed of tzarakk.description: This spell summons an beastial demonic steed from the planes of Tzarakk. The Lord of Chaos can tame the steed and use it as a mount, but the creature refuses to obey orders from anybody else but its summoner.

stoneskin.name: stoneskin
stoneskin.description: It is good defence spell improving protection.

strangulation.name: strangulation
strangulation.description: This spell is a more powerful version of the spell suffocation. In addition to holding the vacuum around the target, additional forces allow the spell to keep a much stronger hold on the target, and for a longer time. The target actually is strangled away as if a garrote was being used, but with much more effectiveness then a simple garrote.

strength in unity.name: strength in unity
strength in unity.description: A little bard called Aarugotti found, quite accidentally, a way to unite his companions into a single fighting unit while being demolished by a horde of orcs. Later he discovered that the unity would last only as long as the danger to the party and that there was no unity in running away.
strength in unity.spell_vocals: You say you don't believe this unity will last, nobody said it would be perfect, but co-operate, share your pain and strength. Together we are strong.

strengthen.name: strengthen
strengthen.description: This spell affects the recipient's str. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

suffocation.name: suffocation
suffocation.description: This spell is similar to the spell vacuumbolt, as it  creates a mass of airless space. Instead of being directed at the target and dissipating, this spell causes that  mass of space to surround the target for a short while, then dissapating. This denies the target air, sucking what is in its lungs out while the mass surrounds the target.

summon.name: summon
summon.description: One powerful tools at those who have knowledge in teleportation magic, is summoning magic. By  reaching through time and space, they can bring a person to their location at their whim. This is not an all powerful tool, it cannot be used on those who are magically shielded from summoning affects. Also, reaching through the fabric of time and space is very dangerous, so careful!

summon beasts.name: summon beasts
summon beasts.description: This spell summons a pack of ferocious animals that aid the caster in combat, attacking any creatures that are hostile to their summoner. Unfortunately the rift that supports the demonic presence is brittle, and the pack remains in the prime plane for a very limited time. They are not capable of following the summoner to other locations.

summon carnal spores.name: summon carnal spores
summon carnal spores.description: One of the most feared poison spells, is the spell summon carnal spores. This spell summons small, almost invisible spores that are the purest form of poison. They appear around the victim and need only contact on the target to introduce one of the most powerful poisons known. Besides overcoming pain, internal organs will be affected, being attacked by the toxins. In some cases total loss of control of movement will cause the victim to fall writhing in agony on the ground.

summon dire boar.name: summon dire boar
summon dire boar.description: This spell summons an unearthly dire boar from the realms of Tzarakk. The beast will assist the summoner in combat, and follow him around to some degree.

summon greater spores.name: summon greater spores
summon greater spores.description: One crafty mage, who saw how the spell summon lesser spores was a reworking of an early magical failure, did some research of his own. He saw that the accident which the lesser spores spell was fairly minor, and that the resulting spell was also a fairly minor spell. He remembered learning about another  earlier tale, where several practicers of magic were trying to jointly conjure a great amount of power. The result was a tremendous explosion, which killed all who were involved. By researching this event, he was able to recreate the  scope of the energy conjured, and tailor it into a stable form. The result, is a spell, while similar to the lesser spores, that is much more powerful.

summon homonculus.name: summon homonculus
summon homonculus.description: From a heart of a dead monster, you can summon a homonculus. It will obey and worship the ground you walk on... unless your skill is too low. Syntax: cast summon homonculus at heart set <name>. Component: heart.You can also use this spell to bring your homonculus to you. However, it won't work if the homonculus is carrying any items. You do not need a heart for that version of the spell, nor do you need to use a target.

summon lesser spores.name: summon lesser spores
summon lesser spores.description: This spell was first originated when those studying the early potential of magical powers. When they were first trying to conjure magical forces of any kind, they accidently summoned a very unstable form, which immediately exploded in their faces. Some time later, when magic was being used as a tool, as a  weapon, someone remembered reading about that early accident in some old scrolls. They went back and found the old chants and after some research, refined the spell into a form that  was easily and safely used. The resulting spell is able to summon small glowing spheres of energy, that resemble the spores of some plants, that sail towards the target and explode.

summon mount.name: summon mount
summon mount.description: There are times when one must leave behind their mount and travel or fight on foot, for whatever reason. However, when that time is over, the fastest one returns to the saddle, the better. This spell instantly retrieves one's most faithful mount, transporting it to the caster's side -- assuming the mount could enter the room, that is. Only noble mounts can be called with this spell.

summon rift entity.name: summon rift entity
summon rift entity.description: You can use this spell to summon one of your rift entities. The time it takes you to cast will decrease as all your entities grow in power. An entity will disappear if you are not in the front row of the party formation, and suffer a health penalty when you next summon it. Type 'gem entities' for a list of available entities. Syntax: cast summon rift entity at <type/name> This spell uses 5 rift sparks.

summon slaads.name: summon slaads
summon slaads.description: While the worshippers of Burglefloogah often walk alone, they're never left without guidance. The frog god Burglefloogah often watches over those who are in its service. The ones who often offer protection are those who are sometimes met at the Great Swamp. When in despair, the servants of darkness have been known to resort to the help of the slaads. These large froglike creatures who dwell in the marshes are fearsome fighters. The amount of slaads depends from the spell percent as well as caster's wisdom. The slaads are summoned from swamp realms of the caster.

summon squire.name: summon squire
summon squire.description: When a knight is fully equipped with a full set of plate mail armour, a strong shield, a fine lance, a mighty sword, and a good set of adventuring supplies, this rarely leaves a lot of room to collect weapons, armour, and other treasures from any vanquished enemies. When a knight needs an extra hand, or more often two, this spell brings a squire to assist the knight by watching items or mounts until they are called for again.
summon squire.spell_vocals: I need someone to watch this for me

summon storm.name: summon storm
summon storm.description: As the harvest comes, the weather of this world turns harsh and unforgiving. Monsoon winds, thundering storms, sudden blizzards and even shredding hail plague the land. During this troubled time, a druid can tap into this savage fury and wield this force as a brutal weapon.

suppress magic.name: suppress magic
suppress magic.description: This spell will suppress the magical abilities of any creature whom it hits. The monster's resistance is based on its level.

suppressing misery.name: suppressing misery
suppressing misery.description: Brain controls all actions of living beings, when brain becomes compromised so does the defensive and offensive abilities of the victim also. More the disease affects the victims brain less capable the victim is to defend himself and fight back. This spell is in effect while emitting aura through embracing gifts bestowed upon the acolyte by Lord Nergal and thus it cannot be casted by normal means.

sweet lullaby.name: sweet lullaby
sweet lullaby.description: Many a wonderful thing can be achieved by the magical playing of a bard, but not all of them need to be mind-boggling to be useful; so thought Diego the Bard and composed a hypnotic tune to ease the worried minds of his adventuring fellows, granting them a moment of precious rest.
sweet lullaby.spell_vocals: There is nothing you can do, when you realize with fright, that the Spider Queen is having you for dinner tonight... it's much too late to get away, the Spider Queen is having you for dinner tonight.

telekinetic whirlwind.name: telekinetic whirlwind
telekinetic whirlwind.description: Even in the smallest fishing villages of the realm, there is always someone who knows just enough cantrips and trickery to bring smiles to children's faces. These tricks often include moving small items such as spoons and coins without touching them. The ability of controlling material objects from distance without physical contact is often referred as telekinesis. This art comes also in more refined forms either in magnificent displays of control or simply raw force, as is the case here. If you know what you are doing, and possess the needed training and experience, you actually accelerate inanimate objects to speeds that make them fatal projectiles. There is also an additional benefit in this approach, since hardness of the objects may also be altered through willpower making almost anything a potential weapon, as long as they are heavy enough.Weight is an issue here, because to inflict the same amount of damage they require more speed and it is much harder to concentrate on fast-moving targets. Of course, what is considered fast-moving for a beginner is might not be that for a master. Once you have achieved the required level of competence the lighter items are just as deadly as the heavier ones. No matter how good you get, you still have to use enough items as projectiles to make the assaults as efficient and unpredictable as possible.This spell is a sustained attack on a singular target in form of a whirlwind produced by the caster's will. The psychokinetic forces acting on the engulfed items to repeatedly pound on the victim. This type of assualt is very effient, but requires caster's full attetion for the duration of the spell, and is taxing to her magical energy as well as to the items used in it.You may prematurely end the spell with 'whirlwind stop'.

teleport with error.name: teleport with error
teleport with error.description: Long ago, when early studies into teleportation magic  were being conducted, a way to magically move oneself was discovered. Unfortunately, a few of the early scholars were lost when they teleported themselves into cliffs and building walls. This set back the study of this art many centuries. With time, a different method was found to make the memory of location more precise. After a bit, some adventuring scholars went back and managed to find twists to the first teleportation spells that made them  work. Well, at least a little better. This spell, while not perfect, is still much easier to use then the later discovered spells. For the most part there have been no recent records of users of this chant teleporting into solid objects, most may find themselves a couple of metres above the air and land on  their rump, and that  only hurts pride, doesn't it?

teleport without error.name: teleport without error
teleport without error.description: This spell instantly teleports the caster to their starting location. This spell is foolproof and incapable of error. Mastery of locating reduces the mana cost of this spell.

terror.name: terror
terror.description: 'There is nothing to fear, but fear itself.' This saying is attributed to a wise sage, long since left this world. His words proved to be more true than even he could imagine. Fear is existent only in one's mind. This being the case, it is possible to use magical and mental techniques to introduce fear in such a way that even the bravest warrior is turned into a sniveling coward.

there not there.name: there not there
there not there.description: Sight, while usually reliable, must be interpreted by one's mind. Those who practice mental magic, can weave auras of magic around items, so that while they are visible, they do not appear to one's mind, the picture that really counts. This spell does not completely hide an item since those who have a keen mind can sometimes see through the mental illusion.

thorn spray.name: thorn spray
thorn spray.description: The spell thorn spray is used by those skilled in poison magic. Upon command, a short burst of thorns, dripping with poison sail towards the target. While not a deadly poison, upon contact, it does cause great pain momentarily, that fades to mild irritation in several minutes.

touch of glacial winds.name: touch of glacial winds
touch of glacial winds.description: A funnel-like weather phenomenon is an extremely rare event that may occur during winter. On normal circumstances, winter storms are rarely as strong as the weakest summer cyclones. They have relative short lifespans, but can make climate much cooler. With this spell cold mages can summon an arctic storm, which will surround the target slowing down its actions.

touch of madness.name: touch of madness
touch of madness.description: The mind hovers closer to insanity than most people want to believe. A strong psionicist can push a victim's mind just close enough to that border and show them what madness really is. Crippled by sudden visions and impulses, complicated actions, such as spells and skills, become much harder for the struggling victim for a short time. Discipline and psychic resistance will lower the effect of the spell, but even the undead are at least partially vulnerable to the grip of insanity. Mastery prolongs the effect, while knowledge of mental defense increases the likelihood of interrupts.

toxic dilution.name: toxic dilution
toxic dilution.description: Poisons, whether magical or non-magical, can make any encounter deadly. If used against defenseless targets, poisons are usually unstoppable. Certain magical means provide some degree of protection against this type of attack. One such mean casts a magical aura over the target which allows one some resistance and immunity to poisonous attacks. While it doesn't make one completely immune, it does help alot, and may be the difference between victory and defeat.

transfer mana.name: transfer mana
transfer mana.description: Magical power is not a completely unknown measurement. Magic exists in different forms and in different magnitudes. The powers that individuals possess, can sometimes be transferred from one person, to another. This is useful if one has drained his magical resources, yet may need to conduct activities that require his magical abilities. Another who has retained his magical power, can transfer a portion of his power to another. This spell is similar to the evil spell mana drain, but requires a voluntary sponsor of magical power.

transform golem.name: transform golem
transform golem.description: While some channellers throw together golems from assorted litter for quick, menial jobs, other spend time and effort making large, beautiful constructions with great strength and power. Naturally, they would like to protect their investment. This spell allows them to change their servants into small figurines or back, making them considerably easier to store. The effect of this spell on other types of golems is unknown and considered risky. Cast transformation increases the size of golems you are allowed to manipulate.

transform rift entity.name: transform rift entity
transform rift entity.description: Once a riftwalker has control over a number of different entities, he/she can transform their existing entity into another entity type. NOTE: solo kills will NOT register on the top kills plaques for 30 minutes after using this spell. Syntax: cast transform rift entity at <type/name> This spell uses 1 rift spark.

transmute self.name: transmute self
transmute self.description: Using magic, crafty individuals can drastically change their appearence. This may allow them to move unhindered in an area normally impassable to them, or allow them to hide unnoticed in a room. To use this spell one only needs to have present the item or person he wants to take the shape of. It is also said that the gods will punish severely anyone who attempts to take their image, as this is blasphemy.

travel.name: travel
travel.description: With this spell a tree navigator is able to travel through other navigators' nodes without paying the fee. Valid target is an existing link to another node when standing before another one. Opening the rift uses either mana or endurance depending on navigators characteristics.

true harm.name: true harm
true harm.description: It is rumored that in the Old Times, there existed even more powerful harm spells than harm body. Some ancient texts mention Lady of Lamentations, also known as the Great Hag-Queen of the East, being able to channel the very essence of harm itself. That spell was called 'true harm' but the knowledge of the spell vocals themselves is long forgotten. Not much is known from the spell, but like other harm spells, this one required the caster to touch her target. When touched, the target gained some external and internal injuries, obviously causing intense pain. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

true heal.name: true heal
true heal.description: It is said that the most powerful healing spell known is so powerful that it is just short of being able to restore life to  a dead target. Virtually any wound of any magnitude can be healed with this spell. Even complete limbs which have been torn off can  sometimes be replaced. It's general consensus that if this  spell is unable to recover an individual, its best that you spend the magical power to resurrect him, not heal him.

true party heal.name: true party heal
true party heal.description: Anyone who has undertaken the task of attempting to  defeat a powerful foe, such as a large dragon know that they have the capability to defeat the entire party at once, or at least to cripple it in an instant. The only way to recover from such a devestating action is to be able to heal the entire party, with great effectiveness. This spell does just that. After having half of a party put out of action from a dragon's breath, nothing short of a true party heal may be able to save the party's efforts to this point from complete failure.

uncontrollable hideous laughter.name: uncontrollable hideous laughter
uncontrollable hideous laughter.description: A spell of limited practical use, but still not without merit, is the spell uncontrollable hideous laughter. Said to having originated from some of the smaller, mischief laden folk, such as pixies and leprachauns, this spell will cause the target to find virtually everything downright funny. Well most useful to cheer someone up, or brighten someone's  day, there are few ways better to distract someone then to have them rolling around on the ground laughing themselves to tears.

uncontrollable mosh.name: uncontrollable mosh
uncontrollable mosh.description: One night they did a mosh pit in the center of the room at the institute of entertainment. They drank some wine and had a good time and played all the songs they could ever think of. Then one bard got an idea 'howabout some different music'. The mosh pit was finally entered and the crowd was getting very anxious because of the forecoming. They started to play - total power was released, aggression hit them with a dwarf's battle fury. Their long hair flowing, doing the eight, flying here and there; their bodies slamming into the walls and eachother; people stage-diving into the crowd... Afterwards they felt VERY awful, their heads and neck hurt and bodies were sore. Luckily no one died! The spell spared NO ONE 'xcept the player.
uncontrollable mosh.spell_vocals: III want to ROAR, III want to SLAM, III want to bash your ass! Hit the WALLS! Hit the WALLS! Go, go go I'll screw the BASS! Hit the WALLS! Hit the WALLS!

unholy matrimony.name: unholy matrimony
unholy matrimony.description: The dowry had been discussed by her family and Shana stood by the altar, wondering if she had what it takes to go through with the wedding while she knew deep in her heart that there was someone else she had devoted her life to. There were no mortal men competing for her heart. It was the overlord of darkness himself that she had vowed her life to. She couldn't hold her tongue anymore. Reluctantly she explained her conviction causing embarrassment to the groom and his family. And just like Curath had stabbed Galean out of jealousy, the groom grabbed his dagger and plunged the dagger through her chest. Shana collapsed, becoming unconscious. As the wedding guests rushed to help her they noticed something peculiar. She was calmly asleep, breathing, and despite the newly inflicted wound, the bride of Draen-Dalar wasn't bleeding either.
unholy matrimony.spell_vocals: I beseech thy wisdom my lord

unleash bogs.name: unleash bogs
unleash bogs.description: Bogs are the domain of the swampdwellers. There are many satraps who dedicate their lives in the servitude of toads who often consider themselves as the descendants of their champion, Burglefloogah. Many satraps know that not only are there societies hidden underneath the swamp, but there is also a lot of untapped power ready to be unleashed. It would be unwise of the satrap not to harness power to their own advantage. This is what many satraps have done throughout the ages by using an ancient spell that allows controlling the marshes in fashion that would not be possible with less extraordinary ways.

unpain.name: unpain
unpain.description: By strengthening the mind, and relaxing the body, one can use magical means to help one ignore pain. Once this spell is cast, the target is given enhanced limits to the amount of damage he can withstand before giving in. Every time his pain threshold is tested, he may lose a bit of the extra limits given to him by this spell.

unstable mutation.name: unstable mutation
unstable mutation.description: One of the more recent mental techniques learned by some of the more chaotic orders of psionics is one that boosts the mental and physical limits of the caster. Be warned this is a relatively new enchantment, and is not yet fully understood, side effects may be dangerous.

unstun.name: unstun
unstun.description: This prayer helps the target against stuns from physical and magical sources, slowly wearing off as it absorbs hits that will otherwise interrupt or daze. However, this mental and physical fortitude is not foolproof; damage from the stun is not absorbed, and some particularly powerful stuns can still bypass this protection.

vacuum ball.name: vacuum ball
vacuum ball.description: This spell is similar to the spell suffocation, except  that a larger pocket of space is affected. This allows the spell to affect several targets at once. Any target hit by this spell undergo sharp loss of air around them, causing damage.

vacuum globe.name: vacuum globe
vacuum globe.description: The most powerful asphyxiation spell is the spell vacuum globe. By creating a swirling vacuum area big enough to evelope several targets at once, the effects are devastating. Loss of air, and the damage from the sudden loss of pressure can cause great harm to blood vessels and organs of all the targets affected.

vacuumbolt.name: vacuumbolt
vacuumbolt.description: The most basic of the spells that attack the target is the spell vacuumbolt. This spell causes a small mass of space to become void of air. This mass of airless space, is then directed at the target. When the magic releases  air around the target into the space, this sucks the air from the targets lungs with great force, knocking the wind out of it.

vampiric charm.name: vampiric charm
vampiric charm.description: This spells makes it quite difficult for the target to cast offensive spells or use offensive skills at caster.

venom strike.name: venom strike
venom strike.description: With this spell, the poison mage can strike their target with a very potent poison, with only a thought. After the proper words are spoken, only a gesture is needed to inflict a deadly poison into the victim. Severe pain,  accompanied by dizziness and some loss of motor functions as the poison attacks the nervous system, comes from being inflicted by this spell.

venturers way.name: venturers way
venturers way.description: 'We still have to press on', said the heavily breathing slaver. 'But alas, our prisoners cannot take any longer and either can we', telepathed the young beholder-kin. 'So we end the day's march here, ensure that our accompanions will not try anything, and CEASE the one playing the lute.', the monster instructed forward.   Not a moment after heavy masses of a hundred slaves started bashing forward with renewed strength. 'Draen-dalar curse us, they are revolting', were the last words of the slaver before numbing blackness caught him..
venturers way.spell_vocals: ..a few steps to earthen might, a few steps just go ahead me, but do I walk the right direction, is it here or there? Just a few steps, left or right. Spirits are what show the sight.

vigilant melody.name: vigilant melody
vigilant melody.description: Even though bards are known to be a jovial lot, not known of shyness by any means, they are also aware of the fact that there are many beings in the Realms whose intentions are far from being benevolent. As bards also have a habit of traveling alone, the loremasters developed this song to protect.. or at least notify the songweaver of lurking dangers.
vigilant melody.spell_vocals: Lost I am not but knowledge I seek for there, my friend, lies a true path for wisdom. With a clouded mind one can not think, but small fog may enhance a presence.

vine mantle.name: vine mantle
vine mantle.description: Druids are able to call upon nature to assist them in their duties and activites. One power they may choose to learn, is to use plants as a physical barrier. This barrier covers the target and protects them from damage to some extent. These vine coverings can be layers, but can also become difficult for the target to bear, as they are burdensome if stacked.

war ensemble.name: war ensemble
war ensemble.description: Whenever war ensemble is echoed in the skies, men on the battlefield get encouraged and their battle-lusts back! It is one of the most influential bard songs dealing with battle.
war ensemble.spell_vocals: War is TOTAL massacre, sport the war, war SUPPOORT!!!

water walking.name: water walking
water walking.description: Most of the world is covered in water, which makes it very impassable, unless you have a boat. This fact resulted in one of the earliest magical spells, one that allows one to walk over the water, as if it were dry land. This spell is very useful since the user does not touch the water at all, nice for keeping one's feet dry.

wilderness location.name: wilderness location
wilderness location.description: This spell tells you the number of rooms east,west,north,south you must travel to get to a location memorized by location memory. You may also use a player as the target, and if the player is on the globe, it will tell directions to the player. It shows you straight line calculation, which doesn't navigate around mountains, but it is possible that you will get ground-based path which would avoid those pesky mountains.Example use: cast wilderness location at guild              cast wilderness location at player duke
wilderness location.spell_vocals: spirits of nature, show me the way!

wither.name: wither
wither.description: This spell affects the recipient's dex. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

wither flesh.name: wither flesh
wither flesh.description: The most evil and powerful spells of Druids, which causes target great pain  while the caster is in the room. Target will also momentarily be very  disoriented from pain. Runic mastery dramatically increases the effect of  this spell. Note: This spell is very powerful and fumble has a similar  nightmarish effect.

wizard eye.name: wizard eye
wizard eye.description: This spell shows a circular map around the caster. You can give it an argument for how large an area it shows. usage: cast wizard eye at 15 (shows 15 spaces around you)

word of apocalypse.name: word of apocalypse
word of apocalypse.description: As the ultimate reaver has surpassed the need to be specialized in his destructive efforts, this spell is for them. It attacks every man, woman, child, or any other living thing who hears the word and who's vulnerabilities the reaver has studied. Each victim suffers a different amount of internal pain and damage based on how well that victim's type or race was studied through word of spite. Only the reaver himself is immune to the spell. Syntax: cast word of apocalypse Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of attrition.name: word of attrition
word of attrition.description: This, the simplest of reaver spells, calls upon the power of destruction against a single item sitting on the ground. Energies appear to hasten the natural entropic forces on that item, making it appear to age suddenly. While this is not truly the case, the effect is the same -- the item is broken down into useless parts. Things found lying around are generally considered to have little value, and as such, reavers who destroy them do not get a lot of credit for it.

word of blasting.name: word of blasting
word of blasting.description: The word of blasting is a potent weapon in the reaver's arsenal. With but a single word, the reaver harnesses dark energy into a concussive force, which can injure, disorient, and possibly kill a single living target. A glowing symbol of destruction accompanies the spell's effect, but does not itself do anything. Training in the skill bash increases the likelihood of disorientation.

word of destruction.name: word of destruction
word of destruction.description: An ancient incantation of great power, the word of destruction is even more dangerous than the word of blasting. It has the same effect on the victim itself, but in addition to the damaging effects, it can also damage or destroy a weapon, shield, or piece of armour the target is using.

word of genocide.name: word of genocide
word of genocide.description: Like the word of slaughter, the word of genocide strikes targets the reaver has learned to destroy through the use of the word of spite. This spell, however, is far more dangerous. Not only does it inflict a more painful strike to those affected, but it hits every single creature in the room of the chosen race -- even those working with the reaver. Affected creatures, blighted or not, often fall to the ground clutching their sides, as the magical strain to their bodies causes massive internal wounds. Syntax: cast word of genocide at <target race> Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of oblivion.name: word of oblivion
word of oblivion.description: The legendary word of oblivion is the most powerful spell the reavers have discovered. They tap into the terrible force of chaos directly, using its all-consuming power to tear apart not just the victim but his armour, his weapons, his clothing, his hopes, his dreams, and his soul. Those few who have proven themselves capable of surviving multiple lashes of this horrifying enchantment have been found cringing and weeping naked on street corners, left with nothing.

word of recall.name: word of recall
word of recall.description: A few crafty users of teleportation magic have devised a neat little trick. Thankfully for the rest of us, they decided to share their secret to their pupils, which gradually found its way into the studies of most novice users of magic. By preparing a special incantation, one can set a safe location, and, in the time of great peril, be instantly  whisked there from danger. While this art is very unrefined yet, it is responsible for saving many novices from  situations they have blundered into unexpectedly. There are also a few more powerful beings who have used this spell to save their hide, but due to pride, this isn't as commonly known case by case... Note: It is also rumored that extreme  knowledge of the teleportation magics can ease the stress  of the sudden teleportation on the user.

word of slaughter.name: word of slaughter
word of slaughter.description: The word of slaughter is a dangerous magical tool that turns a victim's own body against him. Weaknesses of the target's body are used as the victim's joints pull apart, muscles tear, and skin pulls away. While the effect is not often visible, it is quite painful. There is also a chance the target will be blighted by the attack, unable to move or fight as easily as before due to the trauma of the attack. In order to affect a certain type of creature, the reaver must study creatures of that type through the use of the word of spite, the more the better. Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of spite.name: word of spite
word of spite.description: The word of spite is a useful tool for reavers of all kinds. With but a simple word, the caster smites the target with any latent jealousness, bigotry, and bias within his black heart, which tears at the victim's soul. However, a far more important reaction also takes place. As the reaver uses this spell on more and more creatures of a specific race or type, insight into that race or type is used to cause greater effect for the word of slaughter. Creatures resistant or immune to probing effects may be resistant or immune to word of spite.

wrath beyond grave.name: wrath beyond grave
wrath beyond grave.description: Somewhere deep underneath the swamp each satrap keeps their own Tomb of Horrors and only few know the unimaginable abominations that remain buried there. Using very powerful magic, the most talented of priests are able to channel the vigor of their mummies and use it against their enemies. This particular spell targets only those enemies who originate from the same realm as the mummy who provides the vigor for the spell.

wrath of las.name: wrath of las
wrath of las.description: In the old times Gods had solemn agreement not to interfere directly on mortals daily life, especially not to involve other God's territory. That agreement was broken when other Gods, mainly Curath and Oxtoth, conspired with wizards and mortals inflicting the destruction of Sisters of Las. God Las got very angry and handed this spell as a gift to the nun leaders to even the balance between evil and good. With this spell a talented nun may channel the WRATH OF LAS towards the servants of evil Gods. When successfully cast, the divine fire strikes like lightning through caster's relic zapping any evil or undead creature with terrific amount of force. Though Las' wrath is infite the caster must wait certain time before she may channel the wrath again. Because of the divine nature of this spell it may only be used by the members of Synod. This spell is the ultimate tribune to God Las.

youth.name: youth
youth.description: This spell reduces the age of the target creature. It can be cast only to Player Characters. The effect is dependant upon caster's level.

zealotry.name: zealotry
zealotry.description: There are some whose blind devotion to their object of worship, or to good/evil as a concept, goes beyond the accepted limits even for the devout. Such fanatics are often called insane, even by those of the same religion. This spell touches the minds of every living creature in the same area as the caster, promoting the same fanatism. In a nutshell, good creatures become more good, evil creatures become more evil, and neutral creatures are more likely to pick a side.

zoological protection.name: zoological protection
zoological protection.description: Every creature has its strong sides and its weak sides. This spell draws its power from assessing the strong points of a creature and then creating a protection against those. Be it the sting of a scorpion or the hug of a grizzly, this spell protects its target. As the name suggests, not all creatures are affected by this spell, only animals.
